explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：業務常誤以為 CIF 下賣方要承擔全程運輸風險直到抵達目的港，同義改寫為 (B)「誤認在 CIF 條件下賣方於貨物抵港前仍須承擔運輸責任」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(A) 引用 FOB、export customs、main ocean freight、minimum insurance 混淆規則。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which shipping rule matches the arrangement requested for the upcoming European contract?
options: EXW
FOB
DDP
CIF

explain.text:
正解：(C)
• 解析：【圖表交叉比對】講者描述新歐洲合約要求賣方負責「main ocean carriage（主運費）」與「import customs clearance（進口清關）」，且風險於「named destination（指定目的地）」才移轉。對照表格四個欄位，唯獨 DDP 符合這三項條件。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(D) 皆為表格中其他貿易條件，無法同時滿足賣方負擔進口清關與主運費。
• 單字補充：transit liability 運輸責任；named destination 指定目的地。

Q83–Q85（廣播新聞：巴拿馬運河乾旱限制）

questions.q: What is the report mainly about?
options: An expansion allowing 36 daily ships in the canal
A new rail network built across the isthmus
Rising marine fuel prices in East Asia
Environmental conditions limiting maritime passage

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：報導主軸為 severe seasonal drought continues to restrict water levels in the Panama Canal，同義改寫為 (D)「限制海上航道的環境條件」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 引用 rail、isthmus、marine fuel、36 捏造新聞重點。

questions.q: How are shipping lines responding to the situation?
options: By waiting fourteen days at the canal entrance
By paying extra fees to exceed the 24-ship daily cap
By lightening ship weight or taking longer alternate paths
By suspending all Asia-to-U.S. East Coast sailings

explain.text:
正解：(C)
• 解析：船公司透過鐵路轉運減輕吃水深度或繞道非洲南端，同義改寫為 (C)「減輕船隻載重或改走較長的替代航線」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(A) 引用 Asia-to-U.S. East Coast、24、fourteen days 誇大或扭曲應對方式。

questions.q: What impact is predicted for global retailers?
options: Extended restocking cycles and increased holding expenses
A permanent switch to African rail transport
Immediate fuel rebates from shipping lines
Lower demand during the peak shopping season

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：零售商將面臨 longer inventory lead times and higher carrying costs，同義改寫為 (A)「補貨週期拉長且持有成本增加」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 引用 peak shopping season、fuel、Africa、rail 捏造影響。
• 單字補充：maritime passage 海上通道；restocking cycle 補貨週期。

Q86–Q88（國際快遞語音系統）

questions.q: What kind of business is the caller contacting?
options: A local ground delivery company
An expedited overseas parcel carrier
A customs brokerage in SkyBridge
An invoice auditing agency

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：SkyBridge International Courier, your global partner for time-critical air express 同義改寫為 (B)「加急海外包裹承運商」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(A) 引用 customs、invoices 設陷阱。

questions.q: Which option should a caller press to check on a detained package?
options: Press 1
Press 2
Press 3
Press 4

explain.text:
正解：(C)
• 解析：If your shipment has been detained by customs... press 3 對應 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 預約取件/報價；(B) 更新地址；(D) 帳務查詢。

questions.q: What information should callers have ready before speaking with a representative?
options: A ten-character shipment reference code
The recipient's updated street address
A freight quote confirmation number
A copy of the commercial invoice

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：10-digit air waybill or tracking number 同義改寫為 (A)「十位數貨件追蹤代碼」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(C) 引用 commercial invoice、delivery address、freight quote 等其他按鍵提到的名詞。
• 單字補充：expedited 加急的；detained 被扣留的。

Q89–Q91（自動化發貨中心開幕致詞）

questions.q: Why is the speaker giving this speech?
options: To introduce new safety rules for port terminals
To mark the launch of a mechanized distribution site
To announce a $120 million retail expansion
To honor engineers retiring from the Savannah plant

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：grand opening of our new 400,000-square-foot automated fulfillment center 同義改寫為 (B)「慶祝機械化配送據點啟用」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(D) 引用 $120 million、retail、safety、engineers、Savannah 捏造致詞目的。

questions.q: What feature of the new facility does the speaker emphasize?
options: Custom safety vests designed by floor engineers
A direct rail link to the Savannah port terminal
A 400,000-square-foot retail showroom
High-speed automated item handling technology

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：robotic sorting and retrieval system capable of processing 80,000... parcels per hour 同義改寫為 (D)「高速自動化物件處理技術」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 引用 Savannah、port terminal、400,000-square-foot、safety vest 設陷阱。

questions.q: What are attendees invited to do after the speech?
options: Inspect 80,000 export parcels at the gate
Watch a presentation in the Savannah port lounge
Meet with Southeast retail clients
Walk through the operations area with technical staff

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：join our floor engineers for a guided tour of the packing floor 同義改寫為 (D)「在技術人員陪同下參觀作業區」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 引用 Savannah、Southeast、retail clients、80,000 捏造會後活動。
• 單字補充：mechanized 機械化的；operations area 作業區。

Q92–Q94（Podcast 訪談：信用狀單據審核）

questions.q: What is the guest's area of expertise?
options: Port loading and vessel scheduling
Certificate of origin formatting
International payment instruments
Retail buyer dispute resolution

explain.text:
正解：(C)
• 解析：受訪者為 trade finance specialist 並專精 Letters of Credit，同義歸納為 (C)「國際支付工具」。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(D) 引用 ship、certificate of origin、buyer 設陷阱。

questions.q: Why does the guest warn exporters against discrepancies in documents?
options: Financial institutions may decline to release funds.
Customs officials will seize the certificate of origin.
Buyers must pay double for a new packing list.
Shipping lines will unload the goods from the ship.

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：the bank has the legal right to reject the documents and withhold payment 同義改寫為 (A)「金融機構可能拒絕撥款」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 引用 goods、ship、buyer、packing list、certificate of origin 誇大後果。

questions.q: What does the guest imply when she says, "Even a single misspelled street name can freeze half a million dollars"?
options: Buyers frequently waive minor spelling mistakes.
Shipping documents are rarely checked before sailing.
Exporters often lose half a million dollars on street deliveries.
Lenders require exact accuracy across all submitted paperwork.

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：Even a single misspelled street name can freeze half a million dollars 強調銀行嚴格審查單據字面一致性，同義改寫為 (D)「放款機構要求所有提交文件必須完全精確」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(B) 引用 half a million dollars、street、waives、shipping document 曲解原意。
• 單字補充：payment instrument 支付工具；decline to release funds 拒絕撥款。

Q95–Q97（圖表題：港口泊位簡報）

questions.q: Who is the speaker most likely addressing?
options: Port operations leaders
Harbor pilots waiting for the 14:00 shift
Vessel captains sailing to Gothenburg
Gantry crane manufacturers

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：說話者對團隊下達 lead supervisor 任務並討論各泊位作業，同義歸納為 (A)「港口營運主管」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 引用 harbor pilot、14:00、Gothenburg、Gantry Crane 設陷阱。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which berth requires immediate attention due to an equipment issue?

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：【圖表交叉比對】圖表中有兩艘船顯示 Delayed（B-14 與 B-11），獨白指出「前往 Felixstowe 的船因 7 號橋式起重機液壓問題而需立即維修」，對照圖表 Felixstowe 對應泊位 B-14。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(D) 皆為圖表中的其他泊位，其中 (D) B-11 同樣顯示 Delayed 但原因為等待領港員（awaiting a harbor pilot）。

questions.q: What does the speaker instruct the team to do regarding MV Atlantic Wave?
options: Delay loading export containers until 16:30
Repair Gantry Crane 7 before 14:00
Wait for a harbor pilot from Hamburg
Complete loading records and cast off

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：請 B-12 主管 finalize the stowage plan and release mooring lines，同義改寫為 (D)「完成裝載紀錄並解纜啟航」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 引用 Gantry Crane 7、14:00、harbor pilot、Hamburg、16:30 混搭其他船隻資訊。
• 單字補充：stowage plan 積載圖；cast off 解纜啟航。

Q98–Q100（自由貿易協定原產地規則簡報）

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the talk?
options: To review procurement cost breakdowns from last quarter
To clarify revised trade-pact qualification standards
To introduce new industrial machinery from overseas vendors
To announce a 45 percent increase in MFN tariffs

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：主題為 updated Rules of Origin under our regional Free Trade Agreement，同義改寫為 (B)「說明修訂後的貿易協定資格標準」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(A) 引用 45 percent、MFN tariffs、industrial machinery、procurement、quarter 設陷阱。

questions.q: What happens if a product fails to meet the Regional Value Content threshold?
options: It loses eligibility for zero-tariff entry.
It is rejected by procurement teams next quarter.
The vendor must pay a 45 percent import penalty.
It is automatically classified as industrial machinery.

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：若未達門檻則 cannot qualify for preferential duty-free treatment，同義改寫為 (A)「喪失零關稅入境資格」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 引用 procurement teams、45 percent、industrial machinery 捏造罰則或後果。

questions.q: What resource will the speaker distribute at the end of the session?
options: A copy of the regional Free Trade Agreement
A list of MFN tariff rates for next quarter
A verification form for vendor cost data
A 40 percent content calculation guide

explain.text:
正解：(C)
• 解析：會後將發放 standardized supplier declaration checklist，同義改寫為 (C)「供應商成本資料查核表」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 引用 MFN tariff、Free Trade Agreement、40 percent 設陷阱。
• 單字補充：eligibility 資格；verification form 查核表單。

questions.q: All consignments containing lithium-ion batteries must be accompanied by a signed safety declaration ______ to vessel loading.
options: ahead
prior
former
previous

explain.text:
正解：(B) prior
• 考點：固定介系詞片語搭配（prior to）。
• 解析：空格後接 to vessel loading，需用 prior to（在…之前）。
• 誘答分析：(D) previous to 雖偶見於非正式語，多益正式用法必選 prior to；(C) former 不接 to；(A) ahead 需搭配 of。
• 單字補充：be accompanied by 隨附、safety declaration 安全聲明書。

questions.q: Should customs authorities ______ any discrepancy between the commercial invoice and the physical cargo, clearance will be suspended immediately.
options: detecting
detected
detect
to detect

explain.text:
正解：(C) detect
• 考點：假設語氣與條件句倒裝（省略 if）。
• 解析：句首 Should customs authorities ______ 為 If customs authorities should detect... 的倒裝，助動詞 Should 提前，後面動詞需用原形 detect。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(A)、(D) 均不符合助動詞後接原形動詞的結構。
• 單字補充：discrepancy 差異/不符、suspend 暫停。

questions.q: The logistics division implemented an automated route-optimization algorithm, ______ transit times across Southeast Asian corridors by nearly 18 percent.
options: reduces
reduced
reducing
reduce

explain.text:
正解：(C) reducing
• 考點：分詞構句表結果。
• 解析：逗號前為完整子句，逗號後無連接詞，須使用現在分詞 reducing 表主動伴隨結果（「進而縮短了…近 18% 的運輸時間」）。
• 誘答分析：(D)、(A) 為限定動詞，缺少連接詞不能接在逗號後；(B) 被動語態不合（後方有受詞 transit times）。
• 單字補充：route-optimization algorithm 路線最佳化演算法、corridor 運輸走廊。

questions.q: ______ the severe congestion at West Coast ports, Pacifica Electronics decided to divert half of its fourth-quarter inventory through Vancouver.
options: In light of
Whereas
Even though
Because

explain.text:
正解：(A) In light of
• 考點：介系詞片語與連接詞辨析。
• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 the severe congestion...，需填入介系詞片語 In light of（鑑於、考量到）。
• 誘答分析：(D) Because、(C) Even though、(B) Whereas 皆為從屬連接詞，後須接完整子句。
• 單字補充：congestion 壅塞、divert 轉移/改道。

questions.q: Under the revised shipping terms agreement, the exporter bears full financial responsibility for marine insurance ______ the goods reach the designated port of discharge.
options: until
unless
despite
while

explain.text:
正解：(A) until
• 考點：時間副詞子句連接詞辨析。
• 解析：語意為「出口商承擔海運保險的全部財務責任，直到貨物抵達指定卸貨港為止」，選 until。
• 誘答分析：(B) unless 除非；(D) while 當…時（持續動作，不配 reach 瞬間動詞）；(C) despite 為介系詞。
• 單字補充：port of discharge 卸貨港、bear responsibility 承擔責任。

questions.q: Freight forwarders are strongly advised to verify the ______ of every product classification code before submitting electronic manifests.
options: accurate
accuracies
accurately
accuracy

explain.text:
正解：(D) accuracy
• 考點：詞性辨析（名詞）。
• 解析：定冠詞 the 與介系詞 of 之間須填入不可數名詞 accuracy（準確性）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 形容詞；(C) 副詞；(B) 複數名詞，此處指抽象準確性，不用複數。
• 單字補充：product classification (HS) code 國際商品統一分類代碼、electronic manifest 電子艙單。

questions.q: Neither the regional distribution manager nor the warehouse supervisors ______ notified of the sudden change in the carrier's gate-in deadline.
options: were
was
is being
has been

explain.text:
正解：(A) were
• 考點：主詞與動詞一致性（Neither A nor B）。
• 解析：Neither A nor B 連接兩主詞時，動詞依就近原則配合 B（the warehouse supervisors 複數），故選複數過去式 were。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(D)、(C) 皆為單數動詞。
• 單字補充：gate-in deadline 進場截止期限。

questions.q: To prevent moisture damage during long-haul ocean voyages, moisture-absorbing desiccant packs are placed ______ each sealed container.
options: upon
toward
among
within

explain.text:
正解：(D) within
• 考點：介系詞語意辨析。
• 解析：吸濕乾燥劑包應放置於每個密封貨櫃「內部」，within（在…裡面）最精準。
• 誘答分析：(C) among 用於三者以上之間；(B) toward 朝向；(A) upon 在…之上。
• 單字補充：desiccant 乾燥劑、long-haul 長途的。

questions.q: The procurement committee sought a vendor capable of ______ fluctuating seasonal demand without compromising product quality.
options: accommodating
accommodated
accommodation
accommodate

explain.text:
正解：(A) accommodating
• 考點：capable of + V-ing 結構。
• 解析：capable of 為介系詞結尾，後接動名詞 accommodating（滿足/因應…需求），且後方有受詞 fluctuating seasonal demand。
• 誘答分析：(C) 名詞後面不能直接帶名詞受詞；(B)、(D) 詞性不符。
• 單字補充：fluctuating 波動的、compromise 妥協/損害。

questions.q: ______ had the container ship cleared the Panama Canal than a mechanical failure forced it to anchor for emergency repairs.
options: Hardly
Not only
No sooner
Scarcely

explain.text:
正解：(C) No sooner
• 考點：倒裝句型與固定搭配（No sooner ... than）。
• 解析：句中出現 than，且句首為過去完成式倒裝 had the container ship cleared...，固定搭配為 No sooner ... than（一…就…）。
• 誘答分析：(D) Scarcely 與 (A) Hardly 須搭配 when 或 before，不可配 than；(B) Not only 語意不合。
• 單字補充：anchor 下錨停泊、mechanical failure 機械故障。

questions.q: Import tariffs on precision optical components vary ______ depending on whether the country of origin holds a bilateral trade pact.
options: considerably
consider
considerable
consideration

explain.text:
正解：(A) considerably
• 考點：詞性辨析（副詞修飾動詞）。
• 解析：空格修飾動詞 vary（變化），須用副詞 considerably（相當大地）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 動詞；(C) 形容詞；(D) 名詞。
• 單字補充：bilateral trade pact 雙邊貿易協定、optical component 光學元件。

questions.q: The new bonded warehouse features temperature-controlled bays specifically ______ to preserve perishable pharmaceutical shipments.
options: designing
designed
designer
design

explain.text:
正解：(B) designed
• 考點：過去分詞片語作後位修飾。
• 解析：bays（貨位/艙間）是被「設計」來保存易腐藥品的，省去 which are，保留過去分詞 designed。
• 誘答分析：(D)、(A)、(C) 皆無法構成被動修飾。
• 單字補充：perishable 易腐敗的、pharmaceutical 醫藥的。

questions.q: Ms. Lin requested that the revised shipping document ______ to the recipient's bank via express courier by Friday afternoon.
options: will be sent
sends
be sent
was sent

explain.text:
正解：(C) be sent
• 考點：要求動詞後的假設語氣（request that S + (should) + V原形）。
• 解析：requested 表示要求，其 that 子句須用 (should) + 原形動詞，貨運單據是「被寄送」，故選 be sent。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(D)、(A) 皆誤用一般時態。
• 單字補充：express courier 國際快遞、recipient 收貨人。

questions.q: Delays in returning empty containers beyond the allotted free time will ______ substantial daily detention charges from the shipping line.
options: occur
incur
concur
recur

explain.text:
正解：(B) incur
• 考點：商務動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：逾期歸還空櫃將「招致/產生」高額延滯費，固定搭配為 incur charges/fees。
• 誘答分析：(D) recur 再次發生（不及物）；(A) occur 發生（不及物）；(C) concur 同意。
• 單字補充：allotted free time 核定的免費使用期、detention charge 延滯費。

questions.q: ______ its modest fleet size, Meridian Air Cargo has earned a reputation for unmatched reliability in time-critical electronics deliveries.
options: As opposed
Provided that
Notwithstanding
Although

explain.text:
正解：(C) Notwithstanding
• 考點：讓步介系詞辨析。
• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 its modest fleet size，語意表「儘管機隊規模不大，該公司仍贏得高可靠度聲譽」，選介系詞 Notwithstanding（儘管）。
• 誘答分析：(D) Although、(B) Provided that 為連接詞；(A) As opposed 須搭配 to。
• 單字補充：modest 規模適中的、unmatched 無可匹敵的。

questions.q: Once the port authority ______ the berth allocation schedule, dispatchers will assign local trucking trucks to retrieve the incoming containers.
options: had finalized
finalizes
finalized
will finalize

explain.text:
正解：(B) finalizes
• 考點：時間副詞子句以現在簡單式代替未來式。
• 解析：Once 引導時間副詞子句，主要子句為未來式 will assign，故時間子句須用現在簡單式 finalizes（主詞 authority 為單數）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 不可在時間子句用 will；(C)、(A) 過去時態不合。
• 單字補充：berth allocation schedule 泊位分配表、local trucking truck 港口短程拖車。

questions.q: The compliance officer conducted a thorough audit of the export logs to ensure strict ______ with international sanctions regulations.
options: adherent
adherence
adhere
adhering

explain.text:
正解：(B) adherence
• 考點：詞性辨析與固定搭配（adherence to）。
• 解析：形容詞 strict 後須接名詞 adherence（遵守），與後方 to 構成 adherence to regulations。
• 誘答分析：(C) 動詞；(A) 名詞「擁護者/信徒」；(D) 動名詞一般不接在純形容詞 strict 後。
• 單字補充：sanctions 貿易制裁、compliance officer 法規遵循專員。

questions.q: Every pallet entering the automated sorting facility must display a scannable barcode label ______ the shipment's destination hub and weight.
options: indicates
indication
indicated
indicating

explain.text:
正解：(D) indicating
• 考點：現在分詞作後位修飾。
• 解析：條碼標籤主動「顯示」目的地與重量，省去 which indicates，保留現在分詞 indicating。
• 誘答分析：(A) 缺關代不可用限定動詞；(C) 被動不合；(B) 名詞無連接功能。
• 單字補充：scannable 可掃描的、sorting facility 分揀中心。

questions.q: By the time the relief vessel arrives at Rotterdam next Thursday, the stranded cargo ______ at the terminal for nearly three weeks.
options: is sitting
will sit
has been sitting
will have been sitting

explain.text:
正解：(D) will have been sitting
• 考點：未來完成進行式（By the time + 現在式, S + will have been V-ing）。
• 解析：By the time the relief vessel arrives next Thursday 表示到未來某時間點為止已持續進行三週，須用未來完成進行式 will have been sitting。
• 誘答分析：(B) 單純未來式無法表現「已持續三週」；(C)、(A) 非未來時態。
• 單字補充：relief vessel 救援/替補船隻、stranded 滯留的。

questions.q: Importers who fail to settle assessed duties within the statutory grace period risk having their merchandise ______ at public auction.
options: liquidating
liquidate
liquidated
liquidation

explain.text:
正解：(C) liquidated
• 考點：使役/遭遇結構（have + 受詞 + Vpp）。
• 解析：語意為「進口商恐面臨商品被公開拍賣變現的風險」，商品 their merchandise 與 liquidate（拍賣變現/清償）為被動關係，故選過去分詞 liquidated。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(A)、(D) 無法表達受詞被動遭遇。
• 單字補充：statutory grace period 法定寬限期、public auction 公開拍賣。

questions.q: The trade ministry's latest directive aims to ______ cross-border customs procedures by digitizing agricultural inspection certificates.
options: streamline
sideline
outshine
underline

explain.text:
正解：(A) streamline
• 考點：商務動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：透過數位化農業檢疫證書來「簡化/使流暢」跨境海關程序，選 streamline。
• 誘答分析：(B) sideline 邊緣化；(D) underline 強調；(C) outshine 勝過。
• 單字補充：directive 指令、agricultural inspection certificate 農業檢疫證明書。

questions.q: ______ the supplier can guarantee a minimum monthly output of 50,000 units, we cannot commit to an exclusive two-year contract.
options: Supposing
Unless
Provided
In case

explain.text:
正解：(B) Unless
• 考點：條件連接詞語意辨析。
• 解析：後半句為否定「我們無法承諾兩年獨家合約」，前半句條件為「除非（Unless）供應商能保證每月至少五萬件產量」。
• 誘答分析：(C) Provided（只要）、(D) In case（萬一）、(A) Supposing（假設）皆使前後邏輯矛盾。
• 單字補充：exclusive contract 獨家合約、minimum monthly output 每月最低產量。

questions.q: High-value machinery exported under temporary admission rules is ______ from import duties, provided it is re-exported within twelve months.
options: devoid
exempt
vacant
absent

explain.text:
正解：(B) exempt
• 考點：固定形容詞搭配（be exempt from）。
• 解析：暫准進口的高價值機械只要在 12 個月內復運出口，即可「免除」進口關稅，固定搭配 exempt from。
• 誘答分析：(D) absent 缺席的；(C) vacant 空缺的；(A) devoid 缺乏的（接 of）。
• 單字補充：temporary admission 暫准通關、re-export 復運出口。

questions.q: The operations director emphasized that ______ clear communication between brokers and carriers, bottlenecks at border checkpoints are inevitable.
options: lacking of
without
except
beside

explain.text:
正解：(B) without
• 考點：介系詞語意與文法辨析。
• 解析：語意為「若沒有報關行與承運人之間清楚的溝通，邊境瓶頸勢必難免」，選介系詞 without。
• 誘答分析：(D) beside 在旁邊；(C) except 除了；(A) lacking 若作介系詞不加 of。
• 單字補充：inevitable 不可避免的、checkpoint 檢查站。

questions.q: ______ of the three proposed rail routes through Central Asia offered both winter reliability and competitive per-ton freight rates.
options: None
Every
Either
Both

explain.text:
正解：(A) None
• 考點：不定代名詞數量辨析。
• 解析：後方明確寫出 the three proposed rail routes（三條路線），故表達全否定須用三者以上的 None（沒有一條）。
• 誘答分析：(C) Either 與 (D) Both 僅限兩者；(B) Every 不可單獨接 of。
• 單字補充：per-ton freight rate 每噸運費率。

questions.q: Rising marine fuel prices have compelled major ocean alliances to ______ emergency surcharges on all transpacific bookings starting next month.
options: impose
expose
dispose
compose

explain.text:
正解：(A) impose
• 考點：動詞搭配（impose surcharges）。
• 解析：燃料價格上漲迫使海運聯盟對跨太平洋訂艙「徵收/加收」緊急附加費，固定搭配為 impose surcharges。
• 誘答分析：(B) expose 暴露；(D) compose 組成；(C) dispose 處理（常接 of）。
• 單字補充：marine fuel 船用燃料油、ocean alliance 海運聯盟。

questions.q: The logistics software provides real-time visibility into inventory levels, ______ managers to rebalance stock before shortages arise.
options: enable
enabled
enabling
enables

explain.text:
正解：(C) enabling
• 考點：分詞構句（結果用法）。
• 解析：逗號前為完整句，逗號後用現在分詞 enabling 表「進而讓經理人能夠在缺貨前重新調配庫存」。
• 誘答分析：(A)、(D)、(B) 均不可無連接詞直接接於逗號後。
• 單字補充：real-time visibility 即時可視性、rebalance stock 重新平衡庫存。

questions.q: ______ carefully the packing list was prepared, a minor clerical error in the net weight column triggered a manual customs inspection.
options: Whenever
Whichever
Whatever
However

explain.text:
正解：(D) However
• 考點：讓步複合副詞（However + 副詞/形容詞）。
• 解析：空格後緊接副詞 carefully，表達「無論裝箱單準備得多麼仔細，淨重欄的一個小筆誤仍引發人工查驗」，選 However（= No matter how）。
• 誘答分析：(C) Whatever、(B) Whichever 後接名詞；(A) Whenever 語意不合。
• 單字補充：clerical error 文書筆誤、net weight 淨重。

questions.q: Prior to signing the vessel charter agreement, the legal team scrutinized every clause ______ port storage fee liabilities and unexpected delay exceptions.
options: pertain to
to pertain
pertained
pertaining to

explain.text:
正解：(D) pertaining to
• 考點：分詞片語後位修飾與片語動詞（pertain to）。
• 解析：every clause（每項條款）主動「涉及/關於」延滯費責任，故用主動分詞 pertaining to。
• 誘答分析：(C) pertain to 無被動；(A) 缺少關代；(B) 不定詞表目的不合語意。
• 單字補充：vessel charter agreement 租船契約、unexpected delay 突發延誤。

questions.q: Thanks to dual-sourcing strategies adopted last year, the automaker remained largely ______ to the recent electronics shipping disruptions.
options: redundant
reliant
reluctant
resilient

explain.text:
正解：(D) resilient
• 考點：形容詞字彙與介系詞搭配（resilient to）。
• 解析：受惠於去年採行的雙軌採購策略，該車廠對近期晶片海運中斷大致保持「具韌性的/不受衝擊的」（resilient to）。
• 誘答分析：(C) reluctant 不情願的；(A) redundant 多餘的；(B) reliant 依賴的（通常接 on 且語意相反）。
• 單字補充：dual-sourcing 雙重貨源採購、disruption 中斷。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: Prompt
Tentative
Late
Prior

explain.text:
正解：(C) Late
• 解析：前句規定必須在裝船前至少 24 小時傳送電子艙單，因此「逾期（Late）」提交的申報會在抵港時自動被標記扣留。
• 誘答分析：(A) Prompt 迅速的、(D) Prior 先前的、(B) Tentative 暫定的皆不合邏輯。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: The port authority has also announced plans to dredge the main shipping channel next spring.
Several ocean carriers have recently reduced their weekly sailings due to lower seasonal demand.
Importers must pay all outstanding terminal handling charges in cash before picking up freight.
This advance filing requirement is designed to strengthen border security and accelerate low-risk cargo release.

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：第一段末提到 24 小時預報規定，(D)「這項預報申報規定旨在強化邊境安全並加速低風險貨物放行」完美承接上文並說明立法目的。
• 誘答分析：(A) 疏浚航道、(B) 減少航班、(C) 現金支付碼頭費皆偏離主題。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).
options: transmission
translation
transition
transaction

explain.text:
正解：(C) transition
• 解析：舊版 EDI 系統將並行運作至 11 月 15 日，以利順利「過渡/轉換（transition）」。
• 誘答分析：(D) transaction 交易、(A) transmission 傳輸、(B) translation 翻譯均誤。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).
options: arise
rise
raise
arouse

explain.text:
正解：(A) arise
• 解析：Should technical difficulties ______ 表「萬一發生技術困難」，不及物動詞「出現、發生（問題/困難）」固定用 arise。
• 誘答分析：(C) raise 及物動詞（舉起/提出）；(D) arouse 喚起；(B) rise 上升。
• 單字補充：cutover period 系統切換期、flag for hold 標記扣留。

Questions 135–138（歐洲鐵路走廊應變計畫電郵）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).
options: urgent
fragile
perishable
bulky

explain.text:
正解：(D) bulky
• 解析：While 帶出對比：高毛利醫療器材已取得優先艙位，而「體積龐大笨重的（bulky）」工業緊固件則面臨高達十天的延誤（後段也提到非緊急補貨改走海運）。
• 誘答分析：(A) urgent（與後段 non-urgent 衝突）、(B) fragile、D perishable 皆不適合工業緊固件。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: The Munich facility recently won an award for achieving zero workplace accidents in 2025.
To prevent assembly-line stoppages, we are activating our secondary multimodal routing protocol.
Our procurement budget for the upcoming fiscal year is currently under review by finance.
Consequently, EuroRail Freight has decided to suspend all passenger services along the corridor.

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：前段講鐵路延誤十天，下句馬上說明從週一起非緊急補貨改由鹿特丹經短程海運至漢堡再轉卡車，故 (B)「為避免產線停擺，我們正啟動備援複合運輸方案」承先啟後。
• 誘答分析：(D) 停駛客運、(A) 零工傷獎項、(C) 採購預算審核皆離題。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).
options: guaranteeing
has guaranteed
guarantees
guaranteed

explain.text:
正解：(C) guarantees
• 解析：Although 子句用現在式 adds，主要子句描述該方案目前的常態效益，用現在簡單式 guarantees（確保可預測的交期）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 過去式、(A) 分詞缺主要動詞、(B) 現在完成式均不合。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).
options: Nevertheless
For instance
Otherwise
Meanwhile

explain.text:
正解：(D) Meanwhile
• 解析：前句請大家週五前更新 ERP 預測，本句要求「同時（Meanwhile）」直接與客戶經理協調通知最新抵達時段。
• 誘答分析：(C) Otherwise 否則；(A) Nevertheless 然而；(B) For instance 例如。
• 單字補充：multimodal 複合運輸的、replenishment 補貨、short-sea feeder 短程接駁船。

Questions 139–142（信用狀卸貨港瑕疵修改函）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (139).
options: redundancy
proficiency
inconsistency
sufficiency

explain.text:
正解：(C) inconsistency
• 解析：下段指出信用狀寫洛杉磯港，但船期只停長堤港，兩者存在「不一致/瑕疵（inconsistency）」。
• 誘答分析：(B) proficiency 熟練、(A) redundancy 冗餘、(D) sufficiency 充足皆誤。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).
options: Our company has been operating container vessels across the Pacific for over thirty years.
Resolving this discrepancy prior to shipment is essential to avoid payment delays.
Marine insurance premiums have remained stable despite recent weather events.
Both ports offer extensive rail connections to distribution hubs in the Midwest.

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：前句指出卸貨港不同，後句警告銀行會認定單證不符而拒付，(B)「在裝船前解決這項不符點對於避免付款延誤至關重要」正好銜接兩句。
• 誘答分析：(D) 鐵路聯通、(A) 營運三十年、(C) 保費穩定皆無關緊要。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (141).
options: issue
issues
issuing
issued

explain.text:
正解：(A) issue
• 解析：instruct your issuing bank to ______ an amendment，不定詞 to 後接原形動詞 issue（簽發/開立修改書）。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(C)、(D) 詞形不符。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (142).
options: modification
termination
compensation
negotiation

explain.text:
正解：(A) modification
• 解析：指代前句的 amendment（修改書），同義替換為 modification（修改）。
• 誘答分析：(D) negotiation 押匯/談判、(B) termination 終止、(C) compensation 賠償均誤。
• 單字補充：negotiating bank 押匯銀行、container stuffing 裝櫃。

Questions 143–146（冷藏貨櫃出車前檢查標準備忘錄）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (143).
options: worn
wearing
wears
wear

explain.text:
正解：(A) worn
• 解析：與 uncalibrated（未校準的）並列修飾 door seals（門封條），須用過去分詞當形容詞 worn（磨損的）。
• 誘答分析：(B)、(D)、(C) 無法作為「磨損的」前位形容詞。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (144).
options: Singapore remains our fastest-growing market for organic produce in Southeast Asia.
Consequently, several new verification steps have been added to the mandatory loading checklist.
Refrigerated containers typically consume more electricity than standard dry vans.
Technicians will receive an annual bonus if zero equipment failures occur this year.

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：第一段說明莓果腐敗原因，第二段隨即列出兩項新增的技術人員檢查步驟，故 (B)「因此，強制裝載檢查表已新增數項驗證步驟」為最佳轉折句。
• 誘答分析：(A) 新加坡市場成長、(C) 冷藏貨櫃較耗電、(D) 年終獎金皆偏離主題。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (145).
options: Conversely
Therefore
In contrast
Furthermore

explain.text:
正解：(D) Furthermore
• 解析：前句為第一項新增檢查（雲端溫度同步），本句為第二項新增檢查（門墊片漏光測試），用遞進副詞 Furthermore（此外）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 相反地、(B) 因此、(A) 反之皆不合邏輯。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (146).
options: optional
mandatory
temporary
arbitrary

explain.text:
正解：(B) mandatory
• 解析：主旨與語氣皆強調更嚴格的標準，故遵守規定是「強制性的（mandatory）」。
• 誘答分析：(A) optional 選填的、(C) temporary 暫時的、(D) arbitrary 任意的均誤。
• 單字補充：pre-trip inspection (PTI) 出車/裝櫃前檢查、gasket 墊片/密封圈。

questions.q: What will be suspended during the maintenance window on March 22?
options: Electronic entry lanes and train-loading facilities
Online Terminal Portal access
Vessel berthing at Berths 4A and 4B
Crane unloading operations using backup generators

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：原文 all automated container gates and rail-ramp operations will be completely suspended 同義改寫為 (A)「電子進出口車道與鐵路裝卸設施」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D) 泊位 4A、4B 的靠泊與備用發電機卸貨照常進行；(B) 入口網站仍可使用。

questions.q: What are local trucking carriers instructed to do if they have morning appointments on March 22?
options: Change their collection times online before Friday evening
Pay an extended port storage fee
Arrive at Berth 4A before 02:00
Reschedule their appointments after 10:00 on March 22

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：原文 reschedule their pickups via the Terminal Portal no later than Friday, March 20, at 17:00 同義改寫為 (A)「在週五傍晚前線上更改取貨時段」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 免費期自動順延不罰款；(C)(D) 皆與公告截止時間不符。

Q149–Q150（Apex 報關合規顧問廣告）

questions.q: What service is offered free of charge to new annual retainer clients before June 30?
options: Bonded warehouse licensing
A free examination of prior duty charges
A 90-day customs broker consultation
Carbon border reporting setup

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：原文 complimentary 90-day historical tariff audit 同義改寫為 (B)「免費檢視過去的關稅支付紀錄」。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D) 為一般服務項目；(C) 90 天是「回溯稽核期間」而非諮詢天數。

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as an area handled by Apex?
options: HS code classification audits
Duty drawback claims
Bonded warehouse licensing
Post-Brexit warehouse construction

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：廣告提及 HS 編碼稽核、退稅申請與保稅倉庫執照，未提及 (D)「脫歐後倉庫建設」。

Q151–Q153（即時通訊對話：休士頓港貨櫃查驗）

questions.q: Why is Liam concerned about the container from Ningbo?
options: A manufacturing site has minimal parts remaining.
The assembly line must pay overtime on Monday.
The VACIS X-ray exam will take longer than 48 hours.
Lone Star Trucking declined the Saturday delivery.

explain.text:
正解：(A)
• 解析：Liam 提到奧斯汀產線僅剩兩天安全庫存，同義改寫為 (A)「製造據點零件所剩無幾」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆引用 48 hours、Lone Star Trucking、overtime 扭曲時間與事實。

questions.q: At 09:20 A.M., what does Sarah mean when she writes, "They shouldn't need to empty the container"?
options: The truck driver does not need to wait at the Port of Houston.
Lone Star Trucking will charge the standard weekday rate.
The Austin factory will receive the motor housings before noon.
Inspectors will likely leave the goods inside.

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：They shouldn't need to empty the container 指 X 光掃描無異狀就不必拆櫃，同義改寫為 (D)「查驗人員可能不會把貨物卸出」。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(B) 皆引用 Port of Houston、before noon、weekday rate 誤解句意。

questions.q: What will Sarah do next?
options: Ask the customs broker to speed up the X-ray exam
Check pricing with a freight hauler for Saturday
Drive to the Port of Houston to observe the scan
Authorize Monday overtime for the Austin assembly line

explain.text:
正解：(B)
• 解析：Sarah 說要打給 Lone Star Trucking 確認週末費率，同義改寫為 (B)「向貨運業者查詢週六配送價格」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(D) 皆未在對話中安排。

Q154–Q156（Baltic Freight 燃油附加費調整通知）

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the email?
options: To announce the cancellation of a Baltic Sea route
To announce a new ferry service starting on June 1
To request renewal of Agreement #BF-2026-04
To inform a customer of an upcoming energy-fee change

explain.text:
正解：(D)
• 解析：主旨為通知 updated Fuel Adjustment Factor (FAF)，同義改寫為 (D)「通知客戶即將調整能源相關運費」。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(C) 引用 June 1、Agreement #BF-2026-04 錯置日期或目的。

questions.q: How can NordicTech qualify for the 14.5% FAF rate on a June sailing?
options: By booking exclusively out of Immingham
By shipping exclusively within the past 60 days
By having goods enter the port before June begins

Q157–Q159（文章：全球供應鏈「中國加一」策略）

Eliminating all Tier-1 suppliers in East Asia
Identifying indirect upstream material providers
Relying exclusively on feeder ships through Busan

• 誘答分析：(B)(C) 皆利用 guidance（財測指引）與 guide（導遊／引導）製造同根／諧音陷阱。
• 單字補充：revised guidance（修正後財測指引）、after-hours trading（盤後交易）。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
options: Response (A)
Response (B)
Response (C)
questions.say:
M: Can you verify whether the holding account deposit has cleared?
W: A. Let me check the settlement log in my inbox. B. It's a clear glass partition between the desks. C. Yes, I'm holding the meeting in Room B.

explain.text:
聽力稿：
Can you verify whether the holding account deposit has cleared?
(A) Let me check the settlement log in my inbox.
(B) It's a clear glass partition between the desks.
(C) Yes, I'm holding the meeting in Room B.

• 考點：Can you...? 請求句＋間接承諾（先查紀錄）。
• 解析：問能否確認資金保管帳戶的訂金是否已入帳，(A)「讓我查一下收件匣裡的結算紀錄」。
• 誘答分析：(C) holding（保管帳戶）重複字誤導為舉辦會議；(B) clear（結算入帳）誤導為透明玻璃隔板。
• 單字補充：holding account（資金保管帳戶）、settlement log（結算紀錄）。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
options: Response (A)
Response (B)
Response (C)
questions.say:
W: We're still waiting on the signed letter of intent from the target company's CEO.
M: A. The CEO spoke at an industry forum last week. B. Yes, I intend to attend the M&A workshop. C. I heard his legal counsel is reviewing the final paragraph right now.

explain.text:
聽力稿：
We're still waiting on the signed letter of intent from the target company's CEO.
(A) The CEO spoke at an industry forum last week.
(B) Yes, I intend to attend the M&A workshop.
(C) I heard his legal counsel is reviewing the final paragraph right now.

• 考點：陳述句應答（對進度的間接說明）。
• 解析：陳述「我們還在等目標公司執行長簽署的意向書」，(C)「我聽說他的法務顧問現在正在審閱最後一段」提供最新進度。
• 誘答分析：(A) 重複 CEO，卻談他上週的演講，答非所問；(B) intent（意向書）與 intend（打算）近音陷阱。
• 單字補充：letter of intent（意向書，LOI）、legal counsel（法務顧問）。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
options: Response (A)
Response (B)
Response (C)
questions.say:
M: What caused the discrepancy between the general ledger and the bank statement?
W: A. The bank is open until 4:30 P.M. on Fridays. B. A check issued on the 30th hasn't been cashed yet. C. Generally speaking, it was a very profitable year.

explain.text:
聽力稿：
What caused the discrepancy between the general ledger and the bank statement?
(A) The bank is open until 4:30 P.M. on Fridays.
(B) A check issued on the 30th hasn't been cashed yet.
(C) Generally speaking, it was a very profitable year.

• 考點：What 原因問句。
• 解析：問總帳與銀行對帳單出現差異的原因，(B)「30 號開出的一張支票還沒兌現（在途支票）」是會計銀行調節表最常見原因。
• 誘答分析：(A) 重複字 bank 卻回答營業時間；(C) general ledger 聯想 generally speaking 近音陷阱。
• 單字補充：discrepancy（差異）、general ledger（總分類帳）、bank statement（銀行對帳單）。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
options: Response (A)
Response (B)
Response (C)
questions.say:
W: Wouldn't it be safer to require dual signatures on all disbursements over $10,000?
M: A. We already implemented that control last quarter. B. I signed the lease agreement on Monday morning. C. No, the safe is located behind the vault door.

explain.text:
聽力稿：
Wouldn't it be safer to require dual signatures on all disbursements over $10,000?
(A) We already implemented that control last quarter.
(B) I signed the lease agreement on Monday morning.
(C) No, the safe is located behind the vault door.

• 考點：否定疑問提議句＋間接回應（已實施）。
• 解析：提議「對超過一萬美元的撥款要求雙重簽章會不會更安全？」，(A)「我們上一季就已經實施這項內控了」說明早已執行。
• 誘答分析：(C) safer 誤導為 safe（保險箱）同字雙關陷阱；(B) signatures / signed 同根詞陷阱。
• 單字補充：disbursement（款項撥付）、dual signatures（雙重簽核）、control（內部控制）。

questions.q: What problem does the man mention about the quarterly audit?
options: The Swiss office submitted its September revenue figures in the wrong currency.
The consolidation deadline was moved up to September 30.
An automated system was unable to match several overseas accounting entries.
The woman forgot to include the European numbers in the cutoff report.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士提到外部對帳軟體標記了多筆來自瑞士子公司的未過帳分錄（The external reconciliation software flagged several unposted entries from our Swiss entity），(C)「自動化系統無法核對數筆海外會計分錄」為精準同義改寫（external reconciliation software → automated system；unposted entries from Swiss entity → unable to match overseas accounting entries）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 September revenue figures，但未提幣別錯誤；(D) 出現原文 European numbers、cutoff report，但遺漏主因並非女士忘記；(B) 混淆為截至日提前至 September 30。

questions.q: Why does the woman say, "The Zurich subsidiary operates on a different fiscal calendar"?
options: To suggest postponing the European division's audit until October 15
To clarify why some regional financial data appears missing
To criticize the accounting software for flagging unposted entries
To remind the man to update the preliminary draft before calling Zurich

explain.text:
• 考點：意圖題（功能句推論＋同義替換）。
• 解析：女士說蘇黎世子公司採用不同的會計年度行事曆（第三季 10 月 15 日才關帳），目的是解釋為何部分地區的財務數據看起來不完整，對應 (B)「釐清為何部分地區的財務數據看似缺漏」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 European division 與 October 15，但未提議延後稽核；(C) 出現原文 accounting software、unposted entries，但女士已澄清不是軟體錯誤；(D) 出現原文 preliminary draft 與 Zurich，屬於時間與動作錯置。

questions.q: What will the speakers most likely do next?
options: Wait until October 15 to close the Q3 consolidation
Reach out to a regional finance manager by phone
Re-run the external reconciliation software for September
Submit the interim cutoff report as a preliminary draft

explain.text:
• 考點：下一步行動題（同義替換）。
• 解析：對話結尾女士提議立刻致電蘇黎世財務長確認期中結帳數字（call the Zurich controller right now），(B)「以電話聯繫地區財務主管」為上位概念同義替換（Zurich controller → regional finance manager）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 external reconciliation software 與 September，但對話未說要重跑；(D) 出現原文 cutoff report、preliminary draft，但女士明確說先確認再撰寫；(A) 過度推論要等到 10 月 15 日才關帳。

questions.q: Where do the speakers most likely work?
options: At a public utility company
At a Bloomberg financial news desk
At a corporate bond rating agency
At an asset management advisory

explain.text:
• 考點：場景推論題。
• 解析：兩人討論為 Henderson 捐贈基金進行資產配置（債券部位、公用事業股）及準備季報簡報，顯示兩人任職於 (D)「資產管理顧問公司」（原文 investment management firm 的同義替換）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 corporate bond，但兩人並非評等機構；(B) 出現原文 Bloomberg，但只是用來匯出數據；(A) 出現原文 utility，但公用事業只是投資標的。

questions.q: What does the man recommend regarding the client's portfolio?
options: Eliminating inflation-sensitive stocks from the endowment's holdings
Moving a portion of capital into income-generating energy and water equities
Selling all fixed-income assets before the quarterly board meeting
Increasing the 60 percent allocation to long-duration corporate bonds

explain.text:
• 考點：建議細節題（上位概念＋同義替換）。
• 解析：男士建議縮減長天期債券部位，將約 15% 資金轉入配息的公用事業股（dividend-paying utility stocks），(B)「將部分資金轉入能產生收益的能源與水電類股」精準改寫（dividend-paying → income-generating；utility stocks → energy and water equities）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 60 percent 與 long-duration corporate bonds，但男士建議「縮減」而非「增加」；(C) 過度推論要賣光所有固定收益資產；(A) 與原意相反，男士認為公用事業股具抗通膨效果。

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to send her?
options: A briefing packet for the Henderson Endowment board
An updated 10-year inflation forecast from Bloomberg
A summary of the client's current corporate bond benchmark
Historical price-fluctuation data comparing two asset classes

explain.text:
• 考點：請求細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士請男士寄一份「歷史波動率報告」（historical volatility report），比較公用事業股與現有債券基準的差異，(D)「比較兩類資產的歷史價格波動數據」為同義改寫（volatility → price-fluctuation）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 briefing packet、Henderson Endowment，但簡報包是女士要準備的；(B) 出現原文 10-year、Bloomberg、inflation，但匯出的是波動率數據而非通膨預測；(C) 出現原文 bond benchmark，但非單純摘要。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the meeting?
options: To allocate pre-acquisition review responsibilities among team members
To persuade partner banks to approve new debt terms
To finalize the formal bid price for Solaris Logistics
To restate Solaris's historical EBITDA adjustments

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（三人對話＋同義替換）。
• 解析：M1 開場說明客戶準備正式競標 Solaris Logistics，今天要分工盡職調查工作項目（divide up the due diligence workstreams），對應 (A)「在團隊成員間分配收購前審查職責」。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 formal bid、Solaris Logistics，但尚未到定案出價階段；(B) 出現原文 partner banks、debt terms，但那是後續 M2 要做的；(D) 出現原文 historical EBITDA adjustments，為細節誤導。

questions.q: What concern does the third speaker raise about the target company?
options: Its new accounting rules will reduce its warehouse fleet size.
Its unrecorded facility rental commitments are unusually large.
Its working capital trends have deteriorated over the past year.
Its partner banks rejected the proposed leverage profile.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（三人對話＋同義替換）。
• 解析：M2（Victor）指出在附註中發現對方倉庫車隊的「資產負債表外租賃義務」（off-balance-sheet lease obligations）異常高，(B)「未入帳的設施租賃承諾異常龐大」為精準同義替換（off-balance-sheet → unrecorded；lease obligations → facility rental commitments）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 working capital trends，但那是 Claire 負責審查的項目；(A) 出現原文 new accounting rules、warehouse fleet，過度推論會縮減車隊；(D) 出現原文 partner banks、leverage profile，但尚未接洽銀行。

questions.q: What does the woman agree to deliver by Thursday?
options: A footnote summary of Solaris's warehouse fleet contracts
A revised list of historical EBITDA adjustments
A final debt-term comparison from the partner banks
An updated corporate valuation projection incorporating lease liabilities

explain.text:
• 考點：承諾細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：Claire 承諾週四下午前把租賃負債納入修訂後的現金流折現估值模型（revised discounted cash flow valuation model），對應 (D)「納入租賃負債的更新版企業估值預測」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 footnotes、warehouse fleet，但非週四交付物；(C) 出現原文 debt terms、partner banks，為角色錯置（M2 負責）；(B) 出現原文 historical EBITDA adjustments，非週四產出。

questions.q: Why is the man calling the bank's corporate desk?
options: To confirm that the bank received his commercial invoice and packing list
To request a freight forwarder recommendation from the treasury team
To check on the payout progress of a cross-border trade finance instrument
To apply for a higher credit limit for Pacific Rim Imports

explain.text:
• 考點：目的題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士來電查詢上週開立的國際信用狀（international letter of credit）結算進度，(C)「確認一項跨境貿易融資工具的付款進度」為同義改寫（international letter of credit → cross-border trade finance instrument；settlement status → payout progress）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 credit limit，但限額已核准，非申請調高；(A) 出現原文 commercial invoice、packing list，但男士已知已寄出；(B) 出現原文 freight forwarder、treasury team，但非尋求推薦。

questions.q: What documentation does the woman say is required?
options: A revised application for reference LC-8842
A credit-limit approval letter from the trade finance team
Carrier-certified proof that the merchandise was loaded aboard a ship
A signed packing list from Pacific Rim Imports

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士表示貿易融資團隊需要貨運承攬商蓋章的裝船表格（stamped shipping form from the freight carrier），確認貨物已裝上船隻，(C)「由承運商認證、證明貨物已裝船的文件」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 application、LC-8842，但申請書已存在；(D) 出現原文 packing list，但該文件已收到；(B) 出現原文 credit limit、trade finance team，為概念錯置。

questions.q: What does the woman mean when she says, "Our compliance queue is backed up until Friday"?
options: The freight forwarder missed the Friday afternoon cutoff.
Additional compliance fees will apply after Friday.
The man's request cannot be finalized right away.
The man uploaded his documents to the wrong portal.

explain.text:
• 考點：意圖題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士說「我們的法遵審核佇列已積壓到週五」，意即無法當天立刻處理放款，對應 (C)「她無法立即完成男士的請求」。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 upload，過度推論系統錯誤；(A) 出現原文 freight forwarder、Friday afternoon，但貨運商已寄出文件；(B) 過度推論週五會加收費用。

questions.q: What are the speakers discussing?
options: A jump in commercial loan defaults during the second quarter
A decline in promotional CD deposits compared to Q1
A plan to launch a digital-only high-yield savings product
A narrowing of the bank's lending-versus-deposit profit spread

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：兩人討論第二季淨利差（net interest margin）較第一季下滑 22 個基點，(D)「銀行放款與存款利差獲利空間的縮窄」為精準同義改寫（net interest margin dropped → narrowing of lending-versus-deposit profit spread）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 loan defaults、Q2，但男士明確否定是違約造成；(C) 出現原文 digital-only、high-yield savings，那是競爭對手的產品；(B) 出現原文 promotional CD、Q1，敘述相反。

questions.q: According to the man, what caused the recent shift?
options: Rival internet banks offering more attractive yields to savers
A sudden drop in the bank's credit quality across Q2 loans
Customers withdrawing funds from top five online banks
Rapidly falling interest rates on the bank's loan portfolio

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士指出主因是網路競爭對手調高存款利率至 4.8%，迫使自家銀行跟進調高定存利率，(A)「競爭網路銀行提供存戶更具吸引力的利率」為同義改寫（online competitors → rival internet banks；higher deposit rates → more attractive yields）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 credit quality、Q2，與對話內容相反；(D) 出現原文 loan yields，對話說的是資金成本上升快於放款利率重定價；(C) 誤解資金是流向對手而非從對手流出。

questions.q: What will the woman prepare for tomorrow's briefing?
options: A report on afternoon deposit outflows
A side-by-side rate chart benchmarking against competing institutions
A proposal to lower promotional CD rates to 4.8 percent
A Q2 earnings variance summary for the top five online banks

explain.text:
• 考點：任務細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士請女士為明天簡報製作「競爭對手定價比較表」（competitor pricing comparison table），對比前五大網銀與自家存款利率，(B)「與競爭機構進行基準對比的並列利率圖表」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 Q2 earnings variance、top five online banks，將不同概念混在一起；(C) 出現原文 promotional CD rates、4.8 percent，但 4.8% 是網銀活存利率；(A) 出現原文 afternoon、deposit outflows，非簡報內容。

questions.q: What is the relationship among the speakers?
options: They are treasury desk specialists processing SWIFT and ACH transfers.
They are facilities maintenance supervisors reviewing Q2 budgets.
They are internal investigators examining suspected payment irregularities.
They are external vendors disputing duplicate billing records.

explain.text:
• 考點：人物關係題（三人對話＋同義替換）。
• 解析：自動防詐欺引擎觸發警報，三人集結調查應付帳款模組的異常請款模式，顯示他們是 (C)「調查疑似付款異常的內部稽核／調查人員」（原文 forensic accountants investigating an internal fraud alert 的同義改寫）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 facilities maintenance、Q2，但那是涉案成本中心；(A) 出現原文 treasury desk、SWIFT、ACH，但 M2 只是向資金部調閱收據；(D) 出現原文 vendor、duplicate，但他們不是外部廠商。

questions.q: What anomaly did the woman discover in the vendor ledger?
options: Fourteen payments exceeding the $10,000 secondary review threshold
Invoices missing routing and account numbers for facilities maintenance
Repeated charges submitted through minor variations in supplier codes
Automated fraud alerts disabled in the Accounts Payable module

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士在供應商分類帳發現 14 筆重複發票，皆以微調過的供應商編號（如加連字號或補零）請款，對應 (C)「透過微幅變動的供應商代碼重複請款」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 14、$10,000 secondary review threshold，但對話說「低於」一萬美元而非超過；(D) 出現原文 automated fraud alerts、Accounts Payable module，並非系統被關閉；(B) 出現原文 routing and account numbers、facilities maintenance，概念錯置。

questions.q: What does the third speaker instruct the team to do first?
options: Obtain source bank transfer records to verify payment destinations
Escalate the $96,000 discrepancy to the external auditors
Lock the suspect user profiles in the Accounts Payable module
Interview the facilities maintenance supervisor on short notice

explain.text:
• 考點：順序細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：M1 指示在約談任何人或鎖定帳號前，先調出原始銀行轉帳確認單（original bank transfer confirmations）追蹤帳號，(A)「取得原始銀行轉帳紀錄以核實款項去向」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 lock any user profiles、Accounts Payable module，但 M1 明言「先不要」鎖定；(D) 出現原文 interview、facilities maintenance，同樣是被延後的動作；(B) 出現原文 $96,000，未提呈報外部稽核。

questions.q: What does the man want to know about the IPO roadshow?
options: Why Tuesday's luncheon was limited to 18 mutual funds
When the Boston leg of the roadshow will officially begin
Whether NovaMed Systems agreed to the $22 to $25 price range
Whether major buyers have finalized their participation for a specific city stop

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士一開場就問波士頓站的機構投資人是否都已確認出席（confirmed their attendance for the Boston leg），(D)「大型買方是否已確定參與特定城市場次」為同義改寫（institutional investors → major buyers；Boston leg → specific city stop）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 Tuesday's luncheon、18 mutual funds，對話未問原因；(B) 出現原文 Boston leg，男士已知在 48 小時內出發；(C) 出現原文 NovaMed Systems、$22 to $25，非男士提問內容。

questions.q: What does the woman say about the sovereign wealth fund?
options: It asked to lower the share price below the $22 range.
Its chief investment officer will host Tuesday's Boston luncheon.
It intends to serve as a cornerstone investor with a substantial order.
It is still deciding whether to participate in the bookbuilding process.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士表示主權財富基金計畫以 7,500 萬美元的認購承諾作為此次發行的基石（anchor the offering with a $75 million commitment），(C)「打算以大額認購擔任基石投資人」為精準同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 chief investment officer、Tuesday's Boston luncheon，人物與事件錯置；(A) 出現原文 $22，但條件是在 22–25 美元區間內而非壓低；(D) 出現原文 bookbuilding process，對方已經明確表達認購意向。

questions.q: What will the man do before 3:00 P.M.?
options: Contact the two pension boards to verify their $75 million commitment
Send the offering price range to the sovereign wealth fund
Confirm flight reservations for the Boston roadshow team
Revise the pitch materials with fresh peer-company valuation figures

explain.text:
• 考點：行動細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士表示會在下午三點前用最新同業估值倍數更新投資人簡報（update the investor presentation slide deck with the latest comparable-company multiples），(D)「以最新同業估值數據修訂簡報資料」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 flight、Boston，但未提要訂機票；(A) 出現原文 two pension boards、$75 million，金額錯置（7,500 萬是主權基金）；(B) 出現原文 sovereign wealth fund，動作無中生有。

questions.q: What issue does the woman report regarding the client's estate trust?
options: The custodian's ledger miscalculated a $42,000 capital gain.
An automated reinvestment feature bought back shares shortly after a loss sale.
The trust missed the November 4 deadline for year-end tax harvesting.
Vanguard Industrial Corp. suspended its dividend-reinvestment program.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士發現信託在 11 月 4 日認賠賣出股票後，股利自動再投資計畫（DRIP）於 11 月 18 日自動買回 120 股同支股票，(B)「自動再投資機制在認賠賣出後不久又買回股份」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 custodian's ledger、$42,000，4.2 萬是虧損而非獲利；(C) 出現原文 November 4、year-end tax harvesting，未提錯過截止日；(D) 出現原文 Vanguard Industrial Corp.、dividend-reinvestment program，並未暫停該計畫。

questions.q: Why does the man say, "That's a classic wash-sale trap"?
options: To explain why the IRS requires trusts to hold stocks for 30 days
To criticize the custodian for buying 5,000 shares on November 18
To note that a rapid repurchase invalidates the claimed tax deduction
To suggest waiting until December to sell the remaining 120 shares

explain.text:
• 考點：意圖題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士提到「30 天內買回同一檔股票，國稅局會否准該部分稅務虧損抵減」，(C)「指出短期內買回會使申報的稅務抵減失效」為精準同義改寫（within 30 days → rapid repurchase；disallows tax loss → invalidates claimed tax deduction）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 5,000 shares、November 18，數量與日期錯置（18 號買的是 120 股）；(A) 出現原文 IRS、30 days，曲解稅法規定；(D) 出現原文 December、120 shares，建議錯置。

questions.q: What does the woman suggest doing to resolve the situation?
options: Waiting until January to turn off the automatic reinvestment setting
Reinvesting future dividends into a different individual industrial stock
Asking the IRS for a 30-day exemption on the November 18 trade
Exiting the position and reallocating into a broader industry fund

explain.text:
• 考點：建議題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士建議賣掉整個部位並以廣泛的工業類股 ETF 實質替代（sell the entire position... replace with a broad industrial sector ETF），(D)「出清該持股並轉進更廣泛的產業型基金」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 IRS、30-day、November 18，對話未提申請豁免；(B) 出現原文 industrial stock，應改為 ETF 而非個股；(A) 過度推論等到一月才關閉再投資。

questions.q:
Look at the graphic. Which acquisition target is the woman most concerned about?

Target Company | EV / EBITDA Multiple | Debt-to-Equity Ratio | Projected 3-Year Synergy
Apex Logistics | 9.4x | 1.85 | $14.2M
Boreal Tech | 14.8x | 0.42 | $22.5M
Crestline Packaging | 7.9x | 2.60 | $9.8M
Delta Biopharma | 12.1x | 0.95 | $18.0M
options: Crestline Packaging
Boreal Tech
Apex Logistics
Delta Biopharma

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽線索＋看表格）。
• 解析：對話中女士刻意不唸出公司名稱，而是說「我最擔心倍數最低（lowest multiple）的那家，因為它的負債權益比超過 2.5（over 2.5）」。對照圖表，EV/EBITDA 倍數最低（7.9x）且負債權益比達 2.60（超過 2.5）的標的為 (A) Crestline Packaging。
• 誘答分析：(C) Apex Logistics（1.85）與 (D) Delta Biopharma（$18M synergy）皆在對話中被男士提及作為干擾；(B) Boreal Tech 為倍數最高（14.8x）的對比項。

questions.q: Why does the woman express concern about that company?
options: Its 14.8x valuation multiple is too expensive for the steering committee.
Its management refused to agree to a cash-free transaction.
Its heavy borrowing burden could squeeze liquidity after the merger.
Its projected 3-year synergies are lower than Boreal Tech's.

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表延伸細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士補充指出承受過高槓桿若遇高利率將嚴重壓縮併購後現金流（strain our post-merger cash flow），(C)「沉重的舉債負擔可能在合併後擠壓流動資金」為同義改寫（leverage → borrowing burden；strain cash flow → squeeze liquidity）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 14.8x、steering committee，但 14.8x 是 Boreal Tech 的倍數；(D) 出現原文 projected 3-year synergies、Boreal Tech，非擔心主因；(B) 出現原文 cash-free，曲解談判條件。

questions.q: What does the man propose to address the concern?
options: Dropping the target from the M&A steering committee's shortlist
Using projected synergies to refinance the seller's debt
Offering a higher multiple if interest rates decline
Mandating that existing liabilities be paid off by the current owner at closing

explain.text:
• 考點：解決方案題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士提議在購買協議中要求賣方在交割前用現金價款清償現有債務（require the seller to retire existing debt prior to closing），(D)「規定原持有者在交割時須將現有負債結清」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 multiple、interest rates，未提提高倍數；(A) 出現原文 M&A steering committee、shortlist，過度推論剔除名單；(B) 出現原文 synergies，未提用綜效再融資。

questions.q: Why is the man visiting the bank's commercial lending office?
options: To ask Ms. Brooks to waive a 30 percent jump in supplier fees
To repay an existing $2.5 million spring inventory loan
To negotiate a lower interest rate on his current credit line
To seek short-term financing to support a seasonal stock buildup

explain.text:
• 考點：目的題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士來訪是為了申請 250 萬美元營運資金貸款額度，以支應春季季節性庫存擴張（finance your seasonal inventory expansion），(D)「尋求短期融資以支應季節性備貨需求」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 $2.5 million、spring，但非來償還舊債；(A) 出現原文 Ms. Brooks、30 percent、supplier，曲解 30% 的含義（是訂單成長而非費用）；(C) 出現原文 credit line，非協商降息。

questions.q: What does the woman say about the company's current ratio?
options: It sits just under the institution's required liquidity benchmark.
It dropped by 30 percent due to spring wholesale orders.
It is too low to qualify for any policy exception from the credit committee.
It improved from 1.12x to 1.25x over the past quarter.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士指出貴公司流動比率為 1.12x，略低於銀行最低核貸門檻 1.25x（falls slightly below our bank's minimum loan approval threshold），(A)「略低於本機構要求的流動性基準」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 30 percent、spring wholesale orders，兩者無關；(C) 出現原文 policy exception、credit committee，對話明確說「可能」有機會申請例外；(D) 出現原文 1.12x、1.25x，混淆為數值改善。

questions.q: What does the woman suggest the man provide?
options: Proof that spring wholesale orders have already been paid
A detailed breakdown showing how recently customer invoices were billed
A revised profitability forecast for the next 30 days
A written guarantee from the company's spring suppliers

explain.text:
• 考點：建議細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士建議男士提供更新版「應收帳款帳齡表」（updated aging schedule of accounts receivable），證明多數帳款逾期未超過 30 天，(B)「顯示客戶發票開立時間長短的詳細明細」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 spring wholesale orders，應收帳款尚未收現；(C) 出現原文 profitability、30 days，概念混用；(D) 出現原文 spring、suppliers，對象錯置（是客戶應收帳款而非供應商）。

questions.q:
Look at the graphic. Which audit finding requires immediate remediation?

Audit Control Area | Risk Rating | Target Completion | Assigned Lead
Access Controls (ERP) | Critical | May 15 | R. Patel
Revenue Recognition | High | May 30 | L. Chen
Inventory Valuation | Medium | June 12 | M. Gomez
Petty Cash Reconciliation | Low | June 30 | K. Brooks
options: Revenue Recognition
Petty Cash Reconciliation
Inventory Valuation
Access Controls (ERP)

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽線索＋看表格）。
• 解析：對話中刻意不唸出區域名稱，而是透過線索「R. Patel 負責的項目（assigned to R. Patel）」以及「唯一期限在 5 月 15 日（May 15 deadline）」來鎖定。對照表格，R. Patel 負責且目標完成日為 May 15 的項目是 (D) Access Controls (ERP)。
• 誘答分析：(A) L. Chen 負責的 May 30 項目與 (C)(B) M. Gomez、K. Brooks 負責的 6 月項目均在對話中被提及以製造干擾。

questions.q: According to the man, what specific flaw was uncovered in that area?
options: Departed staff members still possessed high-level system entry rights.
Dormant user accounts had not been reviewed in the past six years.
Eighteen current finance employees shared a single administrative password.
Deloitte auditors were unable to log in to the accounting module.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士說明稽核員發現過去六個月離職的 18 名「前員工」仍保有會計模組的管理員登入憑證（former employees... still retained administrative login credentials），(A)「已離職員工仍擁有高權限系統登入權」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 Deloitte、accounting module，未提稽核員無法登入；(C) 出現原文 18、finance，將離職員工誤植為現職人員共用密碼；(B) 出現原文 six，將「六個月」誤植為「六年」。

questions.q: What does the woman say R. Patel has already started doing?
options: Deactivating unused accounts and mandating multi-step login verification
Training former employees on updated finance department security rules
Preparing a May 15 progress report for the Deloitte audit team
Auditing all four open findings ahead of the June deadlines

explain.text:
• 考點：行動細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士表示 R. Patel 已經開始撤銷所有休眠帳號權限，並強制實施雙重驗證（revoking all dormant user privileges and enforcing mandatory two-factor authentication），(A)「停用閒置帳號並強制啟用多步驟登入驗證」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 May 15、Deloitte，未提撰寫進度報告；(B) 出現原文 former employees、finance department，動作荒謬；(D) 出現原文 four open findings、June，過早推論。

questions.q:
Look at the graphic. Which fund tier will the client most likely choose?

Fund Tier | Minimum Investment | Annual Management Fee | Performance Fee | Lock-Up Period
Class A (Institutional) | $5,000,000 | 0.85% | 10% over 6% hurdle | 24 months
Class B (Qualified) | $1,000,000 | 1.25% | 15% over 5% hurdle | 12 months
Class C (Advisory) | $250,000 | 1.65% | None | None
Class D (Liquidity) | $100,000 | 0.60% | 5% over 4% hurdle | 6 months
options: Class A (Institutional)
Class C (Advisory)
Class D (Liquidity)
Class B (Qualified)

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽線索＋看表格）。
• 解析：對話未直接唸出級別名稱，而是給出雙重條件：「不需要任何鎖定期（zero lock-up）」且「董事會禁止支付任何績效獎金（zero performance fee）」。對照圖表，同時滿足 Performance Fee 為 None 且 Lock-Up Period 為 None 的只有 (B) Class C (Advisory)（Class D 已調整為有 5% 績效費與 6 個月鎖定期）。
• 誘答分析：(D) Class B 在對話中被提及管理費較低；(A)(C) 皆不符合無鎖定期與無績效費之限制。

questions.q: What constraint does the man mention about the client?
options: Its Geneva board requires a 12-month lock-up on credit funds.
Its governing body forbids compensation tied to investment gains.
The client refuses to pay any annual management fee above 1.25 percent.
The family office is unable to meet a $1 million minimum investment.

explain.text:
• 考點：限制條件題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士提到客戶的投資委員會禁止支付任何績效激勵費用（investment board prohibits paying any performance-based incentive fees），(B)「其決策機構禁止給付與投資報酬掛鉤的酬勞」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 $1 million，但客戶有 300 萬資金，遠高於門檻；(A) 出現原文 Geneva、12-month lock-up，與原意完全相反；(C) 出現原文 annual management fee、1.25 percent，未設此限制。

questions.q: What will the woman send to the client this afternoon?
options: A fee comparison chart for all four share classes
A DocuSign link for the Absolute Return Credit Fund's annual report
Official offering documents and enrollment paperwork
A revised liquidity schedule for the Geneva board

explain.text:
• 考點：行動細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士答應下午寄出私募備忘錄與認購協議（private placement memorandum and subscription agreement），(C)「正式募集說明文件與申購合約」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 share classes，非寄送內容；(D) 出現原文 Geneva board、liquidity，過度推論；(B) 出現原文 DocuSign、Absolute Return Credit Fund，但寄送的是認購文件而非年報。

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: Evaluating an automated tool to improve money-laundering monitoring
Replacing the compliance team with a machine-learning system
Adjusting bi-weekly international payroll schedules for mid-sized clients
Investigating 4,200 suspicious wire transfers from last month

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：兩人討論目前反洗錢篩選系統誤報率過高，正在評估一個能過濾例行薪資模式的機器學習模組，(A)「評估一項改善洗錢防制監控的自動化工具」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 compliance team、machine-learning，過度推論要取代整個團隊；(D) 出現原文 4,200，其中 96% 為誤報而非真實洗錢；(C) 出現原文 bi-weekly international payroll、mid-sized clients，非討論調整發薪日。

questions.q: What problem does the woman point out about the current system?
options: It mistakes legitimate recurring salary payouts for illicit activity.
It delays international payroll batches until Tuesday morning.
It misses 96 percent of genuine money-laundering transactions.
It cannot process historical transaction data from last quarter.

explain.text:
• 考點：問題細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士指出現行規則引擎無法區分可疑拆單匯款與例行企業薪資，每次雙週發薪都會觸發人工審查（triggers a manual review），(A)「將合法的定期薪資發放誤判為異常交易」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 96 percent，是誤報率而非漏報率；(B) 出現原文 international payroll、Tuesday morning，週二早上是測試時間而非延遲發薪；(D) 出現原文 historical transaction data、last quarter，功能剛好相反。

questions.q: What do the speakers agree to do next week?
options: Ask mid-sized clients to test the new rule engine on Tuesday
Trial the proposed software on past transaction records
Clear last month's 4,200 manual alerts before running a pilot
Turn off the current anti-money laundering screening system

explain.text:
• 考點：共識行動題（同義替換）。
• 解析：兩人同意下週針對上一季歷史交易數據進行平行前導測試（parallel pilot test on last quarter's historical transaction data），(B)「以過往交易紀錄試運行擬議中的軟體」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 mid-sized clients、Tuesday，測試對象是歷史數據而非客戶；(C) 出現原文 4,200、manual alerts，未提先清空再測；(D) 出現原文 anti-money laundering screening system，過於極端。

questions.q: Who is the intended audience for this announcement?
options: Business account holders managing organizational cash flows
Treasury onboarding specialists at Apex Commercial Bank
Customers calling to cancel outgoing wire transfers
Individuals requesting printed monthly bank statements

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾對象推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：公告開頭為「Apex 商業銀行企業資金部支援專線」，內容涉及企業資金入口網、電匯核准與日常現金管理，顯示對象為 (A)「管理組織現金流的企業帳戶持有人」（原文 corporate treasury clients 的同義改寫）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 treasury onboarding specialist，但那是提供支援的銀行人員而非聽眾；(D) 出現原文 downloading bank statements，但未提申請紙本帳單；(C) 出現原文 approving wire transfers，與取消匯款無關。

questions.q: What change is taking effect on November 1?
options: View-only accounting profiles will no longer have portal access.
An extra verification step will be required to sign in to the platform.
Wire transfers will require a phone call to a treasury specialist.
Six-digit passcodes will replace all existing corporate passwords.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：11 月 1 日起全面強制啟用多重要素驗證（multi-factor authentication），登入前須輸入六位數一次性密碼，(B)「登入平台時將需要額外的驗證步驟」為同義改寫（multi-factor authentication → extra verification step；portal logins → sign in to the platform）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 view-only accounting profiles，但系統是「包含」唯讀帳號都須驗證而非取消權限；(C) 出現原文 wire transfers、treasury specialist，誤導須打電話核准匯款；(D) 出現原文 six-digit passcode，但那是一次性驗證碼而非取代密碼。

questions.q: What are listeners advised to do before October 25?
options: Download the bank's authenticator app before approving transfers
Press 2 to update their daily cash management preferences
Confirm their contact numbers on file within the web system
Enroll all view-only accounting staff in SMS alerts

explain.text:
• 考點：建議行動題（同義替換）。
• 解析：所有授權資金用戶受建議在 10 月 25 日前於線上入口網確認其登記的手機號碼（verify their registered mobile phone numbers in the online portal），(C)「在網頁系統內確認其登記的聯絡電話」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 authenticator app、approving transfers，但未要求 10 月 25 日前下載；(B) 出現原文 press 2、daily cash management，按 2 是轉接專員；(D) 出現原文 view-only accounting、SMS，對象錯置。

questions.q: What is the main topic of the briefing?
options: Quarterly performance of the company's currency risk-management strategy
North American operating margin forecasts for Q4
New target collar rates for euro-denominated receivables
Unexpected losses at the Frankfurt subsidiary

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者開場明確表示要檢視第三季外匯避險成果（third-quarter foreign exchange hedging results），(A)「公司貨幣風險管理策略的季度表現」為精準同義改寫（foreign exchange hedging → currency risk-management strategy）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 North American operating margins、Q4，將 Q3 已發生的保護誤導為 Q4 預測；(D) 出現原文 Frankfurt subsidiary，但該子公司其實帶來匯兌收益而非虧損；(C) 出現原文 target collar rates、euro-denominated receivables，屬於局部細節。

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "The euro's unexpected rally caught several desks off guard"?
options: To criticize regional treasurers for leaving 40 percent of receivables unhedged
To explain why unprotected European sales lifted overall corporate profit
To warn that North American margins fell by $11.4 million
To suggest abandoning forward contracts in favor of currency tailwinds

explain.text:
• 考點：意圖題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者解釋由於法蘭克福子公司有 40% 歐元應收帳款未避險，歐元意外走強換算成美元後反而使合併獲利增加 1,140 萬美元，(B)「說明為何未避險的歐洲銷售額推升了整體企業獲利」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 regional treasurers、40 percent of receivables unhedged，語氣並非批評；(C) 出現原文 North American margins、$11.4 million，將獲利增加曲解為利潤下降；(D) 出現原文 forward contracts、currency tailwinds，講者明確提醒「不應依賴」匯率順風。

questions.q: What will happen immediately following the briefing?
options: Finance leads will gather to plan next quarter's hedging positions.
The speaker will distribute a summary of Q3 North American margins.
Regional teams will lock in 80 percent protection for European receivables.
The Frankfurt desk will report its Q3 U.S. dollar translation results.

explain.text:
• 考點：下一步行動題（同義替換）。
• 解析：簡報結束後，區域資金主管將立刻在 B 會議室開會檢視第四季遠期合約配置並鎖定區間匯率，(A)「財務主管將集會規劃下一季的避險部位」為同義改寫（regional treasurers → finance leads；Q4 forward contract allocations → next quarter's hedging positions）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 Frankfurt、Q3、U.S. dollar，動作無中生有；(B) 出現原文 Q3、North American margins，非後續行程；(C) 出現原文 80 percent、European receivables，將北美比例錯植到歐洲。

questions.q: Why is David calling Ms. Lin?
options: To inform her that Concur rejected her credit card authorization
To reschedule Friday's committee review for the investment banking division
To ask why her team traveled to London during the third quarter
To obtain detailed documentation needed to complete an internal review

explain.text:
• 考點：目的題（同義替換）。
• 解析：David 因正在進行第三季差旅費用稽核，發現林小姐團隊倫敦行程缺少明細憑證而來電索取，(D)「取得完成內部審查所需的詳細證明文件」為同義改寫（supporting documents → detailed documentation；expense audit → internal review）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 London、third quarter，並非詢問出差原因；(A) 出現原文 Concur、credit card authorization，系統並未退件；(B) 出現原文 Friday's committee review、investment banking division，未提改期。

questions.q: What issue does David mention regarding the travel receipts?
options: Lodging records show lump-sum totals without per-night or dining details.
Room rates and meal charges were billed to the wrong corporate card.
Several London hotel folios were never uploaded to Concur.
Credit card authorizations exceeded the corporate audit limit.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：David 指出上傳至 Concur 的飯店發票僅顯示信用卡授權總額，缺乏每晚房價與餐飲費用的明細（lack itemized breakdowns of nightly room rates and meal charges），(A)「住宿紀錄僅顯示總額而無每日房費或餐飲明細」為精準同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 room rates、meal charges，未提刷錯卡；(C) 出現原文 London、hotel folios、Concur，發票已上傳只是缺明細；(D) 出現原文 credit card authorizations、corporate audit，未提超額。

questions.q: By when does David need the corrected files?
options: By midday the following day
Before the end of the third quarter
Immediately after Ms. Lin contacts the hotel
By the end of the week

explain.text:
• 考點：時間細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：David 請林小姐在「明天中午前」（by noon tomorrow）上傳修正後的檔案，(A)「隔天正午之前」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)「本週結束前」比原文要求的時間晚，David 要的是隔天中午；(B) 出現原文 third quarter，時間錯置；(C) 出現原文 contact the hotel，過於模糊且不符原意。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the training session?
options: To review qualitative audit findings from regional credit unions
To teach entry-level staff how to evaluate audit significance benchmarks
To compare pre-tax income across commercial banks and tech startups
To train junior associates on preparing client binder disclosures

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：這場針對新進稽核員的下午場工作坊主題是「重大性門檻」（materiality thresholds），教導如何在規劃階段判斷重大性基準，(B)「教導初階人員如何評估稽核重大性基準」為同義改寫（new audit associates → entry-level staff；materiality thresholds → audit significance benchmarks）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 pre-tax income、commercial banks、tech startups，這些只是舉例對比對象；(A) 出現原文 qualitative、regional credit unions，信用合作社是分組練習標的；(D) 出現原文 junior associates、binders、disclosures，概念拼湊。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what mistake do junior staff frequently make?
options: Ignoring total revenue and total assets when auditing mature banks
Applying a 5 percent pre-tax income rule only to high-growth startups
Using an identical percentage standard regardless of a client's sector
Relying solely on qualitative factors rather than quantitative benchmarks

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者指出初階人員常犯的錯誤是「對所有客戶產業套用單一的重大性百分比」（applying a uniform materiality percentage... across all client industries），(C)「不論客戶所屬產業別皆套用相同的百分比標準」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 total revenue、total assets、mature banks，但營收與資產適用於新創而非成熟銀行；(D) 出現原文 qualitative factors、quantitative benchmarks，講者說兩者同等重要；(B) 出現原文 5 percent pre-tax income、high-growth startups，講者說新創「不適用」稅前淨利 5%。

questions.q: What will participants do next?
options: Calculate pre-tax income for a high-growth tech startup
Review a completed audit of a mature commercial bank
Collaborate in small teams to analyze a practice audit file
Present qualitative factors from their training binders

explain.text:
• 考點：下一步行動題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者接著請學員四人一組（break into small groups of four），檢視講義夾中的範例稽核底稿（examine the sample audit workpaper），(C)「以小組合作方式分析一份範例稽核檔案」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 pre-tax income、high-growth tech startup，練習標的是信用合作社；(D) 出現原文 qualitative factors、binders，未提上台報告；(B) 出現原文 mature commercial bank，對象錯置。

questions.q: What corporate event is the speaker reporting on?
options: An unsolicited acquisition attempt involving two banking firms
A merger agreement between Continental Financial Group and Horizon
An investigation into Horizon's wealth advisory profit reporting
A 14 percent drop in Horizon Regional Bancorp's share price

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：新聞報導 Horizon 區域銀行正式拒絕 Continental 金融集團提出的 38 億美元非合意敵意收購要約（unsolicited $3.8 billion hostile takeover bid），(A)「兩家銀行機構間的非合意收購企圖」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 14 percent、Horizon Regional Bancorp，但股價是「大漲」14% 而非下跌；(B) 出現原文 Continental Financial Group、Horizon，但收購案已被拒絕而非達成協議；(C) 出現原文 Horizon、wealth advisory、profit，未提遭到調查。

questions.q: Why did the target company's board reject the initial offer?
options: Continental Financial Group offered stock instead of an all-cash payout.
Wall Street analysts advised Horizon to wait for a 14 percent higher bid.
Horizon's wealth advisory unit accounted for less than a third of profits.
The proposed price failed to reflect the true worth of a key business line.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題（同義替換）。
• 解析：Horizon 董事會表示每股 42 美元的全現金報價嚴重低估了其快速成長的財富顧問部門價值（significantly undervalued its fast-growing wealth advisory unit），(D)「提案價格未能反映關鍵業務部門的真實價值」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 Continental Financial Group、all-cash，敘述與事實相反（報價正是全現金）；(C) 出現原文 wealth advisory unit、third of profits，說「少於」三分之一與「將近」三分之一語意有別且非拒絕理由；(B) 出現原文 Wall Street analysts、14 percent，數字錯置（14% 是股價漲幅，分析師預期加價 12%）。

questions.q: According to the report, what is expected to happen next week?
options: Horizon's board will issue a second strongly worded statement.
Both lenders will finalize negotiations at $42 per share.
The bidder is projected to submit a higher purchase proposal.
Continental's management will withdraw its $3.8 billion offer.

explain.text:
• 考點：未來預測題（同義替換）。
• 解析：華爾街分析師預期 Continental 下週初會提出更優渥的報價（return with a sweetened bid—raising its offer by roughly 12 percent），(C)「出價方預計將提出更高的收購報價」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 Horizon's board、strongly worded statement，那是本週已發生的事；(D) 出現原文 Continental's management、$3.8 billion，與分析師預期相反；(B) 出現原文 $42 per share，42 美元是已被拒絕的舊報價。

questions.q:
Look at the graphic. Which segment experienced the steepest year-over-year decline in operating margin?

Business Segment | FY25 Revenue | FY26 Revenue | FY25 Margin | FY26 Margin
Retail Banking | $420M | $438M | 24.5% | 22.0%
Corporate Lending | $310M | $345M | 31.0% | 30.2%
Wealth Advisory | $195M | $228M | 28.4% | 31.5%
Capital Markets | $160M | $142M | 19.8% | 14.1%
options: Corporate Lending
Wealth Advisory
Retail Banking
Capital Markets

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽線索＋看表格）。
• 解析：講者在獨白中刻意不唸出「Capital Markets」，而是給出線索「2026 會計年度營收最小的部門（our smallest revenue division in FY26）」且「營業利益率較去年同期縮水超過五個百分點」。對照表格，FY26 營收最小的是 $142M 的 (D) Capital Markets，且其營益率從 19.8% 降至 14.1%（下滑 5.7 個百分點，確實為最大跌幅）。
• 誘答分析：(B) Wealth Advisory 在獨白中被正面表揚；(C)(A) 營收皆高於 $300M 且營益率跌幅遠小於五個百分點。

questions.q: What does the speaker attribute that segment's performance to?
options: Lower balance sheet liquidity over the past twelve months
A decline in net new asset inflows during fiscal year 2026
Corporate issuers shifting capital into Retail Banking
Reduced transaction activity caused by high borrowing costs

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者指出該部門利潤下滑主因是「高利率環境下交易量減少」（lower deal volume amid elevated interest rates），使企業發行人觀望，(D)「高借貸成本導致交易活動減少」為同義改寫（elevated interest rates → high borrowing costs；lower deal volume → reduced transaction activity）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 net new asset inflows、FY2026，那是財富顧問部門表現亮眼的原因；(C) 出現原文 corporate issuers、Retail Banking，原文並未提及轉向零售銀行；(A) 出現原文 balance sheet liquidity、twelve months，講者明確說流動性「極佳」。

questions.q: What does the speaker announce regarding the company's capital allocation?
options: Distributing $150 million in special dividends next quarter
Using excess liquidity to acquire corporate issuers
Launching a new Wealth Advisory product in FY2027
Increasing funds authorized for buying back company stock

explain.text:
• 考點：公告細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：董事會投票決定在未來 12 個月內將「庫藏股買回授權額度擴大 1.5 億美元」（expand our share repurchase authorization by $150 million），(D)「增加授權用於買回公司股票的資金」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 Wealth Advisory、FY2027，未提推出新產品；(A) 出現原文 $150 million，將庫藏股金額誤導為特別股利；(B) 出現原文 liquidity、corporate issuers，未提併購發行人。

questions.q: What phase of the merger is the speaker discussing?
options: Auditing client billing records before the deal closes
Eliminating redundant 90-day HR milestones
Initial operational alignment immediately following deal closure
Finalizing the purchase agreement for Veridian Systems

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者開場表示 Veridian Systems 收購案今早正式完成交割，現在進入「交割後第一天整合階段」（Day-One post-closing integration），(C)「交易完成後隨即展開的初期營運整併」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 Veridian Systems，但收購案已經完成交割；(A) 出現原文 client billing，但這是整併期間要避免中斷的業務；(B) 出現原文 90-day，並非要「刪除」里程碑。

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "Dual payroll systems are a recipe for audit exceptions"?
options: To stress the need to unify human resources and finance software quickly
To criticize controllers for running two chart-of-accounts structures
To justify delaying internal control testing for 90 days
To explain why Veridian Systems experienced client billing errors

explain.text:
• 考點：意圖題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者說「雙軌薪資系統是稽核異常的溫床」，緊接著強調必須儘快整合人資與會計平台（consolidate HR and accounting platforms as quickly as possible），(A)「強調必須迅速統一核人資與財務軟體」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D) 出現原文 Veridian Systems、client billing，未提已發生帳單錯誤；(C) 出現原文 internal controls、90 days，說法相反；(B) 出現原文 controllers、two chart-of-accounts structures，語氣並非指責財務長。

questions.q: What milestone is scheduled for the end of Q1?
options: Combining all accounting ledgers into one unified enterprise system
Hiring external auditors to review the unified chart of accounts
Completing client billing integration within the first 90 days
Training controllers on Veridian Systems' existing payroll platform

explain.text:
• 考點：里程碑細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：第一季末的重大里程碑是「將所有總分類帳科目遷移至單一 ERP 實例」（migrating all general ledger accounts onto a single ERP instance），(A)「將所有會計總帳整合進單一企業系統」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 client billing、90 days，時間與項目錯置；(D) 出現原文 controllers、Veridian Systems、payroll，與整合方向相反；(B) 出現原文 chart of accounts，未提聘請外部稽核。

questions.q: What service is being advertised?
options: A multi-currency bank portal built for Monday morning audits
A web-hosted liquidity management platform for finance executives
A high-yield savings sweep account offered by 2,500 global banks
A consulting service that forecasts idle cash for small businesses

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：廣告推銷「為現代財務長打造的雲端資金與現金可視性平台」（cloud-based treasury and cash-visibility platform built for modern CFOs），(B)「供財務高階主管使用的雲端流動性管理平台」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 bank portal、Monday mornings，週一早上是客戶目前的痛點；(C) 出現原文 2,500 global banks，平台是串接銀行而非銀行提供的定存帳戶；(D) 出現原文 forecasts idle cash，廣告標的為軟體平台而非顧問服務。

questions.q: What feature of the service is highlighted?
options: Guaranteed higher interest income on idle cash balances
Automated Monday morning logins across twelve separate bank portals
Free daily sweeps to over 2,500 global partner banks
Instant aggregation of account figures across multiple institutions and currencies

explain.text:
• 考點：產品特色題（同義替換）。
• 解析：平台連接全球 2,500 多家銀行，在單一儀表板中提供「跨幣別多銀行餘額的即時整合」（real-time consolidation of multi-bank balances across all currencies），(D)「跨機構與跨幣別帳戶數據的即時彙整」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B) 出現原文 Monday mornings、twelve separate bank portals，那是未導入系統前的舊做法；(A) 出現原文 interest income、idle cash balances，廣告僅說可試算潛在收益，未「保證」提高；(C) 出現原文 daily sweeps、2,500 global banks，未提免費。

questions.q: How can listeners receive a customized ROI assessment?
options: By running a liquidity forecast on treasurypulse.com
By calling a TreasuryPulse finance specialist directly
By linking twelve bank accounts through the software tool
By scheduling a brief online product demonstration

explain.text:
• 考點：行動細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：廣告指示聽眾今天上官網預約 20 分鐘即時示範（Book a 20-minute live demo on our website），即可獲得客製化 ROI 評估，(D)「透過預約簡短的線上產品演示」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C) 出現原文 twelve bank accounts、software tool，過度簡化步驟；(B) 出現原文 TreasuryPulse、finance，未提供電話專線；(A) 出現原文 liquidity forecast、treasurypulse.com，網頁是預約示範而非直接跑預測。

questions.q:
Look at the graphic. Which bond rating category is the speaker recommending for conservative income portfolios?

Credit Rating | Yield to Maturity | 5-Year Default Rate | Duration (Years)
AAA (Sovereign/Prime) | 4.15% | 0.02% | 6.8
A (Investment Grade) | 4.85% | 0.45% | 5.4
BBB (Lower Investment) | 5.60% | 1.85% | 5.1
BB (High Yield) | 7.40% | 6.90% | 3.9
options: AAA (Sovereign/Prime)
A (Investment Grade)
BBB (Lower Investment)
BB (High Yield)

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽線索＋看表格）。
• 解析：講者刻意不唸出「A (Investment Grade)」，而是給出雙重篩選線索：「五年違約率低於 0.5%（under half a percent）」且「殖利率高於 4.5%（above 4.5 percent）」。對照圖表，AAA 殖利率僅 4.15%（低於 4.5%），BBB 與 BB 違約率皆高於 0.5%（1.85% 與 6.90%），唯一同時符合兩項條件的是 (B) A (Investment Grade)（殖利率 4.85%、違約率 0.45%）。
• 誘答分析：(D) BB 在獨白中被明確警告風險；(A)(C) 皆僅符合其中一項條件，必須交叉比對才能排除。

questions.q: Why does the speaker advise caution regarding BB-rated bonds?
options: Their 7.4 percent yield fails to offset a 6.90 percent annual default rate.
Issuers face steeper debt-rollover expenses if market risk premiums expand.
Conservative clients are prohibited from buying high-yield corporate bonds.
Their 5-year historical default rate is higher during economic booms.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者警告 BB 級發行人面臨嚴重的再融資風險：若經濟放緩導致信用利差擴大，其借貸成本會急劇上升（borrowing costs rise sharply if credit spreads widen），(B)「若市場風險溢酬擴大，發行人將面臨更陡峭的借新還舊成本」為同義改寫（refinancing → debt-rollover；credit spreads → market risk premiums）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 7.4 percent yield、6.90 percent default rate，但 6.90% 是五年累計違約率而非年違約率；(D) 出現原文 5-year historical default rate，講者說的是經濟放緩（slowdown）而非繁榮期；(C) 出現原文 conservative clients、high-yield，過度推論為「禁止」。

questions.q: What does the speaker offer to distribute at the end of the seminar?
options: A chart comparing 5-year default rates across bond categories
A registration form for an upcoming corporate bond workshop
A hard-copy research report covering fourth-quarter debt markets
A guide on building a conservative income portfolio

explain.text:
• 考點：結尾細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者請聽眾離開前到報到桌領取公司「第四季固定收益展望的紙本」（a printed copy of our firm's Q4 fixed-income outlook），(C)「涵蓋第四季債市的紙本研調報告」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 5-year default rates，非發放文件；(D) 出現原文 conservative income portfolio，非指南手冊；(B) 出現原文 registration，registration table 是領取地點而非報名表。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the voicemail?
options: To notify Marcus that four branches failed their annual compliance audit
To explain why Evelyn placed Marcus's district on the exception list
To prompt local office heads to turn in periodic regulatory filings
To announce a new Friday 5:00 P.M. deadline for Q3 staff training

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（同義替換）。
• 解析：Evelyn 留言給各區分行經理，提醒尚未繳交第三季反洗錢（AML）訓練與交易監控證明（quarterly anti-money laundering certifications），(C)「催促地方分行主管繳交定期法遵申報文件」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 Marcus、four branches、annual compliance，尚未到稽核失敗階段；(D) 出現原文 Friday 5:00 P.M.、Q3 training，週五下午五點是認證繳交期限而非新設訓練期限；(B) 出現原文 Evelyn、Marcus's district、exception list，語氣並非解釋為何列入名單，而是催交以解除名單。

questions.q: What will happen if a branch misses the Friday deadline?
options: The branch manager will be removed from transaction-monitoring duties.
Corporate Compliance will suspend Q3 training for that branch.
An official noncompliance record will be filed with internal reviewers.
All four branches in the district will receive lower annual ratings.

explain.text:
• 考點：條件結果題（同義替換）。
• 解析：若任何分行錯過週五期限，將向內部稽核登錄正式缺失通知（a formal deficiency notice will be logged with internal audit），(C)「將向內部審查單位呈報正式的未合規紀錄」為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 出現原文 branch manager、transaction-monitoring，未提停職；(B) 出現原文 Corporate Compliance、Q3 training，動作無中生有；(D) 出現原文 four branches、annual ratings，只有「逾期未交」的分行受影響，並非全區四家都受罰。

questions.q: What does the speaker ask the recipient to do?
options: Remind the four branch managers to sign off before 5:00 P.M.
Email the executed verification document to the compliance team
Contact internal audit to clear the district off the exception list
Upload Q3 transaction-monitoring logs to the compliance portal

explain.text:
• 考點：請求行動題（同義替換）。
• 解析：講者請收件人在經理簽核後，將簽署好的證明 PDF 直接轉寄至法遵收件匣（forward the signed attestation PDF directly to the compliance inbox），(B)「將已簽署的驗證文件以電子郵件寄給法遵團隊」為同義改寫。
