• 考點：原因細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 local suppliers couldn't source fresh sea bass this week—they're out of season right now，正解 (B) 改寫為 Certain raw ingredients are currently unavailable from vendors。
• 誘答分析：(A) 原文是「更換」而非「主動新增特色菜」；(C) 挪用 Friday；(D) 挪用 three hundred booklets 捏造拼字錯誤。
• 單字補充：vendor (n.) 供應商；raw ingredients (n.) 食材原料。

questions.q: What does the woman suggest doing with the printed programs?
options: Crossing out the sea bass dish by hand before Friday
Waiting three days for a complete reprint of the booklets
Distributing the updated menu only to VIP tables
Replacing a single sheet inside the existing booklets

explain.text:
• 考點：解決方案（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 reprint the single insert page with the updated menu and slip it into each booklet，正解 (D) 改寫為 Replacing a single sheet inside the existing booklets。
• 誘答分析：(B) 原文因需時三天而否決整本重印；(A) 挪用 sea bass 捏造手寫劃掉；(C) 過度推論。
• 單字補充：insert page (n.) 夾頁。

questions.q: What is the purpose of the woman's visit to the convention center?
options: To complain about eighty neighboring booths streaming video
To deliver robotic arm demo units to Booth 214
To verify power hookups at her company's display area
To request a shared Wi-Fi password for Hall B

explain.text:
• 考點：來訪目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 check the electrical connections before our demo units arrive，正解 (C) 改寫為 verify power hookups at her company's display area。
• 誘答分析：(B) 示範機組尚未抵達；(D) 混用 shared Wi-Fi；(A) 混用 eighty booths streaming video。
• 單字補充：power hookup (n.) 電源接線。

questions.q: What problem does the man point out?
options: The 220-volt line in Booth 214 is not yet active.
Tech exhibitors are not permitted to stream live video.
Wireless network capacity in the hall is overloaded.
The robotic arm demo cannot connect to a local router.

explain.text:
• 考點：問題細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 the shared Wi-Fi bandwidth in Hall B is struggling today，正解 (C) 改寫為 Wireless network capacity in the hall is overloaded。
• 誘答分析：(A) 與原文 already live 相反；(B) 過度推論禁止直播；(D) 混用 robotic arm demo 捏造裝置故障。
• 單字補充：capacity (n.) 容量／頻寬；overload (v.) 超載。

questions.q: What will the man do by 3:00 P.M.?
options: Ask neighboring exhibitors to pause their video streams
Move SunTech Robotics' booth to another hall
Install an independent high-speed internet connection
Test the 220-volt outlet before the demo units arrive

explain.text:
• 考點：承諾行動（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 running dedicated fiber-optic hotspots... have a private line set up at your booth by 3:00 P.M.，正解 (C) 改寫為 Install an independent high-speed internet connection。
• 誘答分析：(B) 過度推論換展廳；(A) 過度推論要求鄰近攤位停止直播；(D) 混用 220-volt 與 demo units（電源已通電）。
• 單字補充：dedicated (adj.) 專用的。

questions.q: What are the speakers discussing?
options: Choosing a primary air carrier for international routes
Comparing hotel proposals in the Asia-Pacific region
Rescheduling missed connections to Tokyo
Cutting travel expenses for the engineering department

explain.text:
• 考點：對話主旨（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 finalize our company's preferred airline partner for next year's Asia-Pacific routes，正解 (A) 改寫為 Choosing a primary air carrier for international routes。
• 誘答分析：(D) 混用 engineers 與費用；(C) 混用 missed connections 與 Tokyo；(B) 挪用 proposal 捏造飯店比較。
• 單字補充：air carrier (n.) 航空公司。

questions.q: Why does Hannah prefer Pacific Crest Airlines?
options: It offers complimentary rebooking when engineers miss connections.
It guarantees zero layovers on all Asia-Pacific routes.
It submitted a proposal with the lowest ticket prices.
It runs a higher frequency of direct flights to Japan's capital.

explain.text:
• 考點：偏好原因（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 operate twice as many nonstop flights to Tokyo as any competitor，正解 (D) 改寫為 runs a higher frequency of direct flights to Japan's capital。
• 誘答分析：(C) 較低票價是 SkyBridge Air（Ken 提出），屬對象錯置；(B) 過度推論「所有航線零轉機」；(A) 混用 engineers 與 missed connections。
• 單字補充：frequency (n.) 班次頻率。

questions.q: What does Mark say he will review before making a final decision?
options: Productivity reports from the engineering team
The total ticket price difference in SkyBridge Air's proposal
Travel volume projections for next year
Past punctuality records for the competing airlines

explain.text:
• 考點：後續查核動作（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 review the historical flight delay statistics for both carriers to make sure their on-time performance justifies the rate，正解 (D) 改寫為 Past punctuality records for the competing airlines。
• 誘答分析：(B) 挪用 ticket prices 與 SkyBridge Air's proposal；(A) 挪用 productivity 與 engineering team；(C) 挪用 travel volume 與 next year。
• 單字補充：punctuality (n.) 準點率。

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to check?
options: Whether her 10:30 A.M. flight is still on schedule
Whether she can extend her three-night stay until noon
Whether a taxi can be reserved for 7:00 A.M.
Whether a reduced corporate rate was included on her bill

explain.text:
• 考點：請求確認事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 check whether my company's corporate discount was applied to my folio，正解 (D) 改寫為 Whether a reduced corporate rate was included on her bill。
• 誘答分析：(A) 混用 10:30 A.M. flight；(C) 混用 taxi 與 7:00 A.M.；(B) 混用 three nights 與 noon。
• 單字補充：folio (n.) 飯店住宿帳單。

questions.q: Why does the man mention a citywide marathon?
options: To suggest taking the subway instead of a taxi
To note that the hotel lobby will be crowded at 7:00 A.M.
To explain why taxi fares downtown will increase by 18 percent
To alert her to street closures affecting morning transit

explain.text:
• 考點：提及事件之目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文提醒市中心馬拉松將導致 several avenues downtown will be closed until noon，正解 (D) 改寫為 To alert her to street closures affecting morning transit。
• 誘答分析：(C) 混用 taxi 與 18 percent（18% 是企業折扣）；(A) 過度推論建議改搭地鐵；(B) 混用 hotel 與 7:00 A.M.。
• 單字補充：transit (n.) 交通運輸。

questions.q: What does the woman decide to do?
options: Check out tonight instead of tomorrow morning
Switch to a later flight departing after noon
Ask the concierge to book a route avoiding downtown
Head to the airport sixty minutes ahead of her original plan

explain.text:
• 考點：最終決定（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 leave for the airport an hour earlier than I originally planned，正解 (D) 改寫為 Head to the airport sixty minutes ahead of her original plan。
• 誘答分析：(A) 混用 checking out tomorrow morning；(C) 過度推論請禮賓部安排路線；(B) 混用 noon 捏造改搭晚班機。
• 單字補充：ahead of (prep.) 提早於……。

questions.q: What is the man's job?
options: Beverage specialist
Kitchen manager
Charity event planner
Seafood distributor

explain.text:
• 考點：推論職業（上位概念替換）。
• 解析：男士自稱 the hotel's sommelier（侍酒師），並負責討論餐酒搭配，正解 (A) 改寫為 Beverage specialist。
• 誘答分析：(D) 挪用 distributor 與 sea bass；(B) 挪用 kitchen service；(C) 挪用 charity gala。
• 單字補充：sommelier (n.) 侍酒師。

questions.q: What does the woman imply when she says, "We're already at ninety percent capacity for the gala"?
options: Guest seating for Saturday's gala needs to be expanded.
The distributor should deliver more Cabernet Sauvignon.
The grilled sea bass entrée is nearly sold out.
The kitchen cannot handle complicated last-minute changes.

explain.text:
• 考點：語意推論題（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士說宴會已達九成滿，接著表示 so I don't want to complicate kitchen service with last-minute menu changes，對應 (D) The kitchen cannot handle complicated last-minute changes。
• 誘答分析：(B) 挪用 distributor 與 Cabernet Sauvignon；(A) 過度推論需擴大座位；(C) 挪用 grilled sea bass。
• 單字補充：at capacity (phr.) 達到滿載容量。

questions.q: What do the speakers agree to do?
options: Order the discounted Cabernet Sauvignon for the cocktail hour
Offer an unoaked Chardonnay as the only wine option
Serve a milder red vintage with the main dish
Replace the grilled sea bass with a heavier meat entrée

explain.text:
• 考點：達成共識（同義替換）。
• 解析：雙方最後決定搭配 a lighter red like Pinot Noir，正解 (C) 改寫為 Serve a milder red vintage with the main dish。
• 誘答分析：(D) 與原文不改菜單相反；(B) Chardonnay 僅為備選之一，最終選了紅酒；(A) Cabernet Sauvignon 已被否決。
• 單字補充：vintage (n.) （特定年份或種類的）葡萄酒。

questions.q: What is the woman's complaint about the new booking portal?
options: It prevents department heads from viewing client schedules.
It defaults to ticket options that cannot be refunded.
It blocks managers from booking basic economy seats.
It charges extra penalties when searching for flights.

explain.text:
• 考點：抱怨內容（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 automatically selects non-refundable basic fares，正解 (B) 改寫為 defaults to ticket options that cannot be refunded。
• 誘答分析：(A) 混用 department heads 與 client；(D) 混用 penalties；(C) 混用 managers 與 basic。
• 單字補充：default to (phr.) 預設為……。

questions.q: According to the man, why was the feature configured that way?
options: To discourage employees from changing client meeting dates
To curb company-wide flight expenditures
To match the preferences of most department heads
To simplify penalty tracking for Finance

explain.text:
• 考點：設定原因（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 to reduce overall airfare spending across departments，正解 (B) 改寫為 To curb company-wide flight expenditures。
• 誘答分析：(A) 過度推論阻止員工改期；(C) 與前句「幾位主管也注意到了」矛盾；(D) 挪用 Finance 捏造追蹤罰金。
• 單字補充：curb (v.) 抑制、控制；expenditure (n.) 支出。

questions.q: What does the man promise to send the woman?
options: A direct link to cancel her tentative reservation
An authorization code for purchasing changeable fares
A summary of Finance's updated travel policy
A list of managers who already use the portal

explain.text:
• 考點：承諾事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 send you an override code for flexible tickets so you can book changeable fares，正解 (B) 改寫為 An authorization code for purchasing changeable fares。
• 誘答分析：(C) 挪用 Finance；(D) 挪用 managers 與 portal；(A) 混用 cancel 與 tentative。
• 單字補充：override code (n.) 權限覆寫／授權碼。

questions.q: What does the man say about his colleague, Ms. Chen?
options: She has already arrived at the boarding area.
She is checking the departure board in Concourse C.
She is still waiting in line at the security checkpoint.
She texted him to say their flight was delayed.

explain.text:
• 考點：人物狀態細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 already waiting at the gate，正解 (A) 改寫為 has already arrived at the boarding area。
• 誘答分析：(C) 剛過安檢的是男士自己，屬人物錯置；(D) 過度推論簡訊內容；(B) 混用 departure board 與 Concourse C。
• 單字補充：boarding area (n.) 登機區。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which flight is the man most likely taking?
options: AX 412
AX 508
AX 620
AX 735

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（必須聽線索 + 看時刻表）。
• 解析：對話中男士未直接唸出班機代號、時間或目的地，僅提示「十一點後才飛（after eleven）」且狀態顯示為「登機門變更（Gate Changed）」。對照圖表，11:00 後出發且狀態為 Gate Changed 的唯有飛往東京的 AX 620，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(D) 皆為圖表上的其他班機，但狀態分別為 On Time、Delayed 與 Boarding Soon，與對話線索不符。
• 單字補充：reassignment (n.) 重新指派。

questions.q: What does the woman advise the man to do?
options: Verify the updated gate on a screen in the next concourse
Board immediately before the status changes
Ask Ms. Chen to meet him back at security
Wait at Gate B19 until the incoming aircraft arrives

explain.text:
• 考點：建議事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 check the digital monitor in Concourse C... to confirm the exact gate number，正解 (A) 改寫為 Verify the updated gate on a screen in the next concourse。
• 誘答分析：(D) 挪用 incoming aircraft delay 捏造在 B19 等候；(C) 挪用 Ms. Chen 與 security；(B) 與原文 isn't boarding yet 矛盾。
• 單字補充：concourse (n.) 機場大廳／候機長廊。

questions.q: Why is the woman inquiring about the hotel's event spaces?
options: She wants to compare hourly rates for a Friday staff retreat.
She is organizing a corporate unveiling for nearly two hundred attendees.
She needs a room with simultaneous translation booths for international guests.
She is booking a banquet with round-table seating for 120 guests.

explain.text:
• 考點：詢問目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 product launch next month. We're expecting about 180 guests，正解 (B) 改寫為 organizing a corporate unveiling for nearly two hundred attendees。
• 誘答分析：(D) 挪用圖表 round-table 與 120；(C) 挪用圖表 simultaneous translation booths；(A) 挪用 hourly rates 與 Friday。
• 單字補充：unveiling (n.) 產品發表／揭幕。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which room does the man recommend?
options: Sapphire Room
Meridian Hall
Orchid Suite
Horizon Pavilion

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（人數 + 預算 + 設備交叉篩選）。
• 解析：對話中男士未直接唸出廳名，女士提出條件：劇院型容納約 180 人、需要舞台（stage）、每小時預算上限 $800。男士排除太小的 Orchid Suite（120人）與超預算的 Meridian Hall（$1,100），推薦具備伸縮舞台的廳別。對照圖表，符合容納 >=180 人、價格 <=$800 且有 Retractable Stage 的是 Sapphire Room ($700 / 200人)，故選 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆為圖表上其他宴會廳，但在人數或預算上不符條件。
• 單字補充：retractable (adj.) 可伸縮收合的。

questions.q: What additional service is included if the woman books before Friday?
options: A discounted hourly rate on the banquet hall
Zero labor charges for sound-system setup
Free use of dual LED projectors during the presentation
Complimentary round-table rearrangement after the CEO speaks

explain.text:
• 考點：額外優惠細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 waive the setup fees for our audio technicians，正解 (B) 改寫為 Zero labor charges for sound-system setup。
• 誘答分析：(C) 挪用圖表 Dual LED Projectors；(D) 挪用圖表 round-table 與 CEO；(A) 混用 hourly rate。
• 單字補充：waive (v.) 免除（費用）。

questions.q: Why does the man speak to the restaurant manager?
options: To request a separate copy of Invoice 4491 for his client
To ask why a 10 percent service charge was added
To complain about the temperature of his dinner
To dispute an inaccurate charge on his check

explain.text:
• 考點：對話目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 noticed a billing error on the receipt，正解 (D) 改寫為 To dispute an inaccurate charge on his check。
• 誘答分析：(B) 挪用圖表 10 percent service charge；(A) 挪用 Invoice 4491 與 client；(C) 過度推論抱怨餐點溫度。
• 單字補充：dispute (v.) 對（帳單等）提出異議。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which item on the receipt does the man question?
options: Espresso
Executive Prix Fixe Dinner
Sparkling Mineral Water
Service Charge

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（消費明細排除法）。
• 解析：對話中男士未直接唸出飲料名稱，僅確認點了兩份主廚套餐（two Executive Prix Fixe dinners）、大瓶氣泡水（large sparkling water）並認可標準服務費，但指出帳單上多了一筆 $5.50 的額外餐後飲料。對照帳單明細，唯一 $5.50 的飲品項目即為 Espresso，故選 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 皆為帳單上的項目，但對話已明確確認該三項無誤。
• 單字補充：itemized (adj.) 逐項列明的。

questions.q: What does the woman offer to resolve the issue?
options: Delete the incorrect entry and issue an updated receipt
Provide a complimentary beverage on his next visit
Deduct 10 percent from the total charged
Transfer the $5.50 charge to the neighboring table

explain.text:
• 考點：解決方案（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 remove that item right away and reprint a corrected bill，正解 (A) 改寫為 Delete the incorrect entry and issue an updated receipt。
• 誘答分析：(C) 混用帳單 10 percent；(D) 挪用 wrong table number 過度推論；(B) 捏造下次免費飲品。
• 單字補充：entry (n.) 帳目／紀錄。

questions.q: Where is this announcement most likely being made?
options: In a Priority Gold lounge
At an airport departure lounge
Inside a full Vancouver-bound aircraft
At a Pacific Air check-in counter

explain.text:
• 考點：推論廣播地點（同義替換）。
• 解析：廣播提及 begin boarding in approximately fifteen minutes、bring it to the podium、gate agents，可見地點在機場登機門候機室，對應 (B) At an airport departure lounge。
• 誘答分析：(C) 混用 full 與 Vancouver，但尚未登機；(D) 混用 Pacific Air 與 check（實際為 gate check）；(A) 挪用 Priority Gold。
• 單字補充：departure lounge (n.) 候機室。

questions.q: What are passengers asked to do with their oversized carry-on bags?
options: Wait until Zone 3 is called before bringing them to the podium
Store them under the seat in front of them
Hand them over to staff for complimentary stowage
Place them in overhead bins after Priority Gold members board

explain.text:
• 考點：要求事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 bring it to the podium now so our gate agents can check it to your final destination free of charge，正解 (C) 改寫為 Hand them over to staff for complimentary stowage。
• 誘答分析：(B) 原文指頭頂置物櫃空間有限，未要求放座位下；(A) 混用 Zone 3 與 podium；(D) 混用 overhead bins 與 Priority Gold。
• 單字補充：complimentary (adj.) 免費的；stowage (n.) 托運／放置。

questions.q: When will boarding begin?
options: Right after gate agents finish tagging rolling suitcases
Once Zone 1 passengers have lined up
As soon as passengers needing assistance arrive at the podium
In roughly a quarter of an hour

explain.text:
• 考點：時間推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 in approximately fifteen minutes，正解 (D) 改寫為 In roughly a quarter of an hour（15 分鐘＝一刻鐘）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 混用 needing assistance 與 podium；(A) 混用 gate agents 與 rolling suitcases；(B) 混用 Zone 1。
• 單字補充：a quarter of an hour (phr.) 十五分鐘。

questions.q: Who is the speaker?
options: A Grand Oak front desk clerk
A Houston airport shuttle driver
A corporate travel coordinator
A Global Energy Conference organizer

explain.text:
• 考點：說話者身分（同義替換）。
• 解析：說話者為 Marcus from Summit Corporate Travel，負責處理行程與機場接送，對應 (C) corporate travel coordinator。
• 誘答分析：(D) 挪用 Global Energy Conference；(A) 挪用 Grand Oak；(B) 挪用 Houston 與 shuttle。
• 單字補充：coordinator (n.) 協調專員。

questions.q: What change does the speaker mention?
options: Ms. Gomez's reservation at the Grand Oak was moved.
The return airport transfer was rescheduled due to road construction.
A ground transportation boarding area has been shifted.
The convention center's north entrance is closed to taxis.

explain.text:
• 考點：異動細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 the hotel shuttle bus pickup point has been relocated to the East Plaza，正解 (C) 改寫為 A ground transportation boarding area has been shifted。
• 誘答分析：(A) 與原文 remains unchanged 相反；(D) 挪用 north entrance 與 taxi stand 過度推論；(B) 混用 airport transfer 與 road construction。
• 單字補充：ground transportation (n.) 地面交通工具。

questions.q: What should the listener do to confirm receipt of the message?
options: Send a flight identifier via electronic correspondence
Meet the shuttle driver at the East Plaza taxi stand
Check with conference organizers upon arriving in Houston
Call Marcus back at Summit Corporate Travel

explain.text:
• 考點：後續行動（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 reply to my email with your updated return flight number，正解 (A) 改寫為 Send a flight identifier via electronic correspondence。
• 誘答分析：(D) 原文是回覆 email 而非回電；(B) 混用 East Plaza taxi stand；(C) 挪用 conference organizers 與 Houston。
• 單字補充：electronic correspondence (n.) 電子郵件往來。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the talk?
options: To ask guests to board the coach before noon
To explain wine-tasting etiquette at Meadowbrook Farm
To preview the schedule for a food-and-wine excursion
To review dietary restrictions for a farm-to-table lunch

explain.text:
• 考點：演講主旨（同義替換）。
• 解析：導遊介紹 Sonoma Valley Culinary & Vineyard Tour 的整日行程，正解 (C) 改寫為 preview the schedule for a food-and-wine excursion。
• 誘答分析：(B) 挪用 Meadowbrook Farm；(D) 挪用 farm-to-table lunch；(A) 混用 board the coach 與 noon。
• 單字補充：excursion (n.) 短途觀光旅遊。

questions.q: What does the speaker mean when she says, "Don't fill up on the appetizers at the first stop"?
options: The olive oil and sourdough samples at Meadowbrook Farm are limited.
Guests will be eating at multiple subsequent venues.
A three-course lunch will be served immediately after the first stop.
The pastry chef's demonstration includes a full dinner.

explain.text:
• 考點：語意推論題（同義替換）。
• 解析：導遊提醒別在第一站吃太飽，接著說 We have four more tasting locations after that, including a three-course farm-to-table lunch，對應 (B) Guests will be eating at multiple subsequent venues。
• 誘答分析：(A) 挪用 olive oil and sourdough 與 Meadowbrook Farm；(C) 誤以為午餐緊接在第一站之後（中間還有其他試吃點）；(D) 混用 pastry chef 與 demonstration。
• 單字補充：subsequent (adj.) 隨後的。

questions.q: What will the group do at 4:30 P.M.?
options: Sample artisan olive oil and sourdough
Tour a second boutique winery before returning to the hotels
Eat a three-course meal at a local farm
Watch a live sweet-making presentation

explain.text:
• 考點：行程時間細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 at 4:30 P.M. with a live dessert demonstration by a local pastry chef，正解 (D) 改寫為 Watch a live sweet-making presentation。
• 誘答分析：(B) 酒莊參觀在 4:30 P.M. 之前；(A) 與 (C) 皆為早上與中午行程，屬「時間錯置」陷阱。
• 單字補充：presentation (n.) 展示、示範。

questions.q: Who is the intended audience for this talk?
options: Medical convention organizers
Hotel IT support technicians
Front desk receptionists
Lodging sanitation managers

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾對象（上位概念替換）。
• 解析：開頭稱呼 housekeeping supervisors（房務主管），對應 (D) Lodging sanitation managers。
• 誘答分析：(C) 挪用 front desk；(A) 挪用 medical convention；(B) 過度推論平板電腦與 IT 的關聯。
• 單字補充：lodging (n.) 旅宿業；sanitation (n.) 清潔衛生。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what has improved over the past quarter?
options: The number of early check-ins requested by convention guests
Accuracy in delivering paper clipboards to the back office
Attendance at the Q3 operational briefing
The speed of preparing suites between guests

explain.text:
• 考點：過去一季改善項目（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 average room turnover time dropped by seven minutes per suite，正解 (D) 改寫為 The speed of preparing suites between guests。
• 誘答分析：(C) 挪用 Q3 operational 與 briefing；(A) 混用 early check-ins；(B) 混用 paper clipboards 與 back office。
• 單字補充：turnover time (n.) 客房整理周轉時間。

questions.q: What new procedure will start next Monday?
options: Recording room readiness on handheld electronic devices
Having supervisors inspect suites seven minutes faster
Replacing front desk notifications with back-office briefings
Logging medical convention check-ins on paper clipboards

explain.text:
• 考點：新規定細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 receive a digital tablet to log room inspections in real time，正解 (A) 改寫為 Recording room readiness on handheld electronic devices。
• 誘答分析：(C) 與原文「即時通知櫃檯」相反；(D) 原文是「淘汰」紙本夾板；(B) 混用 seven minutes。
• 單字補充：handheld (adj.) 手持式的。

questions.q: What is being advertised?
options: A global hotel chain for layover stays
A corporate credit card for frequent travelers
An international airport club program
A high-speed café Wi-Fi subscription

explain.text:
• 考點：廣告產品（同義替換）。
• 解析：廣告介紹 Horizon Elite Lounge Pass 可使用全球四百多間機場貴賓室，對應 (C) An international airport club program。
• 誘答分析：(D) 挪用 café Wi-Fi；(B) 挪用 corporate travelers；(A) 混用 400 與 layover 捏造連鎖飯店。
• 單字補充：airport club (n.) 機場貴賓室會員計畫。

questions.q: What benefit is highlighted for frequent flyers?
options: Complimentary early-morning flight rebooking
Dedicated private workspaces at over 400 hotels
Unrestricted use of private bathing facilities
Discounted chef-prepared meals at airport cafés

explain.text:
• 考點：會員福利（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 unlimited access to private shower suites，正解 (C) 改寫為 Unrestricted use of private bathing facilities。
• 誘答分析：(D) 混用 chef-prepared hot meals 與 cafés；(A) 混用 early morning flight；(B) 混用 private workspaces 與 400。
• 單字補充：unrestricted (adj.) 無限制的。

questions.q: How can listeners receive a waived initiation fee?
options: By booking an international flight through horizonelite.com
By paying a $150 deposit with promo code ELITE26
By visiting one of the 400 lounges during a layover
By enrolling prior to the close of the current month

explain.text:
• 考點：優惠條件（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 sign up before the end of the month，正解 (D) 改寫為 By enrolling prior to the close of the current month。
• 誘答分析：(A) 挪用 horizonelite.com；(B) 混用 $150 與 ELITE26（$150 是被免除的入會費而非押金）；(C) 混用 400 lounges 與 layover。
• 單字補充：enroll (v.) 註冊加入。

questions.q: What is the report mainly about?
options: Daytime flight cancellations on Runway 2
Postponed facility work at an aviation hub
A September strike affecting steel suppliers
Higher summer ticket prices across commercial airlines

explain.text:
• 考點：新聞主旨（同義替換）。
• 解析：報導主軸為 Construction delays on the new Terminal 4 expansion 延後至十二月完工，對應 (B) Postponed facility work at an aviation hub。
• 誘答分析：(C) 挪用 September 與 steel supply 捏造罷工；(D) 挪用 summer ticket prices（僅為節目預告訪談主題）；(A) 混用 Runway 2（白天航班不受影響）。
• 單字補充：aviation hub (n.) 航空樞紐。

questions.q: What did airport officials announce yesterday?
options: Overnight airfield repairs will start in early summer.
Steel supply shortages will delay daytime flights in June.
Terminal 4 will partially open in September.
Summer airfare queues will be shorter after the break.

explain.text:
• 考點：昨日公告細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 nighttime runway maintenance on Runway 2 will begin in June，正解 (A) 改寫為 Overnight airfield repairs will start in early summer。
• 誘答分析：(C) 原文已延後至十二月；(B) 混用 steel supply shortages 與 June；(D) 混用 longer queues 與 summer。
• 單字補充：airfield (n.) 機場跑道與停機坪區域。

questions.q: Who will be interviewed next on the program?
options: A commercial pilot operating on Runway 2
A specialist in air travel economics
A construction contractor for Terminal 4
A Metro International Airport spokesperson

explain.text:
• 考點：下一位受訪者（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 aviation industry analyst Dr. Raymond Cho，正解 (B) 改寫為 A specialist in air travel economics。
• 誘答分析：(D) 挪用 Metro International Airport；(C) 挪用 Terminal 4；(A) 挪用 commercial 與 Runway 2。
• 單字補充：specialist (n.) 專家。

questions.q: What is the speaker explaining to new employees?
options: How to manage situations where ticket sales exceed seat capacity
How to process meal refunds at airport restaurants
How to deny boarding to passengers without reservations
How to train duty managers on Day 2 of onboarding

explain.text:
• 考點：演講主題（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 how to handle overbooked flights，正解 (A) 改寫為 How to manage situations where ticket sales exceed seat capacity。
• 誘答分析：(C) 原文先徵求志願者而非直接拒載；(B) 挪用 meal vouchers 與 airport restaurants；(D) 混用 duty managers 與 Day 2。
• 單字補充：exceed capacity (phr.) 超出容納上限。

questions.q: What does the speaker emphasize about the vouchers?
options: Volunteers must redeem them before leaving the gate.
Gate agents must sign every voucher before handing it out.
High-value certificates require managerial authorization.
Meal vouchers can only be used for amounts under $300.

explain.text:
• 考點：強調規定（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 every voucher over $300 must be signed by a duty manager，正解 (C) 改寫為 High-value certificates require managerial authorization。
• 誘答分析：(D) 混用 meal vouchers 與 $300；(A) 挪用 volunteers 與 gate；(B) 過度推論「每張」皆須由地勤簽名。
• 單字補充：authorization (n.) 授權核准。

questions.q: What will the listeners do immediately after the talk?
options: Practice handling volunteers at an actual departure gate
Act out customer scenarios with a partner
Draft a new onboarding script for oversold flights
Meet with a duty manager to review voucher rules

explain.text:
• 考點：會後行動（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 pair up and complete a short role-playing exercise，正解 (B) 改寫為 Act out customer scenarios with a partner。
• 誘答分析：(A) 過度推論去實際登機門；(C) 挪用 script 與 oversold flights；(D) 挪用 duty manager。
• 單字補充：act out (phr.) 演練、扮演。

questions.q: Why is the speaker calling Ms. Tanaka?
options: To reschedule a marketing seminar to next month
To explain why downtown occupancy reached 95 percent
To introduce the hotel's new revenue director
To follow up on group lodging pricing and adjacent accommodations

explain.text:
• 考點：來電目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：說話者回報團體房價 $215 無法再降，並保留了兩間相連套房，對應 (D) To follow up on group lodging pricing and adjacent accommodations。
• 誘答分析：(B) 挪用 downtown occupancy 與 95 percent；(A) 挪用 marketing seminar；(C) 挪用 revenue director。
• 單字補充：adjacent (adj.) 相鄰的。

questions.q: What does the speaker say when she mentions, "That's the best we can do during peak convention week"?
options: The quoted nightly tariff is not open to further reduction.
Executive directors must pay more than $215 per night.
The hotel cannot hold the room block past noon tomorrow.
Standard rooms will sell out before the marketing seminar.

explain.text:
• 考點：語意推論題（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文提及詢問營收總監是否能再降價，結論是 $215 per night is honestly the best we can do，對應 (A) The quoted nightly tariff is not open to further reduction。
• 誘答分析：(C) 混用 noon tomorrow；(B) 反向陷阱，原文明確說套房維持同價；(D) 挪用 marketing seminar。
• 單字補充：tariff (n.) 價目表、費率。

questions.q: What is Ms. Tanaka asked to do by noon tomorrow?
options: Speak directly with the hotel's revenue director
Pay the $215 per night rate for the entire room block
Let the hotel know whether to keep the adjoining suites
Submit a list of executive directors attending the seminar

explain.text:
• 考點：要求回覆事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 call back by noon tomorrow to confirm whether you want those connecting rooms，正解 (C) 改寫為 Let the hotel know whether to keep the adjoining suites。
• 誘答分析：(A) 挪用 revenue director；(D) 挪用 executive directors；(B) 挪用 $215 per night。
• 單字補充：adjoining (adj.) 毗鄰相通的。

questions.q: Who is most likely giving this presentation?
options: A travel reimbursement auditor
A commercial airline ticket agent
A client meeting coordinator
A company purchasing manager

explain.text:
• 考點：說話者身分（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文開頭自稱 corporate procurement officer（企業採購官），對應 (D) A company purchasing manager。
• 誘答分析：(B) 誤以為是航空公司業務；(C) 挪用 client 與 meeting；(A) 過度推論。
• 單字補充：procurement (n.) 採購。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which fare tier does the speaker recommend for employees taking short, unpredictable client trips?
options: Business Premier
Economy Flex
Economy Standard
Economy Lite

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（必須聽線索 + 看票價表）。
• 解析：講者未直接唸出票價等級名稱，僅提示針對臨時變動的短程差旅，應選擇「修改行程免收手續費的經濟艙方案（the economy option that doesn't charge a penalty for itinerary modifications）」。對照圖表，Change Fee: Waived 的經濟艙方案唯有 Economy Flex，故選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(D) 不可改票；(C) 改票需 $75；(A) 為商務艙而非經濟艙方案。
• 單字補充：waive (v.) 免除。

questions.q: What does the speaker say will happen next quarter?
options: Travelers will lose unused credits from canceled tickets.
Business Premier will be restricted to international client trips.
Employees will no longer be charged $75 for seat changes.
Remaining funds from voided bookings will be consolidated for company use.

explain.text:
• 考點：未來政策變動（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 unused travel credits from canceled tickets will automatically be pooled at the corporate level，正解 (D) 改寫為 Remaining funds from voided bookings will be consolidated for company use。
• 誘答分析：(C) 挪用圖表 $75；(A) 反向陷阱，未使用額度是「集中保留」而非「損失」；(B) 挪用 Business Premier。
• 單字補充：consolidate (v.) 合併集中；voided (adj.) 作廢取消的。

questions.q: Who is the speaker addressing?
options: Unpaid event helpers
Panel discussion moderators
Aviation technology exhibitors
VIP pass holders

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾對象（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文開頭感謝大家 volunteering at this year's Aviation Tech Expo，對應 (A) Unpaid event helpers。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆為活動會場內出現的對象，屬身分混淆陷阱。
• 單字補充：volunteer (n./v.) 志工／自願服務。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Where should attendees go if they have not yet received their credentials?
options: Zone B
Zone A
Zone D
Zone C

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（必須聽地點 + 看區域表）。
• 解析：講者未直接唸出區域名稱，僅指示尚未領取識別證（badges）的與會者前往 the North Atrium。對照活動地圖表格，North Atrium 對應的是 Zone A，故選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 皆為圖表上的其他區域，但地點與功能皆不符。
• 單字補充：credential (n.) 證件、識別證。

questions.q: What is scheduled to take place at 5:30 P.M.?
options: An evening social gathering for special pass holders
Doors opening at the North Atrium
A closing tour of the Main Exhibition Hall
A panel discussion on the Mezzanine Level

explain.text:
• 考點：活動時間細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 evening reception will take place at 5:30 P.M. 並針對 VIP 通行證持有者，正解 (A) 改寫為 An evening social gathering for special pass holders。
• 誘答分析：(B) 開門時間為 9:00 A.M.，與 North Atrium 混用；(D) 挪用 Mezzanine Level 與 panel discussion；(C) 挪用 Main Exhibition Hall。
• 單字補充：social gathering (n.) 社交聚會／酒會。

questions.q: All international passengers must present a valid passport and boarding pass ------- entering the security screening area.
options: regardless of
in spite of
prior to
as soon as

explain.text:
prior to
• 考點：介系詞片語辨析。
• 解析：空格後接動名詞 entering，需填入介系詞。"prior to + V-ing" 表「在……之前」，符合「進入安檢區前須出示護照與登機證」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 儘管；(D) 一……就（為連接詞，後須接完整子句）；(A) 不論。
• 單字補充：screening area (n.) 安檢區。

questions.q: The Silvercrest Grand Hotel recently underwent a multimillion-dollar ------- to modernize its conference suites and rooftop lounge.
options: renovated
renovation
renovate
renovating

explain.text:
renovation
• 考點：詞性判斷（名詞）。
• 解析：空格前有不定冠詞 a 與複合形容詞 multimillion-dollar，故需填入單數可數名詞 renovation（翻新工程）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 動詞原形；(A) 過去分詞／形容詞；(D) 動名詞／現在分詞。
• 單字補充：modernize (v.) 使現代化。

questions.q: ------- the severe winter storm across the Midwest, Meridian Airlines managed to operate 88 percent of its scheduled departures on time.
options: Whereas
Notwithstanding
Provided that
Even though

explain.text:
Notwithstanding
• 考點：讓步介系詞與連接詞區分。
• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 the severe winter storm across the Midwest，故需選用介系詞。Notwithstanding 表「儘管、雖然」，等於 Despite / In spite of。
• 誘答分析：(C) 倘若（連接詞）；(A) 然而（連接詞）；(D) 雖然（連接詞，後接完整子句）。
• 單字補充：scheduled departure (n.) 預定出發班機。

questions.q: Conference attendees who register before October 15 are ------- for a complimentary harbor dinner cruise.
options: fluent
reluctant
comparative
eligible

explain.text:
eligible
• 考點：形容詞字彙與固定搭配（be eligible for）。
• 解析：be eligible for + 名詞 為多益極高頻搭配，意為「有資格獲得……」。
• 誘答分析：(C) 比較的；(A) 流利的；(B) 不情願的。
• 單字補充：complimentary (adj.) 免費招待的。

questions.q: Ms. Alvarez requested that the catering team ------- the vegetarian entrees separately from the seafood dishes during the banquet.
options: served
serving
serve
serves

explain.text:
serve
• 考點：假設語氣／要求動詞後之原形動詞（Subjunctive）。
• 解析：主要子句動詞為 requested，其後的 that 名詞子句應使用 (should) + 原形動詞，故選 serve。
• 誘答分析：(D) 第三人稱單數現在式；(A) 過去式；(B) 動名詞。
• 單字補充：entree (n.) 主菜（美式用法）。

questions.q: Because the convention shuttle runs every twenty minutes, travelers rarely experience ------- delays between the terminal and downtown hotels.
options: prolonged
prolonging
prolong
prolongation

explain.text:
prolonged
• 考點：分詞形容詞。
• 解析：空格修飾複數名詞 delays，prolonged 表「長時間的、拖延的」，符合語意。
• 誘答分析：(C) 動詞「延長」；(B) 現在分詞表「正在延長某物」；(D) 名詞「延長」。
• 單字補充：terminal (n.) 航廈。

questions.q: Had the travel coordinator booked the group airfare earlier, the company ------- nearly $4,200 in peak-season surcharges.
options: would save
would have saved
will save
has saved

explain.text:
would have saved
• 考點：與過去事實相反的假設語氣倒裝（Had + S + Vpp..., S + would have Vpp）。
• 解析：句首 Had the travel coordinator booked... 為 If the travel coordinator had booked... 的倒裝，與過去事實相反，主句應搭配 would have saved。
• 誘答分析：(C) 未來式；(A) 與現在事實相反；(D) 現在完成式。
• 單字補充：surcharge (n.) 額外費用、附加費。

questions.q: Please ensure that all audiovisual equipment is ------- tested at least two hours prior to the keynote speaker's arrival.
options: thoroughness
thoroughly
more thorough
thorough

explain.text:
thoroughly
• 考點：副詞修飾動詞（過去分詞）。
• 解析：空格位於 is 與過去分詞 tested 之間，須用副詞 thoroughly（徹底地）修飾 tested。
• 誘答分析：(D) 形容詞；(A) 名詞；(C) 形容詞比較級。
• 單字補充：audiovisual (adj.) 視聽的。

questions.q: The boutique resort offers tailored wellness retreats ------- to executives seeking quiet accommodations away from urban noise.
options: catered
to cater
catering
having catered

explain.text:
catering
• 考點：分詞片語作後位修飾（主動語態）。
• 解析：retreats（靜修營／療癒行程）主動「迎合、滿足」（cater to）高階主管的需求，故用現在分詞 catering（相當於 which cater to...）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 過去分詞表被動，但 cater to 為不及物動詞片語，不可用被動修飾 retreats。
• 單字補充：tailored (adj.) 量身打造的；cater to (phr.) 迎合、服務。

questions.q: Under the revised corporate expense policy, employees must submit ------- receipts for any business meal exceeding $35.
options: unanimous
designated
obsolete
itemized

explain.text:
itemized
• 考點：差旅字彙辨析。
• 解析：itemized receipt 意為「分項明細收據」，為企業報帳必備單據。
• 誘答分析：(B) 指定的；(A) 一致通過的；(C) 過時的。
• 單字補充：exceed (v.) 超過。

questions.q: ------- their flight from Frankfurt was delayed by three hours, the engineering delegation still arrived in time for the opening reception.
options: Despite
Although
In case
Because of

explain.text:
Although
• 考點：從屬連接詞（讓步）。
• 解析：空格後接完整子句 their flight from Frankfurt was delayed...，且前後語意轉折，故選連接詞 Although。
• 誘答分析：(A) Despite 與 (D) Because of 皆為介系詞，後不可接完整子句；(C) In case 表「萬一」。
• 單字補充：delegation (n.) 代表團。

questions.q: The airline's loyalty program allows members to ------- accumulated mileage toward cabin upgrades, hotel stays, and car rentals.
options: concede
abstain
preside
redeem

explain.text:
redeem
• 考點：動詞字彙（航空哩程兌換）。
• 解析：redeem 意為「兌換（點數、哩程、優惠券）」，搭配 accumulated mileage toward...（將累積哩程兌換為……）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 承認、讓步；(C) 主持；(B) 棄權、戒除。
• 單字補充：accumulated mileage (n.) 累積哩程。

questions.q: Neither the event director nor the venue coordinators ------- notified about the sudden change in the keynote speaker's travel itinerary.
options: has been
were
was
is being

explain.text:
were
• 考點：對等連接詞主謂一致（Neither A nor B）。
• 解析：Neither A nor B 作主詞時，動詞單複數依最接近的 B 決定。the venue coordinators 為複數，且為被動語態（be notified），故選 were。
• 誘答分析：(C)、(A)、(D) 皆為單數動詞。
• 單字補充：notify (v.) 通知。

questions.q: Guests staying on the executive floor enjoy ------- access to the private sky lounge, which serves refreshments throughout the day.
options: exclusion
exclude
exclusive
exclusively

explain.text:
exclusive
• 考點：形容詞修飾名詞（專屬的）。
• 解析：空格後為名詞 access，exclusive access 意為「專屬使用權／通行權」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 動詞；(A) 名詞；(D) 副詞。
• 單字補充：refreshment (n.) 茶點、點心。

questions.q: The exhibition hall's floor plan was redesigned so that visitors could ------- navigate between the main stage and the vendor booths.
options: efforts
effort
effortlessly
effortless

explain.text:
effortlessly
• 考點：副詞修飾動詞。
• 解析：空格位於助動詞 could 與原形動詞 navigate 之間，須填入副詞 effortlessly（毫不費力地）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 形容詞；(B)/(A) 名詞。
• 單字補充：floor plan (n.) 樓層平面圖。

questions.q: ------- the keynote address concludes at 4:00 P.M., a panel discussion on sustainable aviation fuel will begin in Room 204.
options: Once
Unless
Until
While

explain.text:
Once
• 考點：時間連接詞（一旦……就……）。
• 解析：題意為「一旦主題演講於下午四點結束，關於永續航空燃料的座談會就會在 204 室開始」，選 Once 最精準。
• 誘答分析：(B) 除非；(C) 直到；(D) 當……之時（不合結束後緊接開始的邏輯）。
• 單字補充：sustainable aviation fuel (n.) 永續航空燃料（SAF）。

questions.q: The hospitality group plans to expand its ------- of luxury seaside properties across Southeast Asia over the next five years.
options: portfolio
transcript
itinerary
curriculum

explain.text:
portfolio
• 考點：商業與旅宿字彙。
• 解析：portfolio of properties 指飯店集團旗下的「物業投資組合／旗下飯店陣容」。
• 誘答分析：(C) 行程表；(D) 課程綱要；(B) 文字稿／成績單。
• 單字補充：seaside property (n.) 海濱度假物業。

questions.q: ------- in the historic district, the newly restored Savoy Inn provides convenient walking access to major museums and theaters.
options: To situate
Situates
Situating
Situated

explain.text:
Situated
• 考點：分詞構句（表示地點）。
• 解析：be situated in...（位於……）省略主詞與 be 動詞後，保留過去分詞 Situated 置於句首修飾主詞 the newly restored Savoy Inn。
• 誘答分析：(C) 主動分詞不合邏輯；(A) 不定詞表目的，不合句意；(B) 動詞單數形無法連接主句。
• 單字補充：historic district (n.) 歷史街區。

questions.q: Passengers traveling with oversized musical instruments must make special ------- with the cargo desk at least 48 hours in advance.
options: arrange
arrangements
arranged
arranging

explain.text:
arrangements
• 考點：固定搭配名詞（make arrangements）。
• 解析：make special arrangements with... 意為「與……做特別安排」，為慣用複數名詞搭配。
• 誘答分析：(C) 過去分詞；(D) 動名詞；(A) 原形動詞。
• 單字補充：cargo desk (n.) 貨運／特殊行李櫃檯。

questions.q: The convention's organizing committee expressed ------- appreciation to the volunteers who staffed the information desks all weekend.
options: sincere
sincerity
sincerely
more sincerely

explain.text:
sincere
• 考點：形容詞修飾名詞。
• 解析：空格修飾名詞 appreciation，sincere appreciation（誠摯的謝意）為標準搭配。
• 誘答分析：(C)/(D) 副詞；(B) 名詞。
• 單字補充：organizing committee (n.) 籌備委員會。

questions.q: ------- of the high-speed rail link between the airport and the financial center has significantly reduced commute times for visiting executives.
options: Completing
Complete
Completion
Completely

explain.text:
Completion
• 考點：名詞作主詞。
• 解析：空格位於句首且後接 of the high-speed rail link，主句動詞為 has significantly reduced，需名詞 Completion（完工）作主詞。
• 誘答分析：(B) 形容詞／動詞；(D) 副詞；(A) 動名詞後通常直接接受詞，不接 of。
• 單字補充：commute time (n.) 通勤時間。

questions.q: If your connecting flight is canceled due to inclement weather, our customer care agents will rebook you ------- extra charge.
options: at no
in no
by no
on no

explain.text:
at no
• 考點：固定介系詞片語（at no extra charge）。
• 解析：at no extra charge 為「不另收費、免費」的固定商業用語。
• 誘答分析：(C)、(B)、(D) 介系詞皆不與 extra charge 搭配。
• 單字補充：inclement weather (n.) 惡劣天候。

questions.q: The hotel's concierge desk is staffed round the clock to ------- guests with restaurant reservations, theater tickets, and private transfers.
options: consist
insist
persist
assist

explain.text:
assist
• 考點：動詞字彙與搭配（assist A with B）。
• 解析：assist guests with... 意為「協助房客處理……」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 堅持（常接 on）；(A) 由……組成（of）；(C) 持續、堅持（in）。
• 單字補充：round the clock (phr.) 24 小時全天候。

questions.q: The event planners ------- reviewed the final catering invoice before discovering that the banquet hall had billed them for thirty extra place settings.
options: carefully
careful
carefulness
care

explain.text:
carefully
• 考點：詞性判斷（副詞修飾動詞）。
• 解析：空格位於主詞 The event planners 與過去式動詞 reviewed 之間，須填入副詞 carefully（仔細地）修飾動詞 reviewed。
• 誘答分析：(B) careful 為形容詞；(D) care 為名詞或動詞；(C) carefulness 為名詞。
• 單字補充：place setting (n.) 餐桌上的個人餐具組（或計費人頭份數）。

questions.q: The regional aviation authority issued stricter ------- regarding lithium battery storage in checked luggage following last month's audit.
options: directives
premises
prospects
intervals

explain.text:
directives
• 考點：名詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：航管局針對託運行李鋰電池發布更嚴格的「指令／規範」（directives）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 間隔；(B) 營業場所／前提；(C) 前景。
• 單字補充：lithium battery (n.) 鋰電池。

questions.q: Frequent travelers who enroll in the automated border clearance program can bypass standard immigration queues ------- at twelve participating airports.
options: all together
although
almost
altogether

explain.text:
altogether
• 考點：易混淆副詞辨析（altogether vs. all together）。
• 解析：altogether 意為「完全地、徹底地」（completely），修飾 bypass standard immigration queues（完全免去排一般入境隊伍）。
• 誘答分析：(A) all together 指「全體一起」；(B) 雖然（連接詞）；(C) 幾乎。
• 單字補充：border clearance (n.) 邊境通關。

questions.q: Mr. Kobayashi's presentation on hotel revenue management was ------- well received that the conference organizers invited him back next year.
options: such
so
too
very

explain.text:
so
• 考點：結果子句句型（so + adv. + that...）。
• 解析：well received 為「副詞＋過去分詞（形容詞性）」結構，應搭配 so 形成 so well received that...。
• 誘答分析：(A) such 後須接名詞片語；(D)/(C) very 與 too 不可與 that 結果子句連用。
• 單字補充：revenue management (n.) 收益管理。

questions.q: All exhibitor booths must be completely dismantled and cleared from the exhibition floor ------- 8:00 P.M. on Sunday.
options: by
throughout
until
within

explain.text:
by
• 考點：時間介系詞（by vs. until）。
• 解析：dismantled and cleared（拆除並清空）為一次性完成的截止動作，須搭配表「最遲在……之前」的 by。
• 誘答分析：(C) until 搭配持續性動作；(D) within 後接「一段時間」；(B) throughout 表「貫穿整個期間」。
• 單字補充：dismantle (v.) 拆除、拆解。

questions.q: The airline's newly appointed CEO emphasized that punctuality and transparent communication remain ------- to rebuilding passenger trust.
options: redundant
tentative
paramount
adjacent

explain.text:
paramount
• 考點：高階形容詞字彙。
• 解析：paramount 意為「至關重要的、首要的」，搭配 remain paramount to...。
• 誘答分析：(A) 多餘的；(B) 暫定的；(D) 鄰近的。
• 單字補充：punctuality (n.) 準時。

questions.q: ------- whether the trade delegation arrives on Tuesday or Wednesday, the protocol office has reserved suites at the Regent Plaza for the entire week.
options: Even if
On behalf of
In addition to
Regardless of

explain.text:
Regardless of
• 考點：介系詞片語接名詞子句（whether... or...）。
• 解析：Regardless of whether A or B 意為「無論是 A 還是 B」，接 whether 引導的名詞子句。
• 誘答分析：(A) Even if 後不接 whether；(C) 除了……之外；(B) 代表……。
• 單字補充：protocol office (n.) 禮賓辦公室。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: Among
Throughout
Beside
Toward

explain.text:
Throughout
• 考點：時間介系詞。
• 解析：指「在這個為期六個月的工程期間」，使用 Throughout（貫穿整個……期間）最貼切。
• 誘答分析：(A) 在……之中；(C) 在……旁邊；(D) 朝向。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: Signage has been posted along all concourses to guide travelers to the new counters.
The airport's duty-free shops will extend their operating hours until midnight.
Checked baggage allowances will remain unchanged for international routes.
Parking fees in the long-term garage are discounted for loyalty members.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題（語意連貫）。
• 解析：前句提醒旅客提早兩半小時抵達（因櫃檯搬遷至第一航廈 C 區），後句說明航廈間免費接駁車。(A)「所有大廳均已設置指示牌引導旅客前往新櫃檯」完美銜接報到指引。
• 誘答分析：(C) 託運行李額度、(B) 免稅店營業時間、(D) 長期停車費皆偏離櫃檯搬遷主題。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).
options: regret
regrettably
regretful
regretting

explain.text:
regret
• 考點：動詞時態與詞性。
• 解析：主詞為 We，與對等動詞 and appreciate 並列，須用現在簡單式原形動詞 regret（對……深表遺憾／抱歉）。
• 單字補充：temporary adjustment (n.) 暫時性調整。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).
options: consultation
consult
consulted
consulting

explain.text:
consult
• 考點：祈使句動詞原形。
• 解析：please 後接原形動詞 consult（查閱）。
• 單字補充：real-time (adj.) 即時的。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).
options: In contrast
By means of
In addition
On account

explain.text:
In addition
• 考點：轉折語與固定搭配（In addition to）。
• 解析：空格後已有 to，In addition to（除了……之外）符合「除了每日折扣房價，還包含免費 Wi-Fi 與早餐」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 相較之下（與 to 連用表對比，不合語意）；(B) 藉由（接 of）；(D) 因為（接 of）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: Several regional offices have already exceeded their Q2 travel budgets.
Employees must submit expense reports within ten business days of returning.
These negotiated benefits are expected to save the firm over $180,000 annually.
The previous contract with Harbourfront Inn expired at the end of last year.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：本段列舉各項企業協議優惠，結尾處 (C)「這些議定的福利預計每年為公司節省超過 18 萬美元」自然總結合作案的財務效益。
• 誘答分析：(D) 舊約過期、(A) 預算超支、(B) 報帳期限皆與該段主旨不符。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).
options: eligible
ineligible
eligibility
eligibly

explain.text:
eligible
• 考點：詞性與語意（not be eligible for）。
• 解析：句中已有 not，故需肯定形容詞 eligible（有資格的），構成「將不具備資格享有優惠」。
• 誘答分析：(B) ineligible 若填入會造成雙重否定，語意相反。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).
options: from
onto
with
for

explain.text:
for
• 考點：介系詞搭配（for assistance）。
• 解析：contact [某人/單位] for assistance（聯繫……尋求協助）為固定用法。
• 單字補充：direct billing (n.) 公司直接掛帳付款。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (139).
options: Owing
Due
Prior
In addition

explain.text:
In addition
• 考點：介系詞片語（In addition to + 名詞）。
• 解析：空格後是 to traditional lecture formats，In addition to（除了……之外）表示在傳統演講之外，今年再加入互動式圓桌會議，語意通順。
• 誘答分析：(A) Owing to、(B) Due to（由於）因果關係不合；(C) Prior to（在……之前）語意不合。
• 單字補充：roundtable (n.) 圓桌會議；contactless (adj.) 非接觸式的。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).
options: Public transit passes are included with every hotel reservation in the city center.
Local taxi drivers have protested rising fuel prices near the convention district.
Last year's keynote speaker published a bestselling memoir about luxury resorts.
Organizers are also expanding the trade floor to accommodate fifty additional exhibitors.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：空格後緊接著說明 A 館展覽攤位已售出 95%，(D)「主辦單位也正擴大展覽區以容納額外五十家參展商」直接帶出攤位熱銷的上下文。
• 誘答分析：(B) 計程車抗議、(C) 講者回憶錄、(A) 交通卡優惠皆無關展覽攤位。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (141).
options: uninvited
unfulfilled
unprecedented
unintended

explain.text:
unprecedented
• 考點：形容詞字彙。
• 解析：配合攤位售出 95%，unprecedented interest 意為「前所未有的濃厚興趣」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 未受邀的；(D) 無意的；(B) 未實現的。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (142).
options: since
during
until
between

explain.text:
until
• 考點：時間介系詞（截止日期）。
• 解析：remain open until October 10（早鳥優惠開放至十月十日止）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 自從（須配完成式）；(B) 在……期間（後接時段而非特定日期）；(D) 在……之間（需有 and）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (143).
options: appeal
adhere
assign
adapt

explain.text:
adhere
• 考點：動詞搭配（adhere to）。
• 解析：adhere strictly to [protocol/rules] 意為「嚴格遵守規定」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 呼籲／吸引；(C) 指派；(D) 適應。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (144).
options: The hotel's main dining room will close at 10:30 P.M. on Sundays.
This separation prevents accidental cross-contamination during peak service hours.
Our pastry chef recently won a national award for artisan sourdough bread.
Guests may request a copy of the wine list from their table server.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：前句規定過敏原餐點必須在專用區使用分色廚具製作，(B)「這項區隔可防止尖峰出餐時段發生意外交叉污染」解釋該規定的目的。
• 單字補充：cross-contamination (n.) 交叉污染。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (145).
options: Furthermore
Nevertheless
Consequently
Otherwise

explain.text:
Furthermore
• 考點：連接副詞（遞進補充）。
• 解析：前段講廚房端查核貼標籤，本句補充外場服務生上菜前的口頭確認步驟，故用 Furthermore（此外）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 因此；(D) 否則；(B) 然而。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (146).
options: optional
temporary
voluntary
compulsory

explain.text:
compulsory
• 考點：形容詞字彙（強制性的）。
• 解析：前句提到 A mandatory 30-minute refresher training session（強制性複訓），故此處同義替換為 compulsory（強制的、必修的）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 選修的；(B) 暫時的；(C) 自願的。

questions.q: Who is permitted to enter the lounge with Ms. Rostova using this pass?
options: Multiple guests holding same-day boarding passes
Any frequent flyer departing on December 31
A single traveling companion sharing her itinerary
Any SkyAlliance partner carrier employee

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：條款第一點寫道 named pass holder plus one accompanying guest traveling on the same flight，正解 (C) 將 one accompanying guest 替換為 A single traveling companion，on the same flight 替換為 sharing her itinerary。
• 誘答分析：(D) 混用 SkyAlliance partner carrier；(B) 混用 December 31（效期而非限定出發日）；(A) 原文限帶「一位」同行者，非多位。
• 單字補充：accompanying (adj.) 隨行的；itinerary (n.) 行程。

questions.q: What is stated about the lounge's shower suites?
options: They are assigned in the order travelers request them.
They must be reserved at the reception desk prior to arrival.
They are excluded from complimentary single-day admission.
They cannot be used by passengers flying on SkyAlliance partners.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：條款最後一點指出淋浴間採 first-come, first-served basis，正解 (A) 改寫為 assigned in the order travelers request them（依旅客抵達／請求順序分配）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 原文是入場時於櫃檯詢問，無須事前預約；(D) 原文說明搭乘合作航空亦可使用貴賓室；(C) 原文為 Complimentary（免費）。
• 單字補充：first-come, first-served (phr.) 先到先得。

questions.q: Why was the freight truck initially stopped at Gate 4?
options: The display panels were shipped to the wrong venue gate.
Marcus arrived at Gate 4 before 10:12 A.M. without his tablet.
Gate personnel lacked documentation authorizing the delivery.
The Expo Operations Office had not yet issued the PDF permit.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：Marcus 說 venue security guard says our unloading permit isn't on his list，正解 (C) 改寫為 Gate personnel lacked documentation authorizing the delivery。
• 誘答分析：(D) Priya 昨天下午就已收到 PDF 許可證；(B) Marcus 有帶平板（Priya 說寄給他用平板出示）；(A) 地點就是 Gate 4，問題出在名單未更新。
• 單字補充：authorize (v.) 授權核准。

questions.q: What does Priya instruct Marcus to do about the carpet?
options: Ask the Expo Operations Office to swap it out tomorrow morning
Adjust the lighting rig so the navy blue color stands out
Reject the shipment and install only the main banner
Retain the delivered flooring despite the unexpected shade

explain.text:
• 考點：行動指示（同義替換）。
• 解析：Priya 說 No, keep it... there isn't time to swap it out，雖然顏色是深灰而非海軍藍，仍決定留用，正解 (D) 改寫為 Retain the delivered flooring despite the unexpected shade。
• 誘答分析：(A) 與原文「沒時間更換」相反；(B) 燈光是用來打亮主橫幅（highlights our main banner），非改變地毯顏色；(C) 混用 reject 與 main banner。
• 單字補充：shade (n.) 色調。

questions.q: What must guests do to qualify for the complimentary tea ceremony?
options: Request a round-trip taxi transfer from Kyoto Station
Schedule an uninterrupted multi-night stay prior to October
Enter promo code MERIDIAN26 at the hotel front desk upon arrival
Dine at Chef Haruka Mori's dining room during the inaugural season

explain.text:
• 考點：條件細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 book a minimum stay of three consecutive nights before September 30，正解 (B) 將 three consecutive nights 改寫為 uninterrupted multi-night stay，before September 30 改寫為 prior to October。
• 誘答分析：(A) 計程車接送是贈品而非條件；(D) 混用 Chef Haruka Mori；(C) 優惠碼須於官網（via our website）預訂使用，非抵達櫃檯才輸入。
• 單字補充：consecutive (adj.) 連續的；uninterrupted (adj.) 不間斷的。

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of The Meridian Kyoto?
options: A traditional wooden soaking area
An elevated exercise facility
Locally sourced culinary offerings
Minimalist guest accommodations

explain.text:
• 考點：NOT 題（同義替換排除法）。
• 解析：(A) 對應 cedar-wood public bath；(C) 對應 farm-to-table dining room；(D) 對應 64 minimalist suites；唯有 (B) elevated exercise facility（頂樓健身中心）全文未提。
• 誘答分析：本題每個正確提及的選項皆經過同義改寫，測試考生能否精準對應原文設施。
• 單字補充：minimalist (adj.) 極簡主義的。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this email?
options: To outline itinerary arrangements and administrative deadlines for a presenter
To invite Mr. Vance to join the "Digital Innovation in Business Travel" session
To ask Mr. Vance to submit itemized receipts for his Alpine Palace stay
To confirm that Mr. Vance's flight from Boston has been upgraded to business class

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題（上位概念替換）。
• 解析：信件通知機票代碼、住宿安排、上傳簡報期限及交通費報銷期限，正解 (A) 改寫為 outline itinerary arrangements and administrative deadlines for a presenter。
• 誘答分析：(B) 原文開頭感謝他「已同意擔任講者」，非邀請；(C) 原文明確指出客房服務等雜費須自付，報銷的是地面交通費；(D) 機票為 economy-plus，非商務艙。
• 單字補充：secretariat (n.) 秘書處。

questions.q: What expense will Mr. Vance have to pay for himself if incurred?
options: Accommodations at the Alpine Palace from May 13 to 16
Airport rail tickets submitted within 14 days
Economy-plus airfare under code ZR-7741
Optional personal amenities billed to his room

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 incidental charges such as room service will require a personal credit card，正解 (D) 改寫為 Optional personal amenities billed to his room。
• 誘答分析：(C) 機票已開立；(A) 住宿費由講者保留房涵蓋；(B) 機場鐵路等地面交通費保留收據即可報銷。
• 單字補充：incidental charges (n.) 雜支費用；amenity (n.) 便利設施／服務。

questions.q: By what date must Mr. Vance upload his slides?
options: April 8
May 7
May 13
May 14

explain.text:
• 考點：時間細節。
• 解析：原文 upload their presentation slides to the speaker portal no later than May 7，故選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 為發信日；(C) 為入住日；(D) 為議程當日。
• 單字補充：compatibility (n.) 相容性。

questions.q: Why is Skyway Express updating its cabin baggage policy?
options: To establish uniform compartment sizing for a particular aircraft model
To reduce the number of bags placed in the aircraft hold
To require all Basic Economy passengers to purchase Cabin Plus
To restrict personal items to a 10-kilogram weight limit

explain.text:
• 考點：目的題（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 standardize overhead bin space across our Airbus A321neo fleet，正解 (A) 改寫為 establish uniform compartment sizing for a particular aircraft model。
• 誘答分析：(D) 10 公斤是標準登機箱上限，非隨身物品；(C) Cabin Plus 為選購升級；(B) 過度推論。
• 單字補充：uniform (adj.) 統一的；compartment (n.) 置物空間。

questions.q: What happens if a Basic Economy passenger brings a full-sized carry-on to the gate without an upgrade?
options: They must pay $28 to store it beneath the seat in front of them.
They are denied boarding unless they purchase a Cabin Plus ticket.
They are permitted to place it in the overhead bin for $65.
They face a higher surcharge and mandatory cargo stowage.

explain.text:
• 考點：條件推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 incur a $65 gate-handling fee and must be placed in the aircraft hold，正解 (D) 改寫為 face a higher surcharge and mandatory cargo stowage（相較線上 $28 升級，現場 $65 為較高附加費且強制入貨艙）。
• 誘答分析：(A) $28 是線上升級費，且大型手提箱放不下座位下；(C) 混用 $65 與頭頂置物櫃；(B) 未提及拒載。
• 單字補充：surcharge (n.) 附加費；cargo hold (n.) 貨艙。

questions.q: When is the latest a traveler can buy a Cabin Plus upgrade online?
options: Four hours prior to scheduled takeoff
Within four hours after booking Basic Economy
Any time before November 1
Upon arriving at the boarding gate

explain.text:
• 考點：時間細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 online up to four hours before departure，正解 (A) 改寫為 Four hours prior to scheduled takeoff。
• 誘答分析：(D) 登機門無法用 $28 買升級；(C) 11/1 是新制生效日；(B) 誤解「四小時」的基準點。
• 單字補充：prior to (prep.) 在……之前。

questions.q: Why did Jonathan K. visit the city?
options: To host an early morning seminar at a local café
To conduct a rush-hour traffic study on the waterfront boulevard
To evaluate the mobile key feature at the Harborview Grand
To participate in a nearby commercial shipping conference

explain.text:
• 考點：來訪目的（上位概念替換）。
• 解析：原文 attending the Maritime Logistics Expo nearby，正解 (D) 改寫為 participate in a nearby commercial shipping conference。
• 誘答分析：(B) 挪用 rush hour 與 waterfront boulevard；(C) mobile key 是入住體驗而非來訪目的；(A) 挪用 early morning seminar 與 café。
• 單字補充：maritime (adj.) 海運的、海事的。

questions.q: What aspect of the hotel did Jonathan praise?
options: The quietness of the café across from the west entrance
A staff member's willingness to assist with urgent printing
The twenty-minute coffee service in the executive dining area
The variety of hot trays served to tour groups on Tuesday

explain.text:
• 考點：正面評價細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 the concierge went out of his way to print last-minute presentation handouts for me at 6:30 A.M.，正解 (B) 改寫為 A staff member's willingness to assist with urgent printing。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D) 原文抱怨咖啡等了 20 分鐘且熱食盤空著；(A) 咖啡廳是對面店家，非飯店本身。
• 單字補充：go out of one's way (phr.) 特地、不辭辛勞。

questions.q: What caused the problem at the breakfast buffet on Tuesday?
options: A sudden surge of group diners overwhelmed limited personnel.
The kitchen ran out of fresh pastries and made-to-order omelets.
An early morning seminar delayed the concierge's shift.
The mobile key system prevented guests from entering on time.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 severely understaffed on Tuesday morning when two large tour groups arrived simultaneously，正解 (A) 改寫為 A sudden surge of group diners overwhelmed limited personnel。
• 誘答分析：(D) mobile key 在入住時表現順暢；(B) 麵包與歐姆蛋文中稱讚美味；(C) 過度推論。
• 單字補充：surge (n.) 湧入、激增；personnel (n.) 人員。

questions.q: What is the main topic of the article?
options: A RATA report criticizing boarding delays in Austin and Portland
Why major international hubs spent five years testing facial-recognition gates
Growing implementation of automated identity-scan boarding at smaller airfields
New 24-hour privacy regulations enforced by North American airlines

explain.text:
• 考點：文章主旨（同義替換）。
• 解析：首段指出 mid-sized regional airports are now rapidly adopting similar biometric boarding systems，正解 (C) 改寫為 Growing implementation of automated identity-scan boarding at smaller airfields。
• 誘答分析：(B) 僅為首句對比背景；(A) Austin 與 Portland 試驗顯示登機變快而非延誤；(D) 隱私倡議者是「呼籲」而非「強制執法」。
• 單字補充：implementation (n.) 實施、導入。

questions.q: According to Victor Morales, what has made biometric systems more affordable for smaller airports?
options: Internet-hosted licensing arrangements that reduce initial equipment outlays
Shared hardware trials conducted in Austin and Portland
A 60 percent government subsidy from RATA
A 42 percent reduction in passenger processing times

explain.text:
• 考點：引述細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：Victor Morales 指出 cloud-based software subscriptions have lowered upfront hardware expenses by nearly 60 percent，正解 (A) 改寫為 Internet-hosted licensing arrangements that reduce initial equipment outlays。
• 誘答分析：(D) 42% 是計畫導入機場的比例；(B) 試驗顯示時間從 28 分縮短至 16 分；(C) 60% 是硬體成本降幅，非政府補助。
• 單字補充：outlay (n.) 支出、開銷。

questions.q: What concern do privacy advocates raise?
options: Upfront hardware expenses may rise over the next 18 months.
Cloud-based subscriptions could expose airport schedules to the public.
Traveler biometric records should be purged shortly after flights leave.
Automated boarding lanes may take longer than 28 minutes for large planes.

explain.text:
• 考點：隱私顧慮（同義替換）。
• 解析：末句指出隱私倡議者呼籲 passenger facial templates are automatically deleted within 24 hours of flight departure，正解 (C) 改寫為 Traveler biometric records should be purged shortly after flights leave。
• 誘答分析：(A) 與原文成本下降 60% 相反；(D) 試驗結果顯示登機時間縮短；(B) 過度推論。
• 單字補充：purge (v.) 清除、刪除。

questions.q: Why is the company dividing the sales team into two shifts?
options: To give Group B extra time to book flights through Concur
To reduce booth coverage on April 15 by 25 percent
To ensure all eight representatives work together on April 14 and April 16
To maximize mid-event staffing while cutting lodging and meal expenditures

explain.text:
• 考點：政策目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 ensures strong booth coverage on our busiest day (April 15) while trimming hotel and per diem costs by 25 percent，正解 (D) 改寫為 maximize mid-event staffing while cutting lodging and meal expenditures。
• 誘答分析：(C) 兩組僅在 4/15 重疊；(B) 25% 是省下的費用比例；(A) 過度推論。
• 單字補充：per diem (n.) 每日津貼（餐旅費）。

questions.q: What problem occurred after the previous quarter's trade show?
options: Late lead-data submission slowed down outreach to potential clients.
Per diem expenses exceeded the 25 percent corporate limit.
Sales representatives forgot to scan badges at the booth.
Inside sales staff failed to attend the event in Chicago.

explain.text:
• 考點：過去問題細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 delayed data entry meant our inside sales team could not follow up with hot prospects until nearly a week after，正解 (A) 改寫為 Late lead-data submission slowed down outreach to potential clients。
• 誘答分析：(C) 有掃描但延遲上傳；(D) 內勤銷售本來就負責會後追蹤；(B) 25% 是本季預期省下的費用。
• 單字補充：outreach (n.) 聯繫開發；prospect (n.) 潛在客戶。

questions.q: What are sales representatives instructed to do by March 13?
options: Arrange air travel via the company's designated booking platform
Submit hotel receipts to Trevor Hayes
Upload their badge scans into the CRM mobile app
Confirm whether they are assigned to Group A or Group B

explain.text:
• 考點：行動指示（同義替換）。
• 解析：末句指示 book your flights through Concur by Friday, March 13，正解 (A) 改寫為 Arrange air travel via the company's designated booking platform。
• 誘答分析：(C) CRM 上傳是展期每晚九點前；(D)(B) 皆未要求於 3/13 前回報。
• 單字補充：designated (adj.) 指定的。

questions.q: What is the purpose of Nadia Patel's email?
options: To announce that The Coastal Pavilion won Thursday's committee vote
To ask the committee to conduct site visits in Lake Tahoe and Monterey
To confirm that the deposit contract for Pinecrest Lodge has been signed
To evaluate two shortlisted retreat sites ahead of a group decision

explain.text:
• 考點：寫信目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：信件比較兩間最終入圍場地，並請委員會於週四會議投票，正解 (D) 改寫為 evaluate two shortlisted retreat sites ahead of a group decision。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C) 尚未投票也尚未簽約；(B) 實地參訪上週已完成。
• 單字補充：shortlisted (adj.) 入圍最終名單的。

questions.q: What is mentioned as a drawback of Pinecrest Lodge?
options: It has limited medium-sized meeting spaces and requires a lengthy airport commute.
Its five breakout rooms have not been renovated yet.
Meals and kayaking excursions are billed separately from the $310 rate.
It cannot accommodate 120 attendees for overnight lodging.

explain.text:
• 考點：缺點細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文指出 Pinecrest Lodge 距離主要機場有一小時車程，且只有兩間可容納 40 人的分組會議室，正解 (A) 改寫為 limited medium-sized meeting spaces and requires a lengthy airport commute。
• 誘答分析：(C) $310 為全包價（含餐與划船）；(B) 五間翻新分組室是 The Coastal Pavilion 的優點；(D) 兩間場地皆可容納 120 人。
• 單字補充：commute (n.) 通勤路程。

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Both venues have confirmed availability for our preferred dates of October 19–21."

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。
• 解析：插入句說明「兩間場地皆已確認 10/19–21 有空檔」，緊接在第一段點出兩間最終候選場地（[1]）之後最為連貫，作為進入個別優缺點比較前的共同前提。
• 誘答分析：[2]、[3]、[4] 皆已進入單一場地的細節比較，插入句討論「Both venues」不合邏輯。
• 單字補充：availability (n.) 可預訂空檔。

questions.q: When does Nadia want the committee to make its final selection?
options: Immediately after reviewing the site visits from last week
During a scheduled late-week conference call
After signing the deposit contract on Monday
Before the afternoon strategy workshops begin

explain.text:
• 考點：時間細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 Let's vote during Thursday's 10:00 A.M. call，正解 (B) 改寫為 During a scheduled late-week conference call。
• 誘答分析：(C) 週一是簽訂金合約期限，應在投票之後；(A) 實地參訪是上週的事；(D) 策略工作坊是十月活動內容。
• 單字補充：conference call (n.) 電話會議。

questions.q: What is true about the new Vancouver–Osaka service?
options: It will require travelers from Toronto to re-check luggage at YVR.
It will begin operating daily on June 15.
It will run multiple direct flights each week starting in early September.
It will offer 28 lie-flat suites in the premium economy cabin.

explain.text:
• 考點：新聞細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 four-times-weekly nonstop service... beginning September 2，正解 (C) 改寫為 run multiple direct flights each week starting in early September。
• 誘答分析：(B) 6/15 是雙倍哩程預訂截止日；(A) 明確指出不須在 YVR 重掛行李；(D) 28 個平躺座位屬於商務艙，非豪華經濟艙。
• 單字補充：streamlined (adj.) 流暢簡化的。

questions.q: Who is Henrik Lindqvist?
options: The manager of the Aurora Sky Sanctuary lounge
A technology sector executive based in Osaka
A high-ranking executive at the airline
A tourism board director in western Japan

explain.text:
• 考點：人物身分（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文頭銜為 Aurora Airways Chief Commercial Officer（商務長），正解 (C) 改寫為 A high-ranking executive at the airline。
• 誘答分析：(B) 挪用 technology sector 與 Osaka；(A)(D) 皆為文中其他背景元素之錯置。
• 單字補充：carrier (n.) 航空公司。

questions.q: How can travelers earn double loyalty miles on the new route?
options: By connecting through Toronto, Calgary, or Montreal before September 2
By purchasing tickets prior to mid-June for trips within the promotional window
By reserving one of the 28 lie-flat business suites
By visiting the Aurora Sky Sanctuary lounge at YVR

explain.text:
• 考點：優惠條件（同義替換）。
• 解析：原文 bookings completed before June 15 for travel through December 20，正解 (B) 改寫為 purchasing tickets prior to mid-June for trips within the promotional window。
• 誘答分析：(C) 雙倍哩程適用於所有 YVR–KIX 訂位，不限商務艙；(A) 9/2 是開航日；(D) 貴賓室僅限商務艙旅客，與雙倍哩程無關。
• 單字補充：promotional window (n.) 促銷適用期間。

questions.q: The word "configured" in paragraph 1, line 4, is closest in meaning to
options: delayed
financed
arranged
replaced

explain.text:
• 考點：字彙語境題。
• 解析：configured with 28 lie-flat business suites... 指客機艙位「配置／安排」了不同艙等座位，故選 (C) arranged。
• 誘答分析：(A) 延誤；(D) 替換；(B) 資助，皆不符語境。
• 單字補充：configure (v.) 配置、設定。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of Mr. Gallagher's email?
options: To complain about audiovisual charges at a previous Nexus FinTech dinner
To submit a 20 percent deposit for a November 18 banquet
To reserve the Platinum Tasting menu for 15 VIP executives
To obtain a cost estimate and verify space for a corporate gathering

explain.text:
• 考點：寫信目的（同義替換）。
• 解析：Owen Gallagher 詢問 Starlight Conservatory 是否有空檔，並請求依據 Gold Plated Dinner 方案提供正式報價（formal quote），正解 (D) 改寫為 obtain a cost estimate and verify space for a corporate gathering。
• 誘答分析：(B) 僅詢問是否須付 20% 訂金，尚未付款；(C) 詢問的是 Gold 方案而非 Platinum；(A) 過度推論抱怨過去活動。
• 單字補充：cost estimate (n.) 報價估算。

questions.q: Based on the rate sheet, how much will Nexus FinTech pay for the Starlight Conservatory room rental?

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件計算與條件判斷。
• 解析：郵件指出活動在週三（Wednesday, November 18），預計 110 位賓客；價目表規定 Starlight Conservatory 場租 $1,800，但平日週一至週四（Monday–Thursday）超過 100 人即可免除場租（waived），故場租為 $0。
• 誘答分析：(B) 為視聽設備費；(D) 為未達免租條件時的原價。
• 單字補充：waive (v.) 免除。

questions.q: How much will the Gold Plated Dinner package alone cost for 110 guests?

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件數據計算。
• 解析：Gold Plated Dinner 每位 $115，110 位賓客之餐飲總額為 115 × 110 = $12,650，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 為 Silver Buffet 價格（85 × 110）；(B) 為 100 人價格；(D) 為 Platinum Tasting 價格（165 × 110）。
• 單字補充：plated dinner (n.) 個人位上套餐。

questions.q: Which of Mr. Gallagher's assumptions in his email is incorrect according to the rate sheet?
options: A podium and wireless microphone are included in the audiovisual package.
The Starlight Conservatory can accommodate 110 seated attendees.
The upfront contract payment is one-fifth of the total bill.
Allergen-free meals can be prepared without an extra surcharge.

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件資訊核對（同義替換）。
• 解析：Owen 在信中詢問是否需付 20 percent deposit，但價目表規定需預付 25 percent 訂金。正解 (C) 將 20 percent 改寫為 one-fifth of the total bill（五分之一）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 130 人上限可容納 110 人；(D) 過敏／無麩質餐點免費準備；(A) 講台與無線麥克風確有提供（視聽套裝 $350）。
• 單字補充：one-fifth (n.) 五分之一。

questions.q: By when must Nexus FinTech confirm the 15 special dietary meals to avoid extra charges?
options: No later than seven working days prior to the dinner
Immediately upon receiving the formal quote on September 22
At least 15 business days before Wednesday, November 18
When paying the remaining balance 48 hours before the event

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件時間條件（同義替換）。
• 解析：價目表指出特殊飲食需求須於活動前至少七個工作天確認（at least 7 business days prior to the event），正解 (A) 改寫為 No later than seven working days prior to the dinner。
• 誘答分析：(D) 48 小時前是付清尾款期限；(B) 9/22 是寄信日；(C) 15 是 VIP 人數而非天數。
• 單字補充：working day (n.) 工作日。

questions.q: What does the Kestrel Consulting Group travel policy state about Business Class flights?
options: They are permitted without approval on international flights over 6 hours.
They are limited to long-haul trips and need senior executive sign-off.
They are restricted to flights departing between 11:00 P.M. and 5:00 A.M.
They are reimbursable only when three or more consultants travel together.

explain.text:
• 考點：政策細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：政策規定商務艙 requires prior written approval from a Managing Partner and is restricted to flights over 9 hours，正解 (B) 改寫為 limited to long-haul trips and need senior executive sign-off。
• 誘答分析：(A) 超過 6 小時免核准的是豪華經濟艙（Premium Economy）；(D) 三人同行規定適用於私人轎車接送；(C) 11:00 P.M.–5:00 A.M. 亦為轎車接送條件。
• 單字補充：long-haul (adj.) 長途飛行的；sign-off (n.) 簽核批准。

questions.q: Why was Rachel Kim's hotel stay at the Shinjuku Meridian Hotel approved?
options: A Managing Partner granted an exception for her four-night stay.
Her destination is a top-tier market and the room cost fell under the ceiling.
Her nightly rate was below the $220 cap for regional hubs.
Taxes and resort fees were excluded by the Shinjuku Meridian Hotel.

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件因果推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：政策將東京列為 Tier-1 樞紐城市（上限 $310/night），Rachel 住宿費為 $295/night，未超標故獲准。正解 (B) 改寫為 destination is a top-tier market and the room cost fell under the ceiling。
• 誘答分析：(D) 稅金本就不計入上限，非飯店免除；(A) 無須特別核准；(C) $220 是 Tier-2 城市上限。
• 單字補充：ceiling (n.) 價格上限。

questions.q: Under what condition would Rachel's $145 private sedan transfer have been fully reimbursed?
options: If she had traveled with one other Kestrel consultant
If the Haneda Monorail had cost more than $25
If she had obtained written VP approval before March 4
If her plane had touched down late at night

explain.text:
• 考點：條件推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：政策規定私人轎車僅在三人以上同行或於 11:00 P.M. and 5:00 A.M. 之間抵達時才可報銷。Rachel 獨自於 3:40 P.M. 抵達，故若班機在深夜降落（touched down late at night）即可全額報銷，選 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 一位同事僅兩人，未達三人門檻；(B) $25 是單筆餐費需附收據門檻；(C) 政策未規定副總核准可用於私人轎車。
• 單字補充：touch down (phr.) （飛機）降落。

questions.q: What is the maximum amount Rachel can be reimbursed for the March 4 airport transfer if no extenuating circumstance is provided?

explain.text:
• 考點：數據細節。
• 解析：審核團隊指出若無特殊理由，僅能依單軌＋JR 特急車票等值金額 $18 報銷，故選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 並非完全不補助；(C) $85 為每日餐費上限；(D) $145 為實付轎車費用。
• 單字補充：extenuating circumstance (n.) 可寬宥的特殊情況。

questions.q: What must Rachel provide to get the wine on her March 6 dinner receipt reimbursed?
options: Documentation of client hospitality along with leadership authorization
Written approval from a Managing Partner before March 20
Proof that the $112 dinner was shared with two other consultants
A separate receipt showing the food portion was under $85

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件條件核對（同義替換）。
• 解析：政策規定酒類飲品不可報銷，除非 entertaining a client with VP approval，郵件亦要求註明是否有客戶在場並附上副總核准。正解 (A) 改寫為 Documentation of client hospitality along with leadership authorization。
• 誘答分析：(D) 食物部分超過 $85 仍受每日上限限制；(B) 需 VP 而非 Managing Partner 核准，且 3/20 是更新報告期限；(C) 混用三人同行規定。
• 單字補充：hospitality (n.) 招待、款待。

questions.q: Why was Mei-Ling Zhou's session moved to a different room?
options: The Grand Auditorium became available after an afternoon session moved.
Dr. Thorne's morning keynote ran 15 minutes past 10:15 A.M.
Projected demand exceeded the original hall's seating limit.
Hall 2B's audiovisual equipment could not read her USB backup.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因細節（同義替換）。
• 解析：信中指出 Hall 2B 容量僅 150 人，但有超過 260 人在 App 預約該場次，故改至可容納 500 人的大禮堂。正解 (C) 改寫為 Projected demand exceeded the original hall's seating limit。
• 誘答分析：(B) Dr. Thorne 演講準時於 10:15 結束；(D) 僅要求攜帶 USB 備份，非設備不相容；(A) 過度推論。
• 單字補充：projected demand (n.) 預期需求人數。

questions.q: When is Mei-Ling Zhou asked to arrive at the Grand Auditorium?

explain.text:
• 考點：時間細節。
• 解析：信中明確要求 Please arrive at the Grand Auditorium stage by 10:15 A.M. sharp，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 08:30 A.M. 為推播通知時間；(B) 09:00 A.M. 為開場演講時間；(D) 10:30 A.M. 為原定開講時間。
• 單字補充：switch (v.) 切換。

questions.q: Which session will take place in Hall 2B as originally planned?

Managing Turnaround Times at Congested Gates
AI-Driven Baggage Routing Systems

explain.text:

• 誘答分析：(B)(D) 在 Grand Auditorium；(A) 在 Hall 2A。
• 單字補充：turnaround time (n.) 航班過站周轉時間。

questions.q: Why was Carlos Vega's 13:00 session rescheduled?
options: Hall 2A was reassigned to the Closing Panel.
Attendees were still at the Level 1 Food Court until 14:30
Fewer than 150 attendees bookmarked his session in the app.
His air travel from Spain experienced a setback.

explain.text:

• 誘答分析：(B) 美食街開放至 14:30，與改期無關；(A) Hall 2A 未被閉幕座談佔用；(C) 260 人預約的是 Mei-Ling 的場次。
• 單字補充：setback (n.) 挫折、延誤。

questions.q: What will happen at 16:00 on May 15?
options: Priya Nair's session in Hall 2B will conclude.
Two scheduled events will overlap in different venues.
Mei-Ling Zhou will join multiple panelists in the Grand Auditorium.
The Food Court on Level 1 will close for the afternoon.

explain.text:

• 解析：Carlos Vega 延後至 16:00 在 Hall 2A 演講，running concurrently with the Closing Panel in the Grand Auditorium，正解 (B) 改寫為 Two scheduled events will overlap in different venues。
• 誘答分析：(D) 美食街於 14:30 關閉；(C)(A) 皆與時程表不符。
• 單字補充：concurrently (adv.) 同時地；overlap (v.) 重疊。

questions.q: Why was Flight AC 218 canceled?

questions.q: Why did David Lindholm NOT receive a complimentary hotel room?
options: He arrived at JFK before 9:00 P.M. local time.
His replacement flight left without requiring an overnight wait.
His delay was less than the 4-hour minimum threshold.
His £25 meal voucher replaced the hotel accommodation benefit.

• 誘答分析：(D) 餐券與住宿為獨立補償項目；(C) 延誤達 6 小時 50 分，已超過 4 小時門檻；(A) 抵達 JFK 為 21:05（晚上九點後）。
• 單字補充：not applicable (phr.) 不適用。

questions.q: How long after his original scheduled departure did Mr. Lindholm's new flight depart?

7 hours and 15 minutes
9 hours and 5 minutes

• 誘答分析：(A) 為餐券資格門檻；(C)(D) 為干擾計算。
• 單字補充：subsequent (adj.) 隨後的。

questions.q: What is Mr. Lindholm requesting a refund for in his email?

The cost of the missed client welcome dinner in Manhattan
The fare difference between AC 218 and AC 224
A pre-paid charge for upgraded cabin seating

explain.text:

• 誘答分析：(B) 雖錯過曼哈頓客戶晚宴，但信中請求退費的是選位費與法定延誤賠償；(A) 餐券已使用／感念收到；(C) 兩班機皆為 Economy Flex，無票價差額。
• 單字補充：statutory (adj.) 法定的。

questions.q: What can be inferred about Seat 22C on Flight AC 224?
options: It was located in an exit row with extra legroom.
It was upgraded from Economy Flex to Business Class.
It cost £65 more than Seat 14A on AC 218.
It lacked the additional space Mr. Lindholm had purchased.

explain.text:

• 解析：原文說明 Seat 14A 為 extra-legroom exit-row seat，而 Seat 22C 僅為 standard middle-section aisle seat with regular legroom，可推論 (D) lacked the additional space Mr. Lindholm had purchased。
• 誘答分析：(A) 14A 才在逃生門排；(C) £65 是 14A 的選位費；(B) 兩者皆為 Economy Flex。
• 單字補充：legroom (n.) 腿部伸展空間。

questions.q: According to the manual, what is already included in a Standard Booth Package?
options: A 100 Mbps wired Ethernet connection
Charcoal carpet and a locking reception counter
Two high-back bar stools and freight drayage
Dividers, identification signage, and basic electricity

explain.text:

• 解析：手冊說明標準攤位包含 white partition walls, booth ID sign, and one 110V/5A electrical outlet，正解 (D) 改寫為 Dividers, identification signage, and basic electricity。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(C) 所列地毯、櫃檯、有線網路與高腳椅皆為「不包含」需額外加購項目。
• 單字補充：partition (n.) 隔板；signage (n.) 標示牌。

questions.q: Why did Summit Retail Systems pay $870.00 instead of receiving the 20 percent discount on Order #EX-772?
options: The request was placed past the early-bird cutoff.
The order was submitted on August 29, incurring a surcharge.
The 20 percent discount does not cover IT-401 Ethernet drops.
The company ordered fewer than three bar stools.

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件因果推論（同義替換）。
• 解析：訂單日期為 August 18，已過 August 10 早鳥八折期限，故適用標準費率 $870.00。正解 (A) 改寫為 The request was placed past the early-bird cutoff。
• 誘答分析：(C) 折扣無品項限制；(D) 數量與折扣無關；(B) 8/29 是加訂一張高腳椅的寄信日。
• 單字補充：cutoff (n.) 截止期限。

questions.q: Including the 30 percent on-site/late surcharge (since it is now after August 25), how much will the single extra High-Back Bar Stool (FN-210) cost?

explain.text:
• 考點：跨文件價格計算。
• 解析：High-Back Bar Stool (FN-210) 標準單價為 $65.00。8 月 25 日後加購需加收 30% 遲交／現場附加費：65 × 1.30 = $84.50，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A) 未加收 30%；(B) 為八折誤算或錯誤加成；(D) 為原訂單兩張的總價。
• 單字補充：surcharge (n.) 附加費。

questions.q: Why can Summit Retail Systems NOT send its demonstration unit crate to the Advanced Warehouse on August 30?

The warehouse does not accept heavy crates from customs.
The facility's receiving deadline will have already passed.
Loading Dock B requires all shipments to arrive on August 28.

explain.text:

• 解析：手冊規定貨物送達 Advanced Warehouse 的截止日為 August 28，而貨運商要到 August 30 才送達，已過收貨期限。正解 (C) 改寫為 The facility's receiving deadline will have already passed。
• 誘答分析：(B) 8/10 是早鳥訂購截止日；(D) Loading Dock B 是在 9/2（進場日）收貨；(A) 貨物遲到係因海關延誤，非訂單漏訂。
• 單字補充：drayage (n.) 展場貨物短程搬運／進場託運費。

questions.q: What does Hannah Brooks ask the Expo Operations Team to confirm?

The move-in day schedule for a specific unloading bay
Whether the 30 percent surcharge applies to Item FN-210
Whether her third specialist can receive a discounted exhibitor badge

• 解析：Hannah 信末請求 confirm the exact hours that Loading Dock B will be open on September 2（9/2 為手冊上的 move-in day），正解 (B) 改寫為 The move-in day schedule for a specific unloading bay。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(A) 皆挪用文中出現的 third specialist、30 percent surcharge、Advanced Warehouse 製造干擾。
• 單字補充：unloading bay (n.) 卸貨碼頭／月台。

• 誘答分析：(C) 回答時間（When）；(B) 重複字 "order / approved" 加上 Yes/No 陷阱。

explain.text:

• 解析：男士問進料壓力閥門（incoming batch of precision pressure valves）狀況，女士說將近 15% 未通過保壓測試（failed the pressure-retention inspection），選項 (D) "Some incoming components did not meet testing standards." 以「部分進料零件未達測試標準」同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 重複原文 "overnight courier" 與 "valves"，但並非包裹遺失；(B) 重複 "Assembly Line 4" 與 "client audit"，但他們是要避免產線停擺；(C) 重複 "reserve stock on Shelf B"，但備品尚未耗盡。

questions.q: What does the woman say she will do next?

Postpone the major client audit until tomorrow
Request an urgent replacement shipment from the supplier
Re-test the valves that failed the retention check

explain.text:
• 考點：說話者接下來行動（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士說 "I'm going to call the vendor right now to demand an immediate replacement order via overnight courier."，選項 (C) "Request an urgent replacement shipment from the supplier" 將 vendor 換為 supplier、immediate replacement order 換為 urgent replacement shipment。
• 誘答分析：(A) 原文是從 Shelf B 取備品給 Line 4，但這是雙方後續配套而非女士立刻要打電話的事，且她說的是聯繫廠商；(B) 原文只說明天早上有客戶稽核，並未說要延期；(D) 原文已測試完成，未說要重測。

The following morning
Later this afternoon

• 解析：男士說 "tomorrow morning"，選項 (C) "The following morning" 為同義改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(B) 皆為時間錯置干擾項。

questions.q: Why is the man calling the procurement department?

To submit a new requisition for a backup motor
To ask when the finance director returns from Taipei
To inquire about the progress of an equipment request

explain.text:
• 考點：來電目的題（同義替換）。
• 解析：男士說他送出兩個電動馬達的請購單，打來確認核准進度（check on its approval status），選項 (D) "To inquire about the progress of an equipment request" 將 check on status 換為 inquire about the progress、purchase requisition 換為 equipment request。
• 誘答分析：(B) 重複 "backup motor"，但那是產線目前暫用的備用馬達而非新請購；(C) 重複 "finance director" 與 "Taipei"，但非主要來電目的；(A) 重複 "packaging line"，但產線目前仍靠備用馬達運轉中，並未停機。

Final authorization for the purchase will be delayed.
The vendor comparison sheet will be presented at the expo.
The man should send the engineering review to Taipei.

explain.text:
• 考點：言外之意推論題（同義替換）。
• 解析：財務總監要到週四才從台北貿易展回來，而超過一萬美元的請購單需要她最終簽核，因此暗指 (B)「採購的最終授權將會延遲（Final authorization for the purchase will be delayed.）」。
• 誘答分析：(D) 重複 "engineering review" 與 "Taipei"，但工程審核已經通過，無須寄去台北；(A) 過度推論，原文僅說「超過一萬美元」需財務總監簽核；(C) 重複 "vendor comparison sheet" 與 "expo"，但比價表是回來後加速審核用的，並非要在展會簡報。

questions.q: What does the woman suggest the man do in the meantime?

Switch the packaging line to a backup motor
Organize a side-by-side summary of supplier bids
Request an expedited engineering review

explain.text:
• 考點：建議事項（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士建議 "prepare the vendor comparison sheet"，選項 (C) "Organize a side-by-side summary of supplier bids" 將 vendor comparison sheet 改寫為「整理供應商報價的並列摘要」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 重複 "packaging line" 與 "backup motor"，但產線已經在使用備用馬達；(D) 重複 "engineering review"，但工程審核已通過；(A) 重複 "Thursday" 與 "requisition number"，但請購單四天前就已送出。

Inside a maintenance portal room

explain.text:
• 考點：對話地點推論（上位概念／同義替換）。
• 解析：女士剛在 "metal press floor"（金屬沖壓車間）結束突襲安全巡檢，選項 (C) "In a metal-stamping manufacturing area" 以同義詞改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) 重複 "safety supplier"，但那是之後要叫貨的廠商；(B) 重複 "municipal" 與 "inspector"，但稽查員是來廠內巡檢；(D) 重複 "portal"，但那是電腦系統而非地點。

questions.q: What safety violation did the inspector point out?
options: Staff failed to log a corrective action in the portal.
Hearing-safety notices were worn out and hard to read.
Workers near Press #6 were not wearing ear protection.
Clear aisles were blocked by older equipment.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題（同義替換）。
• 解析：稽查員指出 "the ear-protection warning signage near Press #6 was severely faded and barely legible"，選項 (B) "Hearing-safety notices were worn out and hard to read." 將 ear-protection warning signage 換為 hearing-safety notices、faded and barely legible 換為 worn out and hard to read。
• 誘答分析：(D) 原文 M1 說「一直努力保持走道淨空」，女士也稱讚內務管理很好，並非違規項目；(A) 原文 M1 說「會立刻在系統登錄矯正行動」，並非缺失；(C) 重複 "Press #6" 與 "ear protection"，但違規的是標示牌褪色而非工人沒戴護具。

questions.q: What will the third speaker (Kenji) be responsible for?
options: Logging the corrective action in the safety portal
Escorting the municipal inspector around the floor
Removing the faded placards from Press #6
Purchasing durable replacement signs

explain.text:
• 考點：三人對話人物分工（同義替換）。
• 解析：女士請 Kenji 訂購一組十張耐候型高對比標示牌（order a set of ten weatherproof placards），選項 (D) "Purchasing durable replacement signs" 將 order 換為 purchasing、weatherproof 換為 durable、placards 換為 signs。
