• 解析：中庭需 400 m² 的 SS-200 視覺玻璃，低於單一規格 500 m² 最低訂購門檻，故須加收 12% 小批量費，對應 (A) The atrium glazing order falls short of the required threshold。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆挪用 10 to 12 weeks、wind-load、$340/m² 製造陷阱。

questions.q: What did Priya Nair attach to her e-mail?
options: Approved shop drawings for the double-height atrium
A revised quote adjusting the lobby layout to 500 m²
A bulk invoice for 650 square meters of SS-200
Records verifying compliance with coastal gust standards

explain.text:
• 考點：附件內容題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：Priya 隨信附上抗風壓認證文件包（wind-load certification packet），證實超越加州海岸 140 mph 強風結構標準，對應 (D) Records verifying compliance with coastal gust standards。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(C) 皆錯置 shop drawings、500 m²、SS-200。

questions.q: According to the quarterly report, which zone finished its work earliest?
options: Zone D
Zone C
Zone A
Zone B

explain.text:
• 考點：表格狀態查詢題。
• 解析：季度進度表顯示 Zone D 預計完工日 11 月 5 日且已標示 Completed，對應 (A)。

questions.q: Why is Zone B behind schedule?
options: Flawed gaskets in a window-frame shipment caused a setback.
Fourth-floor moisture readings surpassed the 16% limit.
Replacement seals are still waiting for November 12 inspection.
Floors 6 through 10 failed the initial glass installation test.

explain.text:
• 考點：因果細節題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：進度表備註指出 Zone B 延誤主因是第三批窗框出現橡膠墊片瑕疵（rubber seal defect），對應 (A) Flawed gaskets in a window-frame shipment caused a setback。
• 誘答分析：(B) 16% 含水率上限為 Zone C 問題；(C) 11 月 12 日為目標解決日；(D) 6 至 10 樓是待送檢數據後放行，非已失敗。

questions.q: What must happen before drywall can be installed in Zone C?
options: Triad Mechanical must resolve the missing fire-safety seal first.
Engineered wood beams must be re-anchored to the fourth-floor deck.
Dehumidifiers must lower the timber's dampness to pass re-inspection.
Sandra Lin must sign off on the underground garage's EV wiring.

explain.text:
• 考點：跨句條件題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：Zone C 四樓木構含水率達 19.5%，超過 16% 上限，須先以除濕機抽濕至少 72 小時並複檢合格才可封裝牆板，對應 (C) Dehumidifiers must lower the timber's dampness to pass re-inspection。
• 誘答分析：(B) 木樑已妥善固定；(A) 防火密封條屬 Zone A（#CA-403）；(D) 地下室電動車配線屬 Zone D 且已簽核。

questions.q: Which contractor is responsible for resolving the moisture issue in Zone C?
options: Triad Mechanical
Apex Development Group
Pacific Timber Erectors
Skyline Glazing

explain.text:
• 考點：跨表責任歸屬題。
• 解析：矯正紀錄表 #CA-402 對應 Zone C 含水率問題，負責包商為 Pacific Timber Erectors，對應 (C)。

questions.q: What is indicated about Log ID #CA-403?
options: It has pushed Zone A's scheduled completion past November 15.
Its November 6 target resolution date falls after #CA-401.
It concerns faulty drainage pumps in the underground garage.
The inspector's recent message omitted any reference to this issue.

explain.text:
• 考點：跨篇負向推論題 + 同義改寫。
• 解析：Sandra Lin 在 11 月 4 日信中提及 Zone D、Zone C 與 Zone B，完全未提及 Zone A 的 #CA-403，對應 (D) The inspector's recent message omitted any reference to this issue。
• 誘答分析：(B) #CA-403 目標日為 11 月 6 日，早於 #CA-401 的 11 月 12 日；(C) 屬於 Zone A 二樓，非地下車庫；(A) 進度表顯示 Zone A 仍為 On Schedule。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.

Response (B)

M: A. We inspected the main laboratory wing yesterday. B. Yes, the morning shift starts at seven. C. They haven't finalized the timetable yet.

When is the safety inspection scheduled to begin?
(A) We inspected the main laboratory wing yesterday.
(B) Yes, the morning shift starts at seven.
(C) They haven't finalized the timetable yet.

• 解析：問安全檢查何時開始，(C)「他們還沒敲定時間表」間接說明目前沒有確切時間。
• 誘答分析：(A) 重複 inspect/inspection 且時態為過去式；(B) Yes/No 不適用於 Wh- 問句，並用 morning shift 營造時間假象。
• 單字補充：finalize（敲定）、timetable（時間表）。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
options: Response (A)
Response (B)
Response (C)
questions.say:

W: A. I'm reading the workshop handout right now. B. It's in Conference Room B on the third floor. C. Check the training calendar on the intranet.

• 誘答分析：(B) 回答地點（Where）；(A) 用近音字 reading 混淆 leading，並重複 workshop。
• 單字補充：ergonomics（人因工程學）、intranet（企業內網）。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
options: Response (A)
Response (B)
Response (C)

Haven't the product study results been uploaded to the portal yet?
(A) No, the study room is on the second floor.

• 誘答分析：(B) 重複 upload 與近似數位概念 app；(A) 重複 study 但語意無關。
• 單字補充：portal（入口網站）、verify（驗證）。

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.

Response (B)
Response (C)

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.
options: Response (A)
Response (B)
Response (C)
questions.say:

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.

questions.q: Part 2 — Listen to the question or statement and the three responses. Choose the best response.

At an employee health center
At a physical therapy school
At a furniture manufacturing plant

options: Several fourth-floor employees threw away their chairs.
The chairs in the intake area are missing armrests.
The manufacturer failed to include quick-start cards.
Staff are struggling to operate the adjustment mechanisms.

explain.text: 考點：問題細節（同義替換）。男士反映員工不會操作傾仰張力與扶手調整（can't figure out how to lock the tilt tension and adjust the armrests），對應 (D) struggling to operate the adjustment mechanisms。

questions.q: What does the woman propose?
options: Asking the manufacturer for a revised manual
Having staff submit messages to the physical therapist
Scheduling a short hands-on training during lunch
Moving the ergonomic chairs to another floor

explain.text:
考點：建議事項（同義替換）。女士提議在明天午休舉辦 15 分鐘現場示範（fifteen-minute live demonstration during tomorrow's lunch break），對應 (C) short hands-on training during lunch。

Q38–40

questions.q: What issue does the woman report about Cold-Storage Unit 2?
options: Quality assurance ordered an immediate quarantine of the unit.
The overnight telemetry log failed to record data.
Its door gasket has completely detached.
The internal temperature briefly exceeded the safe limit.

explain.text: 考點：設備異常細節（同義替換）。溫度短暫升至 9.2°C，高於 8°C 門檻（just above our 8-degree threshold），同義替換為 (D) briefly exceeded the safe limit。

questions.q: What does the man imply when he says, "Quality assurance already logged the temperature change"?
options: The required follow-up process has already begun.
Today's scheduled shipment will be delayed by twenty minutes.
The maintenance crew no longer needs to inspect the seal.
The batch is within the approved nine-degree margin.

explain.text: 考點：語意推論題。女士回應 so the standard procedure is already in motion，對應 (A) The required follow-up process has already begun。

questions.q: What do the speakers agree to do before noon?
options: Reschedule today's afternoon shipment
Notify maintenance about the door seal
Quarantine the entire batch of supplies
Examine product stability records together

explain.text:
考點：特定時間行動（同義替換）。男士提議中午前一起檢視安全測試數據（review the safety test data together before noon），同義替換為 (D) Examine product stability records together。

Q41–43

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: Reducing copays for all outpatient clinic visits
Reviewing the finance team's annual budget report
Broadening employee access to psychological care
Conducting a new company-wide absenteeism survey

explain.text: 考點：對話主旨（同義替換）。對話聚焦擴大心理健康照護給付（expand mental health coverage），對應 (C) Broadening employee access to psychological care。

questions.q: According to the woman, what happened after last year's benefit change?

Virtual therapy visits dropped by fourteen percent.
Outpatient counseling claims exceeded the budget.
The benefits committee rejected a premium increase.

explain.text: 考點：細節題（同義替換）。去年推出六次療程福利後，整體缺勤率下降 14%（overall absenteeism... dropped by fourteen percent），同義替換為 (A) Fewer employees missed workdays overall。

questions.q: What does the man offer to prepare for Friday's meeting?

A financial projection comparing costs and savings
A list of virtual counseling providers

Their previous screening results

questions.q: All product study coordinators must ensure that safety incidents are reported to the health agency ------- twenty-four hours of initial detection.
options: among
within
during
until

explain.text:
• 考點：時間介系詞辨析。
• 解析：within twenty-four hours of ... 表示「在……發生後的 24 小時內」，為法規通報常用搭配。
• 誘答分析：(C) during 接期間名詞（如 during the trial），不接數字時間長度；(D) until 表「直到」；(A) among 表「在三者以上之中」。
• 單字補充：adverse event（不良事件）、initial detection（初步發現）。

questions.q: Dr. Lin emphasized that strict ------- to laboratory safety rules is essential before any initial test data can be submitted.
options: adherence
adhere
adhering
adherent

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性題（名詞）。
• 解析：形容詞 strict 後接名詞作 that 子句主詞，且後接介系詞 to，adherence to ... 意為「遵守……」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 動詞；(D) 形容詞或名詞（追隨者）；(C) 動名詞。
• 單字補充：laboratory safety rules（實驗室安全規範）、initial test data（初步測試數據）。

questions.q: Had the temperature sensor ------- properly during transit, the entire shipment of medical supplies could have been salvaged.
options: function
been functioned
functioning
functioned

explain.text:
• 考點：與過去事實相反的假設語氣倒裝（Had + S + Vpp）。
• 解析：主句為 could have been salvaged，可知為與過去事實相反的條件句；省略 if 並將 had 提前，空格需填過去分詞 functioned（自動詞，無被動）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 原形動詞；(C) 現在分詞；(B) 被動式錯誤。
• 單字補充：temperature sensor（溫度感測器）、salvage（搶救／挽回）。

questions.q: The newly approved treatment offers a ------- alternative for patients who have not responded well to standard medication.
options: fragile
viable
reluctant
redundant

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：viable alternative 意為「可行的替代方案」，符合語意「為對傳統化療產生抗藥性的病患提供可行替代方案」。
• 誘答分析：(A) 脆弱的；(D) 多餘的；(C) 不情願的。
• 單字補充：standard medication（標準藥物）、alternative（替代方案）。

questions.q: Employees who enroll in the corporate wellness program are eligible for an annual reimbursement ------- up to $500 for preventive dental care.
options: to total
total
totaled
totaling

explain.text:
• 考點：分詞片語後位修飾。
• 解析：reimbursement 主動「總計達（totaling）」500 美元，故用現在分詞 totaling 修飾前面的名詞。
• 誘答分析：(C) 過去分詞；(B) 原形／名詞；(A) 不定詞表目的不符語意。
• 單字補充：reimbursement（報銷／補助）、preventive dental care（預防性牙科保健）。

questions.q: ------- the promising initial results, the medical company decided to expand its product study across twelve European clinics.
options: Even though
In light of
Regardless
Because

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞片語 vs. 連接詞。
• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 the promising initial results，故須選介系詞片語 In light of（鑑於、考量到）。
• 誘答分析：(D) Because 後須接完整子句；(C) Regardless 須加 of 才能接名詞；(A) Even though 後須接子句且語意轉折不符。
• 單字補充：preliminary results（初步結果）、cohort（受試者群組）。

questions.q: Quality control inspectors rejected Batch #409 after discovering that several bottles contained ------- levels of moisture.
options: elevating
elevation
elevated
elevate

explain.text:
• 考點：分詞形容詞修飾名詞。
• 解析：elevated levels 為醫藥檢測高頻搭配，意為「升高的濃度／數值」。
• 誘答分析：(D) 動詞；(B) 名詞；(A) 主動「正在升高」不符靜態檢測結果語意。
• 單字補充：dissolved oxygen（溶氧）、vial（藥瓶）。

questions.q: The human resources director requested that every department head ------- the updated ergonomic workstation checklist by Friday afternoon.
options: reviewing
reviewed
reviews
review

explain.text:
• 考點：意志／要求動詞後的假設語氣（request that + S + (should) + V原形）。
• 解析：主要動詞為 requested，其後 that 子句動詞須用原形 review（省略 should）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 第三人稱單數現在式；(B) 過去式；(A) 動名詞／現在分詞。
• 單字補充：ergonomic workstation（人因工程工作站）。

questions.q: Neither the lead researcher nor the junior lab assistants ------- able to explain the unusual result observed in Tuesday's lab test.
options: is
was
were
has been

explain.text:
• 考點：主詞與動詞一致性（Neither A nor B）。
• 解析：Neither A nor B 作主詞時，動詞單複數依較近的 B（the junior lab assistants，複數）決定，且依語意為過去事件，故選 were。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(A) 皆為單數動詞。
• 單字補充：lab test（實驗室測試）、unusual result（異常結果）。

questions.q: BioVantage's flagship testing kit has gained widespread ------- among rural clinics due to its fast results and minimal refrigeration needs.
options: adopted
adoptive
adoption
adopt

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性題（名詞）。
• 解析：形容詞 widespread（廣泛的）後接不可數名詞 adoption（採用／普及）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 動詞；(A) 過去分詞／形容詞；(B) adoptive 意為「領養的／收養的」，語意不符。
• 單字補充：turnaround time（處理／檢測週轉時間）。

questions.q: ------- rigorously a medical device is tested in the lab, real-world user feedback remains essential for ongoing safety monitoring.
options: Whichever
Whenever
Whatever
However

explain.text:
• 考點：複合關係副詞（However + 副詞 + S + V）。
• 解析：空格後緊接副詞 rigorously（嚴格地），However rigorously ... 相當於 No matter how rigorously ...（無論測試得多嚴格）。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A) 後接名詞或直接接動詞；(B) 表時間「無論何時」。
• 單字補充：indispensable（不可或缺的）、post-market surveillance（上市後監測）。

questions.q: To ------- the risk of contamination, staff members must change protective coats whenever moving between lab areas.
options: proliferate
fabricate
mitigate
aggravate

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：mitigate the risk 為高頻搭配，意為「減輕／降低風險」。
• 誘答分析：(D) 加劇、惡化；(A) 激增；(B) 捏造、製造。
• 單字補充：contamination（汙染）、protective coat（防護衣）。

questions.q: The healthcare group announced a ------- partnership with two university medical centers to support public health research.
options: strategize
strategically
strategic
strategy

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性題（形容詞）。
• 解析：空格修飾名詞 partnership，須填形容詞 strategic（策略性的）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 名詞；(B) 副詞；(A) 動詞。
• 單字補充：consortium（聯盟／財團）、rare-disease research（罕見疾病研究）。

questions.q: Employees participating in the wellness study were ------- assigned to either the morning exercise group or the evening group.
options: scarcely
mutually
randomly
formerly

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：健康研究中，受試員工會被「隨機（randomly）」分配到晨間運動組或晚間運動組。
• 誘答分析：(A) 幾乎不；(B) 互相地；(D) 從前地。
• 單字補充：wellness study（健康研究）、randomly（隨機地）。

questions.q: Only after the independent safety monitoring board reviewed the interim data ------- permission to resume the product study.
options: did the agency grant
was granted the agency
the agency granted
had granted the agency

explain.text:
• 考點：否定／限定副詞片語置於句首的倒裝句（Only after ... + 助動詞 + S + V）。
• 解析：Only after + 時間副詞子句 置於句首時，主要子句須採疑問句語序倒裝，故選 did the agency grant。
• 誘答分析：(C) 未倒裝；(B)(D) 主被動與語序錯誤。
• 單字補充：interim data（期中數據）、dosing（給藥）。

questions.q: The updated health insurance policy covers preventive screenings, ------- annual physicals, vision checks, and blood tests, at no out-of-pocket cost.
options: such as
provided that
in addition
as well

explain.text:
• 考點：舉例片語。
• 解析：後方列舉三項預防性篩檢項目（mammograms, colonoscopies, and lipid panels），故選 such as（例如）。
• 誘答分析：(D) as well 須加 as 才能接名詞；(C) in addition 須加 to；(B) provided that 為「倘若」。
• 單字補充：mammogram（乳房攝影）、colonoscopy（大腸鏡）、lipid panel（血脂檢測）。

questions.q: Because the patent on the popular blood-pressure product is set to ------- next quarter, competing manufacturers are preparing their market launches.
options: transpire
inspire
aspire
expire

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：藥品專利「到期（expire）」，學名藥廠便準備上市。
• 誘答分析：(B) 啟發；(A) 發生、洩漏；(C) 渴望。
• 單字補充：antihypertensive（降血壓的）、generic manufacturer（學名藥廠）。

questions.q: The wellness committee's proposal to install standing desks throughout the headquarters was ------- endorsed by the executive leadership team.
options: unanimously
unanimous
unanime
unanimity

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性題（副詞修飾動詞）。
• 解析：空格位於助動詞 was 與過去分詞 endorsed 之間，須填副詞 unanimously（一致地）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 名詞；(B) 形容詞；(C) 拼字錯誤。
• 單字補充：endorse（背書／支持通過）、standing desk（站立式辦公桌）。

questions.q: ------- who experience persistent eye strain should schedule an occupational optometry consultation through the employee assistance portal.
options: Anyone
Someone
Whoever
Those

explain.text:
• 考點：代名詞與關係子句主詞一致性。
• 解析：關係子句動詞為複數 experience，故先行詞須為複數代名詞 Those（Those who ... 意為「凡是……的人」）。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(C) 皆須搭配單數動詞 experiences。
• 單字補充：eye strain（眼睛疲勞）、optometry（視光學／驗光）。

questions.q: The compliance specialist compiled a ------- report containing over four hundred pages of safety, quality, and performance studies.
options: comprehensive
comprehensible
respective
apprehensive

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞字彙辨析（易混淆字）。
• 解析：超過四百頁包含穩定性、毒性與生體相等性研究的檔案，應為「全面詳盡的（comprehensive）」。
• 誘答分析：(B) 可理解的；(D) 憂慮的；(C) 各自的。
• 單字補充：dossier（送審檔案）、bioequivalence（生體相等性）。

questions.q: Under the revised occupational health guidelines, laboratory staff must undergo audiometric testing ------- a year to monitor noise exposure.
options: single
one
first
once

explain.text:
• 考點：頻率副詞搭配。
• 解析：once a year 為固定搭配，意為「一年一次」。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 均無法構成「一年一次」的頻率表達。
• 單字補充：audiometric testing（聽力檢測）、noise exposure（噪音暴露）。

questions.q: ------- the mixing tank reaches the target temperature of 25 degrees, the automated valve will release the cooling solution into the container.
options: Lest
Once
Whereas
Unless

explain.text:
• 考點：時間從屬連接詞。
• 解析：Once（一旦）發酵槽達到目標酸鹼值 pH 7.2，自動閥就會釋放營養緩衝液，符合製程邏輯。
• 誘答分析：(D) 除非；(C) 然而；(A) 以免（後常接原形動詞或 should）。
• 單字補充：mixing tank（混合槽）、cooling solution（冷卻液）。

questions.q: The hospital network's investment in telehealth infrastructure has ------- improved specialist access for patients in remote mountainous areas.
options: substantiate
substantially
substance
substantial

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性題（副詞修飾動詞）。
• 解析：空格位於 has 與過去分詞 improved 之間，須用副詞 substantially（大幅地）修飾。
• 誘答分析：(D) 形容詞；(C) 名詞；(A) 動詞。
• 單字補充：telehealth infrastructure（遠距醫療基礎設施）。

questions.q: All medical waste containers must be sealed and labeled ------- to the standards outlined in Section 4 of the Workplace Safety Manual.
options: compliant
according
consistent
regardless

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞搭配（according to）。
• 解析：空格後接 to，according to 意為「依據、按照」。
• 誘答分析：(D) regardless 要接 of，語意也不合；(C) consistent 搭配 with；(A) compliant 搭配 with。
• 單字補充：medical waste（醫療廢棄物）。

questions.q: Dr. Patel's research team ------- the patient survey data for three months before identifying the key factor linked to recovery speed.
options: had been analyzing
has been analyzing
is analyzing
will analyze

explain.text:
• 考點：過去完成進行式（had been + V-ing）。
• 解析：句尾有過去時間點 before identifying ...（在找出關鍵因素之前），強調在該過去動作前已持續進行三個月的動作，故用過去完成進行式 had been analyzing。
• 誘答分析：(B) 現在完成進行式（與過去動作時間軸不符）；(D) 未來式；(C) 現在進行式。
• 單字補充：patient survey data（病患調查數據）、recovery speed（復原速度）。

questions.q: The company's mental health helpline provides ------- counseling sessions, ensuring that no personal details are shared with supervisors.
options: conspicuous
confident
confidential
contagious

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞字彙辨析（易混淆字）。
• 解析：由後半句「確保個人細節不會與主管分享」可知，心理健康專線提供的是「保密的（confidential）」諮商。
• 誘答分析：(B) 有自信的；(A) 顯眼的；(D) 具傳染性的。
• 單字補充：helpline（諮詢專線）、counseling session（諮商療程）。

questions.q: ------- of the two proposed packaging designs demonstrated superior heat resistance during the ninety-day durability test.
options: All
Every
Neither
Several

explain.text:
• 考點：代名詞辨析（兩者皆不）。
• 解析：後方明確指出 the two proposed packaging designs（兩種包裝設計），兩者皆否定用 Neither，接單數動詞；Every 不能直接接 of the，All 與 Several 用於三者以上，故選 Neither。
• 誘答分析：(B) Every 不可接 of；(A)(D) 用於三者以上。
• 單字補充：durability test（耐用度測試）、heat resistance（耐熱性）。

questions.q: Manufacturing supervisors must verify that every air filter has passed a quality test ------- packaging the final medical product.
options: owing to
prior to
instead
in order

explain.text:
• 考點：時間介系詞片語。
• 解析：空格後接動名詞 packaging，prior to（在……之前）為介系詞片語，符合語法與「包裝前先確認濾心通過品質測試」的醫療產品流程。
• 誘答分析：(D) in order 後接 to V；(C) instead 須加 of；(A) owing to 表原因「由於」。
• 單字補充：integrity test（完整性測試）、injectable（注射劑）。

questions.q: The startup's breakthrough in smart health monitoring systems attracted ------- from three international medical companies.
options: investments
investing
invest
invested

explain.text:
• 考點：名詞字彙與語意搭配。
• 解析：動詞 attracted（吸引）受詞為「投資資金（investments）」，即「吸引了來自三家國際醫療公司的投資」。
• 誘答分析：(D) invested 為動詞變化，不能當 attracted 的受詞；(B)(C) 詞性不符。
• 單字補充：breakthrough（突破）、health monitoring（健康監測）。

questions.q: ------- its compact footprint, the portable ultrasound unit delivers high-resolution imaging comparable to full-sized hospital consoles.
options: Except
Although
Even
Despite

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步介系詞 vs. 連接詞。
• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 its compact footprint，須選介系詞 Despite（儘管）。
• 誘答分析：(B) Although 須接完整子句；(C) Even 不能單獨接名詞；(A) Except 語意不符。
• 單字補充：compact footprint（精巧的機身佔地面積）、portable ultrasound（可攜式超音波）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: Otherwise
However
Furthermore
Nevertheless

explain.text: 考點：轉折／遞進副詞。前句說補助金從 400 調高到 650 美元，後句進一步補充資金適用範圍擴大，故選 Furthermore（此外）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: In addition, we are introducing a dedicated mental health leave policy.
Unfortunately, dental coverage premiums will rise slightly in the spring.
Consequently, the cafeteria will discontinue sugary beverages next month.
Meanwhile, the annual flu vaccination drive has been postponed until November.

explain.text: 考點：句子插入題。空格後緊接著說明全職員工每年將獲得四天帶薪「充電假」，無需醫療證明，故前句應引入「心理健康假政策」，選 (A)。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).
options: proactivity
proactively speaking
reactive
proactively

explain.text: 考點：詞性題（副詞）。修飾動詞 use this time，須用副詞 proactively（主動提前地），與後面 before burnout occurs 呼應。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).
options: directed
inspected
complied
prescribed

explain.text:
考點：動詞搭配。direct questions to ... 意為「將問題轉交／詢問……」，採被動式 be directed to。
• 單字補充：registered dietitian（註冊營養師）、burnout（職業倦怠）。

Passage 2（Q135–138：藥品仿單修訂法規通知）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).
options: concealed
amended
abolished
imitated

explain.text: 考點：動詞字彙辨析。仿單第五節「警語與注意事項」經過「修訂（amended）」以納入腎功能監測指引。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: The effectiveness of Cardiovex® in younger adults remains unchanged.
Therefore, all manufacturing lines will halt production for two weeks.
No product size or main ingredient has been altered in this update.
Patients are advised to discontinue the medication immediately.

explain.text: 考點：句子插入題。前段講述仿單文字更新，後段說明舊包裝庫存仍可附上補充貼紙繼續配發至 12 月 31 日；(C)「此次更新未改變劑量規格或有效成分」最能銜接為何舊庫存仍可使用。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).
options: Within
Until
Prior
As of

explain.text: 考點：時間介系詞。As of January 1 意為「自 1 月 1 日起」，搭配後句「任何過期仿單庫存必須隔離退回」。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).
options: certified
certify
certification
certifying

explain.text:
考點：複合名詞。certification forms 意為「認證／合規證明表單」，符合簽署並上傳法規檔案庫的語境。
• 單字補充：package insert（產品說明書）、safety monitoring（安全監測）、reverse-logistics（逆向物流／退貨回收）。

Passage 3（Q139–142：睡眠恢復裝置研究新聞稿）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (139).
options: In contrast
Even so
Instead
Moreover

explain.text: 考點：遞進連接副詞。前句講睡眠品質改善率高（68% vs. 24%），後句補充晨間疲勞分數也顯著下降，故選 Moreover（此外）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).
options: The company's stock price fell slightly following the quarterly earnings call.
A wearable device could offer greater convenience and improved long-term daily use.
Researchers have not yet determined how the battery performs in cold weather.
Enrollment for the night-shift group was suspended due to budget constraints.

questions.q: Under the revised licensing framework, any unauthorized reproduction of the proprietary algorithm will be treated as a material ------- of contract.

breach
fraction
break

explain.text:
• 考點：法律固定搭配詞（collocation）。

• 解析：breach of contract 為「違約」的標準法律用語（material breach 為「重大違約」）。

• 誘答分析：(D) break 雖有打破之意，但不與 of contract 搭配為法律術語；(C) fraction 分數；(A) rift 裂痕。

unless
despite
without

• 解析：空格後為名詞片語 the prior written consent of the other，語意為「未經另一方事先書面同意，不得轉讓權利」，故選介系詞 without。

• 誘答分析：(A) except 通常需加 for 才接名詞表「除了」；(B) unless 為連接詞，後接完整子句；(C) despite 語意不合。

• 單字補充：assign rights 轉讓權利；prior written consent 事先書面同意。

questions.q: Had the legal department ------- the translated liability clause more carefully, the firm could have avoided the costly arbitration in Zurich.
options: scrutinized
scrutinize
scrutinizing
been scrutinized

explain.text:
• 考點：假設語氣與過去完成式倒裝（Had + S + Vpp）。

• 解析：此為「與過去事實相反」的假設語氣省略 if 倒裝句，原句為 If the legal department had scrutinized...，主動語態須用過去分詞 scrutinized。

• 誘答分析：(B)(C) 時態／詞性不符；(D) been scrutinized 為被動語態，但受詞為 the translated liability clause，應為主動審查。

• 單字補充：scrutinize 仔細審查；liability clause 賠償條款。

adhere
observe

• 解析：空格後有介系詞 to，四個選項中僅 adhere to（嚴格遵守）可搭配 to。

• 誘答分析：(A) comply 須搭配 with；(D) abide 須搭配 by；(C) observe 為及物動詞，直接接受詞，不加 to。

• 單字補充：adhere strictly to 嚴格遵守；anti-bribery protocols 反賄賂準則。

questions.q: The newly ratified bilateral treaty ------- existing intellectual property protections for electronics designs registered after January 1.
options: supersedes
recedes
concedes
intercedes

explain.text:
• 考點：高階商業法律動詞辨析。

• 解析：supersede 意為「取代、替代（舊法規或舊合約）」，符合「新批准的雙邊條約取代現有智財保護規定」。

• 誘答分析：(C) concede 讓步／承認；(B) recede 退去；(D) intercede 調停／說情。

• 單字補充：ratify 正式批准；bilateral treaty 雙邊條約。

questions.q: \------- the complexity of the cross-border merger, both legal teams managed to finalize the definitive purchase agreement ahead of the Q4 deadline.
options: Notwithstanding
Although
Whereas
Even though

• 考點：讓步介系詞與連接詞的結構區分。

• 解析：空格後僅為名詞片語 the complexity of the cross-border merger，必須使用介系詞 Notwithstanding（儘管／雖有）。

• 誘答分析：(B) Although、(D) Even though、(C) Whereas 皆為從屬連接詞，後方必須接「主詞＋動詞」完整子句。

• 單字補充：notwithstanding 儘管（法律文件高頻字）；definitive purchase agreement 最終收購協議。

questions.q: Before signing the technology transfer agreement, the board ------- an independent external auditor to review the financial records.

has been retained
will be retained
retained

explain.text:

• 解析：主詞 the board 後方有受詞 an independent external auditor，須選主動語態的過去式動詞 retained（聘請了外部稽核人員）。

• 誘答分析：(A) 現在分詞無法單獨作主要動詞；(C)(B) 皆為被動語態，與後方名詞受詞不合。

questions.q: Because the patent application was filed ------- across twelve jurisdictions, the company secured an earlier priority date in each market.
options: concurrently
intermittently
tentatively
consecutively

• 解析：concurrently 意為「同時地」，符合在 12 個司法管轄區「同時遞件」以確保較早的優先權日（priority date）。

• 誘答分析：(D) consecutively 連續地（一前一後）；(B) intermittently 間歇地；(C) tentatively 暫定地。

questions.q: Any confidential data disclosed during due diligence must be returned or destroyed ------- ten business days of the termination of negotiations.

until
within
among

• 考點：時間介系詞辨析。

• 解析：within + 一段時間 表示「在……期限之內」，符合「談判終止後十個工作天內須歸還或銷毀機密資料」。

• 誘答分析：(B) until 表「直到……為止」（持續狀態）；(A) during 後接特定時期名稱而非數字天數期限；(D) among 在……之中。

• 單字補充：due diligence 實地查核；termination 終止。

questions.q: The software vendor agreed to ------- the client against any third-party copyright infringement claims arising from the use of its platform.
options: implicate
invalidate
indemnify
instigate

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞字彙辨析與搭配用法。

• 解析：indemnify A against B 意為「保障 A 免於 B 造成的損失」，是合約固定用語，符合軟體供應商承諾保障客戶免受第三方侵權索賠的語意。

• 誘答分析：(A) implicate 牽連；(D) instigate 唆使／發起；(B) invalidate 使無效。

• 單字補充：third-party infringement claim 第三方侵權索賠。

questions.q: \------- of the two proposed meeting venues is acceptable to the Munich-based partner, so we will need to suggest a neutral alternative.
options: None
Neither
Both
Either

explain.text:
• 考點：不定代名詞與主詞動詞一致性。

• 解析：後半句說「因此我們需要提議一個中立替代方案」，可知「兩個擬議的會議地點沒有一個（Neither）被慕尼黑夥伴接受」，且 Neither of + 複數名詞 搭配單數動詞 is。

• 誘答分析：(D) Either 語意相反；(C) Both 須搭配複數動詞 are；(A) None 用於三者或以上，本題明確為 the two。

• 單字補充：meeting venue 會議地點；neutral alternative 中立替代方案。

questions.q: The licensing royalties will be calculated on a tiered basis, ------- ensures that higher sales volumes trigger a lower percentage fee.
options: that
where
what
which

explain.text:
• 考點：非限定關係代名詞（逗號隔開）。

• 解析：逗號後方不能使用 that 或 what，which 可代替前面整件事（「權利金採階梯式計算」這件事），並擔任 ensures 的主詞。

• 誘答分析：(A) that 不可用於逗號後的非限定用法；(C) what 先行詞已包含在內，不可接於逗號後；(B) where 為關係副詞，不可作主詞。

• 單字補充：tiered basis 階梯式／分級基準；trigger 觸發。

questions.q: Ms. Nakamura's ------- knowledge of European data-privacy statutes proved invaluable during the Frankfurt subsidiary's compliance overhaul.
options: extending
extensive
extension
extended

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性與語意辨析（形容詞修飾名詞 knowledge）。

• 解析：extensive knowledge 意為「廣泛淵博的知識」，符合語境。

• 誘答分析：(D) extended 延長的／擴展的（較少與 knowledge 搭配）；(A) extending 正在延伸的；(C) extension 名詞。

• 單字補充：statute 成文法／法規；overhaul 徹底檢修／整頓。

questions.q: Once both CEOs formally ------- the memorandum of understanding, the engineering teams will begin sharing technical blueprints.
options: ratify
rectify
pacify
notify

explain.text:
• 考點：商務動詞辨析。

• 解析：ratify 意為「正式批准／簽署生效（條約、備忘錄、協議）」，符合「一旦雙方執行長正式批准備忘錄，工程團隊便會開始分享藍圖」。

• 誘答分析：(B) rectify 糾正／修正；(D) notify 通知；(C) pacify 安撫。

• 單字補充：memorandum of understanding (MOU) 合作備忘錄。

questions.q: The revised agreement was deemed ------- by the review board because its geographic scope was overly broad.
options: enforceable
unenforceable
enforce
enforcement

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性與否定字首語意判斷。

• 解析：因為地理範圍過於寬廣（overly broad），審查委員會認定該修訂協議「無強制執行力（unenforceable）」。deem + O + adj. 轉被動為 be deemed + adj.。

• 誘答分析：(C) enforce 動詞；(A) enforceable 語意相反；(D) enforcement 名詞。

• 單字補充：review board 審查委員會；geographic scope 地理範圍。

questions.q: \------- to Section 8.4 of the partnership deed, any deadlock between the managing directors shall be referred to mediation in Singapore.
options: Attributable
Relevant
Adjacent
Pursuant

explain.text:
• 考點：法律固定片語。

• 解析：Pursuant to 意為「依據、依照（某條文／法規）」，為合約最常見的開頭片語。

• 誘答分析：(B) Relevant 與...相關；(C) Adjacent 鄰近的；(A) Attributable 歸因於。

• 單字補充：partnership deed 合夥契約；deadlock 僵局。

questions.q: Not only ------- the counterfeit goods from its online marketplace, but the platform also suspended the offending merchant's account permanently.
options: has the platform removed
did the platform remove
the platform removed
removed the platform

explain.text:
• 考點：否定副詞片語置於句首的倒裝句（Not only + 助動詞 + S + V）。

• 解析：句首為 Not only，後方必須倒裝；且後半句動詞 suspended 為過去式，故助動詞須選過去式 did。

• 誘答分析：(C) 未倒裝；(D) 一般動詞不可直接倒裝至主詞前；(A) 時態為現在完成式，與後半句過去式不協調。

• 單字補充：counterfeit goods 仿冒品；suspend 停權／暫停。

questions.q: The settlement amount is ------- with the actual financial losses our client sustained as a result of the trademark dilution.
options: complacent
commensurate
compatible
complimentary

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞與介系詞 with 的固定搭配。

• 解析：be commensurate with 意為「與……相稱／成比例」，符合「和解金額與客戶承受的實際財務損失相稱」。

• 誘答分析：(D) complimentary 免費的／讚美的（不接 with）；(C) compatible 相容的（通常用於軟硬體或性格）；(A) complacent 自滿的，語意不合。

• 單字補充：trademark dilution 商標淡化／稀釋。

questions.q: \------- the holding conditions are satisfied by Friday afternoon, the cross-border acquisition funds will be released automatically.
options: In case of
So that
Provided that
As though

explain.text:
• 考點：條件連接詞辨析。

• 解析：空格後為完整子句 the holding conditions are satisfied...，須選連接詞 Provided that（只要／倘若）。

• 誘答分析：(A) In case of 為介系詞片語，後接名詞；(D) As though 彷彿；(B) So that 以便／以致於（表目的或結果，語意不合）。

• 單字補充：holding conditions 第三方託管條件。

questions.q: Several clauses in the legacy distribution contract remain -------, leaving room for conflicting interpretations regarding warranty obligations.
options: ambiguity
ambiguously
ambiguous
ambiguities

explain.text:
• 考點：連綴動詞 remain 的用法。

• 解析：remain 為連綴動詞，後方接形容詞 ambiguous（模稜兩可的、不明確的）作主詞補語。

• 誘答分析：(A)(D) 名詞；(B) 副詞。

• 單字補充：legacy contract 舊版／遺留合約；warranty obligations 保固義務。

questions.q: The startup sought ------- protection from the court to prevent its former director from sharing client lists with a rival firm.
options: immediate
immediately
immediacy
intermediation

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性判斷（形容詞修飾名詞）。

• 解析：空格位於動詞 sought 與名詞 protection 之間，須填入形容詞 immediate（立即的）修飾 protection。

• 誘答分析：(B) immediately 為副詞；(C) immediacy 與 (D) intermediation 皆為名詞。

• 單字補充：seek protection 尋求保護；rival firm 競爭對手公司。

questions.q: \------- by a team of bilingual IP specialists, the patent portfolio audit uncovered three previously overlooked licensing opportunities.
options: Conducting
To conduct
Conducted
Having conducted

explain.text:
• 考點：分詞構句（過去分詞表被動）。

• 解析：主詞為 the patent portfolio audit（專利組合稽核），與動詞 conduct 為被動關係（「由雙語智財專家團隊執行」），故用過去分詞 Conducted。

• 誘答分析：(A)(D) 主動分詞；(B) 不定詞表目的，與後文 by a team 衝突。

• 單字補充：patent portfolio 專利組合。

questions.q: Payment of the final milestone installment is ------- upon the successful registration of the joint trademark in Brazil.
options: contingent
persistent
resistant
consistent

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞與介系詞 upon 的搭配。

• 解析：be contingent upon 意為「視……而定、取決於……」，符合「最終里程碑款項的支付取決於巴西共同商標是否成功註冊」。

• 誘答分析：(B) persistent 堅持的（in）；(D) consistent 一致的（with）；(C) resistant 抵抗的（to）。

• 單字補充：milestone installment 里程碑分期付款。

questions.q: The compliance officer asked that all regional directors submit their signed conflict-of-interest ------- before the end of the fiscal quarter.
options: closures
exposures
disclosures
enclosures

explain.text:
• 考點：名詞字彙辨析。

• 解析：conflict-of-interest disclosures 意為「利益衝突揭露聲明書」，為企業合規標準文件。

• 誘答分析：(D) enclosures 附件；(B) exposures 暴露／曝險；(A) closures 關閉。

• 單字補充：conflict of interest 利益衝突；fiscal quarter 會計季度。

questions.q: \------- she has extensive experience in domestic corporate law, Ms. Vance decided to consult a local specialist for the Indonesian joint venture.
options: Despite
Albeit
Although
Inasmuch as

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步連接詞結構與語意。

• 解析：前後兩子句語意對比（雖有豐富國內法經驗，仍決定諮詢當地專家），Although 引導完整讓步子句（雖然）。

• 誘答分析：(B) Albeit 後方不可接完整「主詞＋動詞」子句（僅接形容詞或名詞片語）；(A) Despite 為介系詞，不可接子句；(D) Inasmuch as 意為「因為／既然」，因果邏輯不合。

• 單字補充：domestic corporate law 國內公司法；joint venture 合資企業。

questions.q: The two conglomerates entered into a ------- cross-licensing arrangement, allowing each to use the other's wireless charging patents.
options: unilateral
peripheral
unilateralist
reciprocal

explain.text:
• 考點：形容詞字彙辨析。

• 解析：reciprocal 意為「互惠的、雙向的」，與後半句「允許彼此使用對方的無線充電專利」及 cross-licensing（交叉授權）完美呼應。

• 誘答分析：(A) unilateral 單方面的；(C) unilateralist 單邊主義的；(B) peripheral 邊緣的／周邊的。

• 單字補充：conglomerate 企業集團；cross-licensing 交叉授權。

questions.q: Employees are reminded that ------- must not upload confidential client files to unapproved public websites.
options: they
their
them
theirs

explain.text:
• 考點：代名詞格位判斷。

• 解析：空格位於 that 引導的名詞子句主詞位置，指代前方的複數名詞 Employees，故須選主格代名詞 they。

• 誘答分析：(C) them 為受格；(B) their 為所有格；(D) theirs 為所有格代名詞，皆不可當子句主詞。

• 單字補充：confidential 機密的；unapproved 未經核准的。

questions.q: The new shipping policy applies ------- to orders placed after March 15, regardless of when the customer account was created.
options: respectively
previously
exclusively
approximately

explain.text:
• 考點：副詞字彙辨析。

• 解析：句意指出新出貨政策「僅／專屬於（exclusively）」3 月 15 日之後下訂的訂單，不論帳號何時建立。

• 誘答分析：(B) previously 先前地；(A) respectively 分別地；(D) approximately 大約地，皆與句意不符。

• 單字補充：shipping policy 出貨政策；regardless of 不論／不管。

questions.q: Having failed to reach a consensus on pricing terms, the negotiators agreed to ------- the meeting until Monday morning.
options: promote
proceed
propose
postpone

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞字彙辨析。

• 解析：postpone 意為「延後／延期」，符合「未能在定價條款上達成共識，同意將會議延至週一早上」的語意。

• 誘答分析：(C) propose 提議；(A) promote 推廣／升遷；(B) proceed 繼續進行，皆不搭配 until Monday morning。

• 單字補充：reach a consensus 達成共識。

questions.q: \------- of the substantial legal fees involved, the board voted to pursue patent litigation to defend its flagship medical device.
options: Regarding
Unlike
Independent
Irrespective

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞片語搭配（空格後有 of）。

• 解析：Irrespective of 意為「不管、不顧（龐大律師費）」，後方固定接 of。

• 誘答分析：(A) Regarding 關於（後不接 of，且語意不合）；(B) Unlike 不接 of，語意也不合；(C) Independent of 獨立於……之外，語意不合。

• 單字補充：pursue litigation 進行訴訟；flagship 旗艦產品。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: expedite
subsidize
validate
jeopardize

explain.text: 公開揭露未申請專利的發明會「危害／損害（jeopardize）」取得專利保護的能力。(A) 加速、(B) 補貼、(C) 驗證皆語意相反。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: Otherwise
In contrast
Nevertheless
Consequently

explain.text: 前句說明歐洲與日本採嚴格絕對新穎性原則，「因此（Consequently）」法務團隊需要足夠前置時間先提出暫時性申請。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).
options: Should any redactions be necessary, the reviewer will contact you within ten business days.
Previous conference recordings are archived on the company intranet for viewing.
Engineering managers are encouraged to recruit graduate interns at these events.
The university's endowment fund will cover all travel expenses for presenters.

explain.text: 前句說專利律師將審閱敏感商業機密，「若有需要塗黑刪節（redactions）之處，審查員將於十個工作天內聯繫您」，承接最自然。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).
options: until
provided
whereas
unless

explain.text:
provided (that) 意為「前提是／只要」，說明行銷手冊免受此政策限制，「前提是已獲企業傳播部核准」。

• Q135–Q138（信函：共同開發協議第 9.2 條修訂）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).
options: subsequence
subsequences
subsequent
subsequently

explain.text: 空格修飾名詞 improvements（改良技術），須選形容詞 subsequent（後續的）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: Our board feels that such an arrangement does not fairly reflect our technical contribution.
The Japanese patent office recently approved our joint trademark registration.
We have already shipped the hardware prototypes to your Yokohama facility.
Please confirm the catering preferences for our upcoming Tokyo visit.

explain.text: 前句指出目前條文讓對方獨佔所有衍生軟體所有權，故緊接「我方董事會認為此安排無法公平反映我方的技術貢獻」最連貫。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).
options: granting
grant
granted
to grant

explain.text: with + 受詞 (each party) + 受詞補語 獨立結構，每一方「被授予（granted）」非專屬免費授權，呈被動關係。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).
options: speculation
stipulation
saturation
simulation

explain.text:
stipulation 意為「合約條款／規定」，指附件修訂版反映了這項條款修訂。

• Q139–Q142（合規公告：歐盟跨境資料傳輸）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (139).
options: adopt
adopting
adoption
adopted

explain.text: 過去分詞片語作後位修飾，指歐盟執委會「所採納的（adopted）」標準合約條款（SCCs）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).
options: European offices will be closed for a regional bank holiday next Monday.
A complete list of approved vendors can be downloaded from the Procurement dashboard.
The marketing team is redesigning our corporate website for mobile users.
Annual performance reviews for support staff will begin in January.

explain.text: 前句要求確認每個第三方處理商均已簽署新附約，接續「核准供應商完整清單可於採購儀表板下載」最切合工作流程。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (141).
options: In addition
For instance
By contrast
As a result

explain.text: 前後段皆在列舉新合規措施（上段簽署 SCC、本段 IT 啟用自動加密標籤），故選遞進轉折語 In addition（此外）。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (142).
options: owing to
as well as
in spite of
rather than

explain.text:
請立刻通報資料保護長，「而不是（rather than）」自行嘗試透過替代伺服器繞道傳輸資料。

• Q143–Q146（電子郵件：年度反貪腐認證）

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (143).
options: comply
compliantly
compliance
compliant

explain.text: 介系詞 to 與形容詞 full 之後須接名詞 compliance（遵守／合規），compliance with 為固定搭配。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (144).
options: contested
attested
detested
protested

explain.text: attest 意為「證實、簽署證明」，線上問卷須由經授權的公司主管「簽署證明（attested）」。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (145).
options: In addition, randomly selected partners may undergo a virtual documentation audit in Q1.
Invoice payments are typically processed within forty-five days of delivery.
Our new warehouse in Rotterdam will double our European storage capacity.
Please update your shipping labels to reflect our revised postal code.

explain.text: 承接問卷認證流程，補充「此外，隨機抽選的合作夥伴可能於第一季接受線上文件稽核」，語意連貫。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (146).
options: eligible
liable
available
susceptible

explain.text: be available 意為「（服務台）週一至週五皆可提供協助」。

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To announce a change in corporate insurance policies
To require all existing contracts to be re-signed by November 1
To require staff to adopt a newer agreement format
To explain how to handle component supply-chain delays

explain.text: 同義替換——原文要求使用新版 Clause-Library Template v4.2，改寫為 require staff to adopt a newer agreement format。誘答：(A)(D)(B) 混用原文 corporate insurance policy、supply-chain disruptions、November 1。

questions.q: What is required if a contract manager wishes to modify the Limitation of Liability cap?
options: Approval in writing from a pair of company officers
An addendum drafted using legacy template v3.8
Approval from the international client's legal team
A formal review by the component procurement team

explain.text:
同義替換——written sign-off from both the General Counsel and the Chief Financial Officer 改寫為 Approval in writing from a pair of company officers。誘答：(C)(B)(D) 錯配 international clients、legacy template v3.8、component。

• Q149–Q150（簡訊對話：商標共存協議）

questions.q: What did the Berlin counsel agree to?
options: Selling the "Lumix" trademark to Claire's company
Restricting Claire's company to selling only in Germany
Permitting worldwide commercial use of a brand name in one sector
Dropping a lawsuit regarding consumer lighting products

explain.text: 同義替換——全球範圍（worldwide coexistence）用於工業感測器，改寫為 Permitting worldwide commercial use of a brand name in one sector。誘答：(A)(D)(B) 錯用 Lumix、consumer lighting。

questions.q: What does Marcus ask Claire to do?
options: Confirm whether they plan to enter consumer retail
Copy him on correspondence sent to the other party
Call the Berlin counsel back to negotiate pricing
Prepare the signature page himself

explain.text:
同義替換——cc me when you send it over to their partner 改寫為 Copy him on correspondence sent to the other party。誘答：(C)(D)(A) 錯配 Berlin counsel、signature、consumer retail。

• Q151–Q153（電子郵件：回應停止侵權警告函）

questions.q: Why did NexGen Corp. send a cease-and-desist letter to Solaris Tech?
options: NexGen wants to license its air-cooled heat sink to Solaris Tech.
NexGen accuses Solaris Tech of unauthorized technology use.
Solaris Tech delayed launching its SmartGrid Inverter line.
Solaris Tech copied NexGen's 2014 Japanese patent publication.

explain.text: 同義替換——alleges that your cooling-fan housing infringes their Utility Patent 改寫為 accuses Solaris Tech of unauthorized technology use。誘答：(D)(C)(A) 錯配 2014 Japanese patent publication、SmartGrid Inverter、air-cooled heat sink。

questions.q: On what basis does Mr. Morales believe Solaris Tech has a strong defense?
options: NexGen's patent expired two years ago.
The SmartGrid Inverter is only sold outside the United States.
Solaris Tech holds an older U.S. patent for the liquid manifold.
Solaris Tech's device omits a required design element.

explain.text: 同義替換——缺少獨立項中的必要元件（lacks even a single element），改寫為 omits a required design element。誘答：(A)(B)(C) 混用 United States、liquid manifold。

questions.q: What does Mr. Morales advise Ms. Park to do?
options: Offer to pay NexGen a modest licensing fee to avoid court
Postpone the launch of the SmartGrid Inverter immediately
File a countersuit in a Japanese court tomorrow
Deliver a written response detailing how the products differ

explain.text:
